reviewList.text:
Such a lovely spa experience! I was in da nang for three days and ended up coming here twice because I enjoyed it so much. 😂

I tried the 2-hour four-hand massage and it was honestly so relaxing. The massage was great, the staff were friendly, and they were also having a discount, so the value for money was really good.

Another unexpected highlight: they have two super cute little dogs at the spa! 🐶🐶 They were absolutely adorable and made the whole place feel even more welcoming.

And here’s the best part ：if you book a full 2-hour treatment, they provide free pickup! My friend and I were picked up in a clean and comfortable car with a really friendly driver and taken to Hoi An. After a 2-hour massage, not having to worry about transport was such a nice touch.

Honestly, for the price, service, massage and free pickup, I think this place is fantastic value. Would definitely recommend it if you’re visiting da nang，and I’d happily come back again! ❤️
reviewList.author: Tiffany Lyu (Tiffany)

reviewList.text:
Very nice and professional staff!! The massage was very good. We got a full body oil massage. There is a surcharge of 50000 VND for after 10 pm but it was totally worth it. They even have 2 dogs for emotional relief :-) halfway during the massage the staff came and asked us how the massage was. Which was really nice of them! Overall a must do in Da Nang! Will surely come back here again.

They gave a welcome drink and also a juice/ drink after the massage. They take credit cards without any surcharge.
reviewList.author: Ravi Sairaman

reviewList.text:
I had a head shampoo & a Vietnammix massage & then returned the next day for a foot massage. Head shampoo was great & came with a simple facial, my hair still feels so soft. Massage was also really good & worked through all my knots & sore spots. You can get 20% off if you make a reservation & then you get a free juice or coffee afterwards (and there are puppies!!).
Rooms were a good temperature, the therapists checked in regularly on the pressure & made sure I was comfortable.
Highly recommend 💖
reviewList.author: Rachel Benson

reviewList.text:
In love with this place! I had my nails done by a lady artist! She gave my a special glove that protects the skin while drying the gel. She was very accurate and works flawless. My nails turned out perfect!!!
I was offered a drink from their bar, and chose a lychee tea.  The whole experience was so welcoming. It’s so easy to find this place as it’s just next the Sala Danang hotel.
It was definitely my favorite spot in Vietnam 🇻🇳!
reviewList.author: Anati Keinan

reviewList.text:
I had a really great experience at this spa. They offer free pick-up service, which made everything very convenient, and I also received a 20% discount by making a reservation.

Before the massage, they let me choose a drink from the menu, and the drink was served after the massage, which was such a nice touch. The staff were all very kind, welcoming, and attentive throughout the whole experience.

With the free pick-up, discount, complimentary drink, and friendly service, I was very satisfied. I would definitely recommend this spa!

reviewList.text: We had a relaxing family time here at Maison Spa.  My wife and I came with our two children (4 yo and 8yo) for massage.  The four hand massage was excellent and highly recommended. We are glad they were able to accommodate our kids as well.  They spoke English well and were easy to communicate with. The staff is very friendly and accommodating.  The facilities were clean and nicely decorated.  You can see a beautiful view of the lady Buddha, beach, and city line from the treatment room.  It’s our third time coming to this spa in our 11 day trip.  Highly recommended!

It was such a wonderful and rewarding experience!

My husband and I joined a yoga class at Furama Hotel during the Chuseok holiday. The class was a great workout, and we had such a lovely time thanks to our kind and beautiful instructor, THANH.

She guided us with such warmth and care, and made the class both enjoyable and refreshing. Thanks to her, I really enjoyed yoga and even felt inspired to exercise more regularly after returning to Korea.

Thank you so much, THANH, for making our time at Furama Hotel so special and enjoyable. We truly appreciate it!

reviewList.text:
i've been to some of the biggest NYC yoga studios, watched free and paid yoga content online, so I've seen a lot of instructors and Thanh is genuinely amazing! her voice is incredibly calming, and every day is varied enough that the classes don't feel boring. she has great energy and pacing so even though it's only a 45 minute class, it never feels rushed and i always leave with a great feeling of peace. her morning classes are easier, but the evening ones are still beginner friendly and she adjusts the routine according to guests, even for someone that was pregnant. she also offers sound therapy, but i haven't attended that one yet.

the facilities are great as well, the unique yoga studio is extremely ornate and the most serene one I've ever practiced in, there's even peacocks in the amazing lobby that overlooks their pool, the beach, and the sunrise. the same high end intricate designs are carried on into the spa, from the lockers to the large dry sauna that gets properly hot.

The spa itself is very clean, elegant, and feels brand new. The ambiance is peaceful, the staff are courteous and highly skilled, and you can really feel the attention to detail in the service. After several days of walking around Da Nang and Hoi An, this was the perfect way to end our Vietnam trip before flying back to the Philippines tomorrow.

So when I found myself walking along the beach and felt the pull to get a massage, I checked my saved places and noticed Dragon Spa was just down the street so I decided to walk over.

The owner was very warm and welcoming. While I waited, I was offered tea and a herbal foot soak. At first the water felt quite hot, but the owner gently encouraged me to let my feet adjust, explaining that the warmth was good for my body - and he was right! After a few moments, it became incredibly soothing, and it was actually lovely to sit and relax into it. 🍵

My massage therapist was truly exceptional. I’ve had massages all over the world, and you can immediately tell when someone is deeply skilled. She released tension I didn’t even realize I was carrying, and gently cracked and aligned different areas of my body, which left me feeling physically lighter and more open. I’ve recently gone through a difficult heartbreak, and as she worked on my shoulders, I felt emotions and old memories releasing in a way that was both gentle and deeply healing.

The spa itself is very clean, peaceful, and calming. After my session, I was offered tea again, and I left feeling relaxed, renewed, and genuinely cared for.

I feel very aligned with the energy of this place and will absolutely be returning when I’m back in this beach area. 🙏🐉

reviewList.text:
I had a really great experience at this salon, and now that it has been almost three weeks since my visit, I feel even more confident recommending them because I can truly see how my hair turned out and how well it has held up.

From the beginning, everyone was very attentive, gentle, and kind. My main hairdresser, Khang, was especially professional. When I arrived, he was already busy with other clients, but he still took the time to properly consult with me and make sure I felt comfortable with the plan. There was a language barrier between us, but he made a real effort to communicate — using translation, showing me pictures, and taking the time to understand what kind of result I wanted. I really appreciated that.

I had a permanent beach-wave treatment, and I’m very happy with the result. The curls were more defined at first, but after a few weeks they have relaxed beautifully and now look much more natural. Most importantly, my hair still feels healthy and “alive” rather than overly damaged, which makes me feel that the products and technique they used were of good quality.

What impressed me the most, though, was their after-service care and accountability. A few days after my first visit, Khanh reached out to check how my hair was doing, whether it was easy to manage, and whether I was happy with the result. I mentioned that a few curls at the back didn’t seem to be holding as well as the others. He immediately offered for me to come back so he could check it and fix it if necessary.

I wasn’t able to come back that same week, but once I had time to visit, they welcomed me and checked my hair without making me feel uncomfortable at all. They fixed the areas that needed attention and even offered an additional collagen treatment for my hair. Khang was again actively involved throughout the process, making sure everything was done properly and that I was satisfied.

For me, this is what really shows professionalism. It’s not just about doing a good job the first time — it’s also about being responsible for the result afterward and genuinely caring about whether the client is happy.

I left both times feeling well taken care of, and I would definitely come back again. I’m very happy with my waves and with the overall experience. I would absolutely recommend this salon to anyone looking for a professional and attentive hairdresser who will genuinely do their best to make sure you love your hair. ❤️

I went here because it had good reviews and it was clean and professional looking.

The staff all look extremely young   They wear a professional uniform though the head woman wore what looked to be pyjamas!

I filled out the professional form saying medium strength on my shoulders and upper back and legs and soft/ gentle over my lower back/ hips.

I had booked a 1 hour full body massage and half hour foot massage.

I got left for 10 minutes to soak my feet in a bucket with a tea bag in it. Then had feet dried and taken upstairs to massage table. The girl then pressed my left hip so hard that I yelped. Then fluffed around using google translate on her phone to say sorry.

She hadn’t been trained in massage techniques so the total back massage was her running her fingers up and down each side of spine and then running her thumb in an unprofessional and uncaring way over the top of my neck shoulder area.

Then she tried to turn me over. Hadn’t done hips, or arms or legs at all. More wasted time with her typing out more half hearted messages through Google translate and saying she could do my legs if I wanted when she was doing my feet. How do you get a half hour foot massage when the therapist is *suddenly* doing leg massage.

I knew it wasn’t going to get any better so got up and left. I wrote all of this out clearly to the head woman who didn’t bother to read it by herself but let the young girl read it standing next to me.

I got lots of sorry, sorry but considering this was going to be my last time set aside for a massage before I boarded an international flight I left sore, and annoyed and it wasted my time.

I do not recommend.

reviewList.text:
I’m not usually one to write reviews because I have pretty intense ADHD and don’t usually have the patience for it 😅 but I got my hair done by Madam Thao yesterday and was so happy with the experience.

Their salon is completely vegan, so you can rest assured that all of the products they use don’t cause harm to animals. This was an absolutely huge selling point for me because I’ve been living in Da Nang for about eight months now, and it’s really hard to find salons that even understand the terms “vegan” and “cruelty-free,” much less are 100% vegan to begin with.

It’s so refreshing to be able to go somewhere and not have to ask a million questions just to make sure the beauty treatments I’m receiving don’t contribute to animal suffering.

They also finished my hair in under two hours, which I was really impressed by. That’s another thing that’s important to me because with my ADHD, I find it difficult to sit in a chair for an extended period of time. I’m also juggling a lot of projects, so I really appreciate it when a salon can provide high-quality services without taking all day.

There were two people working on my hair the entire time, and even though they didn’t speak much English, you could tell they were incredibly kind and wanted to do everything possible to make sure I was happy with the result.

This will definitely be my go-to salon from now on.

They also have a completely vegan restaurant right next door, so it’s super convenient to grab food and then get your hair done. That’s another thing I’ve struggled with in the past because I often forget to eat, then end up sitting in a salon chair for hours and hours. Then, by the time I’m finished, I’m exhausted and starving 😂

Honestly, what they’ve created by combining a vegan salon and vegan restaurant into one lifestyle hub is a genius idea, and I couldn’t be more grateful that Da Nang has something like this now.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a vegan, cruelty-free salon experience in Da Nang. So so so grateful for them 🤍🤍

reviewList.text:
Very disappointing massage and anything but a professional approach.

For three days in a row, I was pressured to come in, to the point of being followed down the street. I’m used to being approached like this in Vietnam, but this was simply too much. I eventually promised I would come in the evening.

I booked a one-hour foot massage. Unfortunately, the experience was very uncomfortable. The person giving me the massage kept looking at me in a very awkward way throughout the whole session, asked me if I was married, and basically used two different movements for the entire hour… for 400,000 VND.

The staff were friendly, the welcome was nice, and the cold drink was appreciated. Everything else was disappointing. Even more so when I was asked for a tip and then pressured to leave a 5-star review before leaving.

There are much better places nearby, for barely more money, where you can get a full 2-hour treatment including nails, shampoo, massage and facial — without having to beg for tips or 5-star reviews.

So now I’m wondering: were all those 5-star reviews actually voluntary?

Oh, and I was also asked for my WhatsApp number so they could make sure I came back. 😂

Definitely not coming back.

It’s been a week now and not a single chip—the polish is holding up like it’s protected by a max-level magic barrier. Long story short, I dropped in for a regular manicure and walked out with +100 confidence and flawless nails. Definitely coming back for the next "season"!

reviewList.text:
I came in with a straightforward task: get a decent nude shade that wouldn't peel off within a week of typing on my keyboard. No 3D art, no glitter, and no stories about their ex-stylist.

Here’s the breakdown:

- Time. Exactly an hour and a half. Not a rushed 40-minute hack job, but not a three-hour marathon where your legs go numb either.
- Process. They work quietly and precisely. I didn't flinch once, even though my cuticles are pretty sensitive.
- The Result. My nails look like mine, just better. Thin, even, without that thick layer of gel that makes your fingers look like sausages.

It’s been two weeks now. The manicure survived deep cleaning without gloves and packing a suitcase. No chips, no lifting.

I won't call it 'pure magic' it's just good, solid work for a reasonable price. If you want results without drama or small talk, this place is a solid choice.

My massage focused on overall relaxation, especially the shoulders, back and legs, which felt great after the flight. The pressure could also be adjusted based on preference. My son’s massage was much gentler and suitable for children.

The spa was quiet and comfortable, and it was a really nice way to start our first day in Da Nang before heading out for sightseeing.

Had a fabulous, relaxing afternoon with my family at this spa. We only discovered it on our last day, which was such a shame! From the hotel pickup to the refreshing drink after our massage, everything was exceptional.
I absolutely loved the 90-minute bamboo massage—it was one of the best massages I've had. The staff were welcoming, the atmosphere was peaceful, and the whole experience was incredibly relaxing.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality massage and a truly relaxing spa experience. We'll certainly be back next time!
reviewList.author: Jesal Patel

reviewList.text: Amazing, relaxing spa experience, and wonderful massage. They have a wide range of massage selection, including aroma, hot stone and bamboo massage. My partner did the bamboo massage and said it was awesome, great for untangling muscle knots and relaxing stiffness. Very reasonable price with private rooms/bathrooms, delicious mangoes post-massage and also hotel transfers. Came twice during our short stay here and wish we discovered it earlier :) thank you!
reviewList.author: Chasing Sunsets

reviewList.text:
Dahan Spa was recommended to me, so I went.
It didn't disappoint. My wife and I got a 90-minute aromatherapy session.
They had us fill out a questionnaire to point out any spots we wanted extra attention on.
The therapists really knew their stuff and made sure the pressure was just right.
Afterward, we got mango juice and fruit.
I'd say it's one of the best massages I've ever had.
reviewList.author: Tony S

reviewList.text: Experience was 10/10 here! I highly recommend. They really prioritize your satisfaction down to every detail and it was a real plus with how well they spoke Korean for my mom since that’s her primary language. If you’re looking for a sweet treat afterwards too, they also own a mango dessert shop called Pink Mango which they had ready for us right after our massage was over. They also provided us free mango drinks along with mango slices.
reviewList.author: Genie Kim

attribution.name: dahan spa danang - Best Spa Massage Danang 다한스파 다낭점

reviewList.text: Served by Bonnie. She was really skillful, strong and know how to adjust her strength according to the customer. I fall asleep while she was doing the pedicure. Very comfortable. 😴
reviewList.author: Joseph Goh

reviewList.text: I really feel asleep feeling so comfortable with the pedicure service. Yumi was the one serving me and I felt very comfortable and pleased with her service. I think price is reasonable. I came with my husband.
reviewList.author: Shannon Cheng

reviewList.text:
Extremely disappointed! Great tips and trust in return for sloppy work and excuses
I just got a cat-eye manicure at this shop yesterday (costing 300,000 VND). I thought the service was good back then and even went out of my way to exchange money to give the nail artist a tip. Trusting them, I came back today to get a pedicure, also paying 300,000 VND. However, I was met with completely unreasonable double standards and treatment:
1. Excuses and Inconsistent Standards: The nail tech first excused herself by saying my toenails were too small for cat-eye style and I could only get a regular solid color. But yesterday when doing my fingers, they explicitly said they could mix colors and do cat-eye. Today, they refused any color blending, showing completely inconsistent standards.
2. Severe Drop in Quality and Time: Yesterday’s manicure took 50 minutes, while today’s pedicure was rushed and finished in just 25 minutes. The final result looks like cheap, ordinary nail polish—completely incomparable to a proper cat-eye effect.
3. Heartless and Defensive Attitude: When I raised the issue with the shop, they rudely brushed it off by saying "pedicures naturally take less time," completely dodging the core problem: charging the price of a cat-eye while only providing a cheap single-color polish without any mention of a refund!
We treat the shop with kindness, trust, and tips, only to be met with sloppy, low-quality service and a defensive attitude. It is completely unacceptable! I have retracted my 5-star review from yesterday and posted this honest review to expose their true colors—"nice on the first visit, dismissive on the second." I will definitely never come back again!
reviewList.author: Teresa Tracy Chang

reviewList.text:
I had a really good experience at Suzy Nails & Foot Massage. I did ear cleaning, a back massage and a foot massage, and everything was very comfortable and well done.

Special thanks to staff No. 6, who took care of me. The ear cleaning was especially comfortable and clean. For the back and foot massage, she adjusted the pressure according to what I was comfortable with, which made the whole experience very relaxing.

Really happy with the service and would definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: Amos Yap

reviewList.text:
If you're traveling in Da Nang, Vietnam, I highly recommend Suzy Massage to relax and recharge after a long day.

It was my first time trying an exfoliating treatment, and I was really impressed! I felt so refreshed afterward.

A special thanks to ZANG for the excellent service and kindness. She was incredibly friendly and professional.

I feel completely refreshed. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience! Highly recommended! :D
reviewList.author: Wooheesung Woo

places.name: Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm
places.address: 26XW+XQ4, 81 Hoàng Kế Viêm, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
An absolutely amazing experience at Nguon Spa Da Nang! The environment is incredibly serene, elegant, and of the highest quality—it truly feels like a premium oasis. The whole spa experience was top-notch from start to finish.

I want to give a special shoutout to the reception staff, who were extraordinarily welcoming, attentive, and professional. They made us feel right at home the moment we walked through the door.

Furthermore, a huge thank you to our four fantastic therapists: Trang, Lieu, Suong, and Tham. Their massage skills and dedication were exceptional. They paid great attention to detail and went above and beyond to ensure we were completely relaxed and comfortable throughout the entire session.

Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Da Nang. We will definitely be coming back!
reviewList.author: Austin Hong

reviewList.text:
I had a 90 minute massage scheduled with Anh BT with a focus on my neck, shoulders, and lower back. Anh BT did not disappoint. Her technique, her pressure, was excellent and throughout the massage she had great communication always being sure to check in to make sure I was ok.

I only received a massage although the spa does offer other services such as facials, scrubs, and hair treatments. Unfortunately my appointment was very last minute so it was the only service I was able to get.

Upon arrival you are greeted warmly by the staff and welcome with an iced tea and dates. The place looks very clean and the staff are very friendly and professional.

I highly recommend this place if you are in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Alissa Fontanos

reviewList.text:
Did the 75 min package with 15 minute Himalayan sauna and 60 min full body massage. It was the best 75 minutes of relaxation! Trang BT was amazing and had all the pressure points.

The spa was so welcoming and everyone was able to speak English (or some). It was very clean, relaxing and had welcome and after massage tea.

Worth the stop!
reviewList.author: Blesyl Silvestre

reviewList.text: I found this spa during my research on tik tok, and it was everything we thought and more. The spa is clean, very beautiful, and the employees were very kind. Suong BT did an amazing job and checked in with me multiple times to ensure that I was having a great experience. Our 75 min couples massage included tea and snacks before/after. The prices were fair and slightly higher than others because they do not except tips. You get what you pay for and this was 100% worth it and more! We will be back again this trip before the next leg of our Asia trip. I would highly recommend this spa!
reviewList.author: Maryann Hoang

reviewList.text: Had the most wonderful experience at Nguồn Spa. I booked the 90 minute hot stone massage and it was exceptional from start to finish. My therapist, Vi, was amazing, so caring and attentive throughout, and clearly skilled at her craft. The pressure was perfect, the hot stones were incredibly soothing, and the whole treatment left me feeling completely relaxed and restored. The space itself is calm and welcoming too. I'll definitely be back and will be requesting Vi again. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a proper, caring massage experience in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Lisa Ockinga

attribution.name: Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm
Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm

reviewList.text: Great service from start to finish. A cold drink and coconut crackers at the start, then onto the massage. They have a real focus on hygiene during the massage and in the entire place in general (including the toilet facilities). They used several hot towels during the massage, which gave the feeling of being in a hot spa. They gave us tea and a slice of water melon after the massage.
reviewList.author: James Lawson

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely recommended!

We had a 90-minute massage and it was honestly one of the best massages we’ve had in Vietnam so far. Very professional, relaxing, and exactly the right amount of pressure.

The staff were extremely friendly and attentive, and the whole atmosphere was calm and welcoming. You can really tell that they know what they’re doing.

We will definitely come back. Highly recommended – 5 stars plus from us! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: DyFlora

reviewList.text:
Just do a 60 mins hot stone body massage and massage skill from Ms. Vân is so good. My body feel relieved and my muscles no longer hurt. Facilities is clean and rooms are big. Just remind that price price are serperates with tips (service charges)
Overall:
Service: 5/5
Facility: 5/5
Price: 4/5
Location: 4/5

Will i come back later? Yes.
reviewList.author: Nguyen Minh Vu

reviewList.text: Amazing experience I had a package for the massage, facial, face pack and hair wash! I was floating out. They take good care of you tea and snacks. I have never felt so relaxed! Thank you my mum loved it too
reviewList.author: carly bickerton

reviewList.text:
Busy expect to wait or make an appointment in advance.

Excellent hospitality they offered sweet teas and coconut cookies while you wait. Watermelon and hot tea when you end.

Don't bother paying extra for scented oils as you can't smell anything during the massage.  Perhaps was too diluted.

Had my first ever 4 hands massage.  Could feel two hands were stronger had more energy.  The other two were hesitant or maybe she's ending her shift late in the day.  Reminded her to increase pressure 4-5 times but was unheeded.  The masseuses could be external contractors as they left the shop when we finished  Best to have massage here early in the day perhaps.

3% fee for credit card.
reviewList.author: Porter KHOR

reviewList.text: Herbal Spa which I experienced on Friday, 23rd October 2026 is simply awesome & by far the best spa I have been to during my 6 days stay in Danang.  It's the grand finale I must say before heading to the airport. We (4pax) paid for a 2.5 hrs Herbal Massage & Cupping for body & feet each at a reasonable price. The masseuses are very skilful & professional & most important they didn't skive in their job unlike Maya Spa. I feel relaxed, shoulders are lighter & can sleep better at night. This Spa definitely deserves a 6-star rating! I hope to come back again next year.
reviewList.author: Betty Lim

reviewList.text: Such a cute massage spa. If you like deep strong knots relieving massage, this is the place. The ease of booking appointments and the friendly staff, made this place our favorite in Da Nang. I found this place through instagram and got the herbal aroma massage.
reviewList.author: Christie Ly

reviewList.text: Absolutely delighted to be here. Before you go in, you will fill in a simple form to help them tailor their services for you. You can choose your own essential oil. I personally really recommend the blossom one. The staff are really friendly. The massage experience was relaxing, with soft music in the background. They have warm pads for your neck and different body parts. Their coconut biscuits are delicious. Overall, it is definitely a 5-star experience.
reviewList.author: 0v0 Tree

reviewList.text: The most relaxing massage I’ve had! I did the Four hands package and absolutely loved it. Would definitely come here again. All the staff can speak English well so made it very easy to communicate.
reviewList.author: Clarissa Lundy

reviewList.text: Nice ambience. friendly & attentive staff.  skilful and meticulous therapists with strong, slow strokes . calm massage. Nice dessert! Tho a bit more pricey than those along common streets! But Best so far! Especially the four hands! Don’t miss!
reviewList.author: Rick Yang

reviewList.text: I walked past and smelled very nice aroma scent coming out, and then noticed it is a spa. Given the good review, I decided to give it a go. It turned out to be really great. The masseur is very attentive. I was having a sensitive nose, she thought I was cold so she turned up the aircon, added blanket, and prepared tissue for me. I would want to come back again!
reviewList.author: Joyce Y

reviewList.text:
Went to this spot as a solo female around 1pm on a Tuesday with no reservation. Just had to wait 15m! I got the 2 hour massage because I’ve been averaging 20k steps around Vietnam and really needed it, especially cuz I’m leaving tomorrow morning and going to be on a flight. Very pleasant and relaxing experience! Organized, not chaotic, peaceful, exactly what I needed. I would definitely come here again!

They were attentive to the form I filled out, place was very clean and safe! I especially liked that my massage was in a private room with private bathroom.
reviewList.author: Leah Acosta

reviewList.text: My husband and I just enjoyed an incredibly relaxing yet energizing 2 hour massage!  Cong Spa and Nail is a quiet, cozy and beautiful spa just a quick walk from the Han Market and River.  We have had the Dry Massage which incorporates stretching and deep massage as well as the aromatherapy massage.  The therapists were amazing!  Miss Huong, Miss My and Ms. Ly are phenomenal! We have been here several times over the past few months and the staff and therapists above are consistently outstanding!
reviewList.author: K Carter

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful experience at Cong Spa! The place is clean, relaxing, and has a very welcoming atmosphere. The staff are friendly, accommodating, and professional. The massage was relaxing and exactly what I needed after exploring Da Nang. I also appreciated their excellent customer service and attention to detail. Highly recommended! Will definitely come back on my next visit to Da Nang. ❤️
reviewList.author: Marie Judisah Quiñopa

reviewList.text: We had a good experience last time, so we decided to come back for a second visit! The hot stone massage was really relaxing. We love it a lot!!
reviewList.author: Yasti Choi

reviewList.text:
Amazing massage, excellent service, and unbeatable value for money!

We had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa! From beginning to end, everything was relaxing, professional, and enjoyable.

The massage therapist was fantastic, with excellent technique, the perfect amount of pressure, and great attention to detail. We enjoyed a 60-minute full-body massage with hot stones for only 300,000 VND, which is incredible value for the quality of the treatment!

The hot stones added another level of relaxation, and one detail we especially appreciated was how perfectly they removed the massage oil afterward. We left feeling refreshed, clean, and completely relaxed, without that greasy feeling you sometimes get after an oil massage.

The entire experience was comfortable, peaceful, and well worth every dong!

If you're looking for a great massage in Vietnam at an amazing price, this place is definitely worth visiting! Excellent therapists, wonderful treatment, and fantastic value for money. We would happily come back again!
reviewList.author: Assaf Liran

reviewList.text: Wonderful experience! We had foot massages and full body massages. We came back multiple times on our stay. Lovely staff and delicious mango smoothies!
reviewList.author: Jen Wilson

reviewList.text:
Best massage exp we had so far here in Danang!
Tried other spas but this is the best one.
They even have welcome drinks & fruits + free water and drinks.
Pressure is on point based on how we requested it and we enjoyed it alot.

I got foot massage and my husband tried full body oil massage. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Fem Somera

reviewList.text:
Yesterday, we went for a massage at this place and were very impressed. The therapist who massaged me was lovely and friendly. The therapist who worked on my boyfriend seemed a bit less cheerful, but that’s okay.

Before the massage, they served ripe mango and tea, both of which were absolutely delicious. We chose the 1-hour foot massage, and near the end of the session, they also used hot stones, which felt amazing and was a very relaxing experience.

If you’re looking for a massage shop with good service, we highly recommend this place. 😊
reviewList.author: Maliwan Street to Suite

reviewList.text:
Unfortunately I have to be honest 😕 the reviews are definitely NOT TRUE! As a foreigner, when something says ' Foot Massage ' we expect a FOOT MASSAGE!! THIS WAS A 1 HOUR KNEE, LEG & CALF MASSAGE!! 2 MINUTES ON FEET.
The super SUGAR FREE DRINK AT THE END IS POINTLESS! WHY WOULD ANYBODY WANT A SWEET SUGAR DRING after a Massage???
Sorry but Canada 🇨🇦 foreigners and most will be disappointed 😞 and the reviews are NOT REAL.
I can't imagine asking for a ' Head & Neck ' Massage: what would they actually rub ???😳
Most likely NOT the area you chose.
Foot means FOOT!!!!   LET'S GET REAL NOT THE LEG FOR 45 MINUTES!!!😖
NEW MANAGEMENT NEEDED
reviewList.author: Kenneth D.

reviewList.text: I love this spa!! It was my first time ever getting a massage, and the whole process was smooth and comfortable. The entire staff is so friendly and helpful, and they would ask if the strength pressure was ok during the massage. I was given a sheet before my massage, it asked about my preferences and what part of my body to focus more on. The massage will be catered to you! Afterwards they gave me snacks and tea, I feel so refreshed!
reviewList.author: Kody

reviewList.text: We had a 90 minutes full body massage with hot stones, the place is nice and clean they have a change of clothes to have a massage in and a locker with key to lock up your belongings very good massage highly recommend. There's a 20% promo discount at certain times we went around 12.00pm on a Wednesday and a 5 % credit card fee if paying by card but we still got 15% off in total. Also get a drink and snack after the massage.
reviewList.author: Jeff

reviewList.text:
I chose this venue over a few others on the same street, and the initial impression was lovely. The entrance area is beautifully decorated, fresh, and has a very pleasant aroma. The reception staff were incredibly welcoming, and even though I walked in without a booking, they accommodated me seamlessly. The pricing at the entrance is also very transparent and clear, which I appreciated.

However, a few aspects of the experience could be improved. The foot-washing process takes place in the waiting area rather than being done privately by the therapist. Having your feet washed in full view of everyone else waiting felt rather uncomfortable; a bit more privacy here would go a long way.

Additionally, you are asked to leave all your belongings in a separate changing room. While they provide a key, it feels quite flimsy and easy to misplace or break. Leaving all my personal items completely out of sight in a different room made me feel slightly uneasy, especially since the venue doesn't take responsibility for them.

As for the treatment itself, I had a head and neck massage. Having tried many places in Da Nang, I found this one to be rather average. It is great for the price, but given the beautiful standard of the building, I expected a slightly higher quality of therapy.
Furthermore, toward the end of the 60-minute session, I became quite cold, as my hair was wet and the air conditioning hadn't been adjusted.

After the treatment, they offered a choice of a snack - banana or a boiled egg. While I imagine the egg is meant to be a unique touch, it felt a bit impractical for a post-massage snack. Peeling a boiled egg involves dealing with shells and trying not to make a mess, which defeats the purpose of trying to fully relaxed.

For payment, they only accept cash or QR code. It is not the most convenient setup, but manageable. Overall, it is a beautiful space, but i think I will choose another place next time .
reviewList.author: Julia Alexandrova

reviewList.text:
Tried contacting them via WhatsApp about 30 minutes before arrival, but the response was a little slow. However, when we reached around 8:30 pm via walk in, we were still able to start our 90-minute aromatherapy session almost immediately.

There are separate male and female changing rooms with lockers. We were first brought to the respective changing rooms to freshen up and store our belongings, then guided up to about level 3 for the treatment.

The room was simple with two beds, and the massage started promptly. My masseuse was amazing—her strokes were excellent and the entire 90 minutes felt incredibly relaxing. They also used hot stones and heated compress bags. The hot stones surprised me at first, but I quickly got used to them. The heated bags were placed under my neck and on my forehead, then moved to my stomach, and finally used to cover my eyes during the front massage. It felt so good that the 90 minutes passed way too quickly.

After the session, we were ushered back downstairs to change, returned the locker keys, and made payment. There is an additional 5% charge for credit card payments.
reviewList.author: Tan.W

reviewList.text: The massage therapists are talented and give better than average massages, but the services are overpriced because of the amenities and layout. First, the locker room has no privacy, so customers are forced to change openly near each other. Second, the shared massage rooms don't close the curtains, so it is like a row of sardines—not a pretty sight. Aside from extremely budget local spas, most other spas around the city close the curtains to create some privacy. Overall, it is difficult to return here after visiting other spas around.
reviewList.author: Rosie C.

reviewList.text: An amazing experience at Golden Lotus! It’s a very busy spot, so definitely book a slot in advance, especially during the holidays. The service was fantastic and the therapists are incredibly skilled; we completely drifted off to sleep. The complimentary tea and fresh mango fruit served before and after were lovely touches. Will absolutely return on our next trip to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Paige Pang

reviewList.text: Did a 60min foot + 30min head and shoulder massage. Experience is great, everything is done while lying down. Did a shampoo afterwards. Just take note service charge is included according to length of service. They serve drinks before and after massage with a fruit plate. Overall I feel relaxed and satisfied.
reviewList.author: Vicky Huang

reviewList.text: Had a great massage!  I love strong massages and the masseuse was able to deliver. Felt my knots melted away,  I wish they have an option for 2 hour lotus massage, 2x1 hour pricing is not attractive. Overall great experience and worth re-visiting.
reviewList.author: yves yong

reviewList.text: Just went here with my hubby and had an amazing 60minutes feet massage. It was clean. The decor was nicely done and you end with yummy mangos and other treats. Everyone was really nice. We were lucky to be taken cared of day of without a wait. Will definitely come back and refer to friends and family.
reviewList.author: Lien

reviewList.text:
I did a 60 minute “dry” lotus massage and I loved it🌟🌟🌟!!

Such a great find.  The whole experience is top notch from start to finish
reviewList.author: Jo

reviewList.text:
Absolutely wonderful experience from beginning to end. I booked the 165 minute Sum Spa Package and was incredibly impressed by the quality of the service and attention to detail throughout.

Bella took care of me and she was amazing! Incredibly skilled, gentle, and attentive to my comfort throughout the entire experience. The massage was excellent, and I also loved the body scrub, facial, and especially the head spa with the scalp scrub and head massage. Everything felt thoughtful, relaxing, and completely unhurried.

I especially appreciated all the little details - the warm herbal bags and blankets, the essential oil I selected, fresh towels and clothing after my shower from the scrub, and my hair in the end. They served fresh fruit and tea and arranged a complimentary driver back to my hotel.

I left completely relaxed with incredibly soft skin and fluffy, clean hair. Exceptional service, amazing value, and such a beautifully designed experience from start to finish. Thank you so much to the Sum Spa Team for taking such wonderful care of me. I will absolutely be returning!
reviewList.author: Sofia Wakabayashi

reviewList.text:
Wonderful therapist

Lina was absolutely wonderful! She was so kind and gentle, and her hands were incredibly soft. She really listened to my needs and respected the fact that I don’t like too much pressure. The whole experience was very relaxing and comfortable. They also offer free drop off or pick up. I would definitely recommend her and will come back again! ❤️
reviewList.author: YU LIU

reviewList.text:
My boyfriend and I arrived at 8pm for our 8:30pm booking, but unfortunately, there was some internal miscommunication. Fiona, the receptionist, sincerely apologised and asked if we were okay to wait another 20 minutes. We could genuinely feel her sincerity, and we were more than happy to wait. ❤️

When the massage started, I felt that the initial therapist might not have been as experienced, so after about 5min, I requested to change to another therapist. Anna took over, and she was experienced, professional, and really good! The reception team also kept checking in with me to make sure I was feeling comfortable, which made me feel much better and showed how much they cared about their customers.

I was actually recommended to this place, and despite the initial hiccup, the way the team handled the situation really impressed me. Their sincere apologies, attentiveness, and willingness to make things right made me feel valued as a customer. 🥰

I’m definitely willing to come back again and recommend this place to others because of their excellent customer service. 🙏🏻

Thank you, Anna and Fiona, for taking such good care of us today! ❤️
reviewList.author: Tiana Lau

reviewList.text:
One of the Most Relaxing Spas I Found in Da Nang

After days of exploring Da Nang, walking along the beach, and climbing mountains, sometimes your body just asks for one thing…

A good massage.

That’s exactly what I found at Sum Spa Da Nang.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere changes.

🌿 Soft lighting
🎵 Calm music
🌸 Pleasant aromas
😊 Friendly staff who make you feel welcome from the start

Whether you’re looking for a traditional Vietnamese massage, a relaxing oil massage, or simply a quiet place to unwind, Sum Spa offers the perfect break from the city’s busy streets.

After an hour, you’ll probably walk out feeling lighter, more relaxed, and ready for another day of exploring.
reviewList.author: Resulizm B.

reviewList.text:
"Had an incredible experience here! The place was clean, relaxing, and very welcoming. A special shoutout to the two staff members who took care of us—they were extremely polite, attentive, and professional. Their massage technique was amazing and completely relieved my fatigue. Highly recommended, and I will definitely come back next time I’m in Vietnam!

"Cảm ơn hai bạn nhân viên rất nhiều, dịch vụ rất tuyệt vời!"
reviewList.author: haohao CK

reviewList.text: We had a wonderful experience! I enjoyed the 2-hour massage, and my girlfriend also had her nails done at the same time. The staff were very friendly, professional, and attentive. Both services were excellent, and we felt relaxed and well taken care of throughout our visit. Everything was clean and comfortable. Highly recommended! We would definitely come back again.
reviewList.author: 정병규

reviewList.text:
The four hands massage was awesome! Highly recommended! Facial and heel scrub were also fabulous 😍
The staffs are very considerate and gentle. They made sure you are satisfied with their jobs. I will come back again 💕
reviewList.author: Matet Taylor

reviewList.text: My sister and I had a 30-minute foot massage. It was really nice. They served some snacks before and after the massage, and the massage was very good. The bed was also comfortable. I would have chosen two hours, but we didn't have time.
reviewList.author: Supapond Duriyaprateep

reviewList.text: Great massage, great price! The therapists were skilled and attentive, and I loved the relaxing aroma in the spa. They also treated me to free fresh mango after the session – such a nice touch. Will definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Seatory Doo

reviewList.text: We did a 30-minute foot massage only just to try the service but now maybe we will try also a full body massage next time. The service and treatment were great so I highly recommend this spa. I fell asleep right away because it was very relaxing. There’s also a complementary cold tea and a fresh cold mango fruit which makes the experience more relaxing.
reviewList.author: Alfben Nicki Rogar

reviewList.text: We visited Spa 365 for a foot massage, and they kindly let our daughter stay with us during the session. The massage pressure was just right, and the service was excellent. The prices are very reasonable, making it a great value. It's also conveniently located near Han Market, so I highly recommend stopping by after shopping!
reviewList.author: Richard Young Min Park

reviewList.text: The place was clean and the service was good overall. The therapist with long hair did a nice job, but her hair occasionally brushed against my body, which felt a bit uncomfortable. It would be great if it could be tied more neatly during the session. Also, it would be appreciated if phone use could be avoided while working on clients’ legs.
reviewList.author: Review Queen

reviewList.text: This was an amazing experience!! My boyfriend and I both got 60 min aroma massages with hot stone, by far one of the most healing massages. Thank you for the hospitality and awesome service :)
reviewList.author: Ashlee Nicole

reviewList.text:
Awesome massage😍 Got the 120 minute aroma massage with hot stone & tiger balm. The hot stone was such a relaxing touch. Felt so relaxed and refreshed after the flight to Vietnam~
Masseuses are kind, quiet and so good! Can’t wait to come back again ~~
reviewList.author: kk

reviewList.text: Had great service and massage, vave alot healing for travel ^^
reviewList.author: 상근한

reviewList.text: I've come here 4 times in a month and each time seems better than the last. The staff is great, always friendly. I have always had a great massage! I absolutely recommend it.  Pro tip - I don't drink tea but the tea after the massage is heavenly.
reviewList.author: Steve Turner

reviewList.text: I walked in to Honey SPA and welcomed by a friendly front desk Mimi who can communicate in great english. They also has excellent masseuse that relieves all my body ache.
reviewList.author: Penny Tang

reviewList.text: From the receptionist to the masseuses, everyone was polite and professional. I really appreciated the end-to-end experience - starting with a relaxing foot soak and tea, followed by incredibly thorough massages, and ending with tea and a biscuit. I chose Package 3 and honestly felt like I was in heaven. I left feeling completely relaxed and peaceful. It’s absolutely worth a visit, especially after a long travel day or a full day of walking.
reviewList.author: Mellissa N

reviewList.text: It was a great experience. Everyone was nice. The massauer lady was skillful and knew what she was doing. There was a complimentary herbal tea which was delicious. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Ivett Makk

reviewList.text:
Best massage i've had in Danang and i've been getting massages every other day.

Perfect way to end the trip before heading to the airport!

Service is friendly and incredible, my masseuse Lee has magical hands- my back pain is now gone. So relaxing!!

Highly recommend. 100/10
reviewList.author: Katrina

places.name: SEN Boutique Spa
places.address: 70 Lê Quang Đạo, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: I had an incredible experience here. The massage was incredibly relaxing and therapeutic. The therapist was attentive and noticed my bug bites and wounds, ensuring that I was comfortable with the massage in those areas. I also thoroughly enjoyed the face massage at the end and the complimentary tea and sweet soup served at the reception. Overall, I highly recommend this spa and give it a perfect 10/10 rating!
reviewList.author: 姚天鸣（Faye yao）

reviewList.text:
Definitely not worth 530,000 VND. I’ve had much better massages for around 200,000 VND. The therapist seemed young and inexperienced — it felt like she was simply rubbing a huge amount of oil over my body rather than actually working on the muscles.

I specifically asked her to focus on my neck, shoulders and the area between my shoulder blades, but she barely touched those areas and spent a lot of time on my arms, lower back and head instead.

The shower was literally inside the toilet area, there was no proper shower gel, and the towel they gave me smelled damp and unclean, as if it hadn’t been properly washed or dried. I didn’t even want to use it, so I got dressed while I was still wet. Even after showering, I left feeling completely covered in oil.

I came in in a great mood and left feeling extremely uncomfortable and disappointed.
reviewList.author: Zhaniya Murtaza

reviewList.text:
I had a great experience at Sen Boutique!
I read a lot of reviews trying to get the perfect massage package for my last day of my trip. Reviews can be very mixed, but ultimately we decided on Sen Boutique because it was nearby our hotel, and had the package we were looking for, with a good rating.

It did not disappoint! We were so pleased with the Sen Boutique Package! I message them about an hour before on WhatsApp and they replied quickly to help me book the package for 2 people.

When we arrived, we were greeted with Tea and the Form to note if you have any injuries, allergies, etc.

The steam room was great and located next to showers and lockers to clean up afterwards. Our massage therapist came when the time was up in the sauna and brought us to the room for a Foot Soak, before beginning the massage and facial.

Both my partner and I agreed that our therapist did GREAT. Applying smooth and even pressure, not too hard, checking in along the way, the technique and transitions were professional level and we felt well taken care of, and incredibly relaxed.

It was the perfect end to our trip, and we left here glowing! I am so happy we chose to go with this Spa
reviewList.author: Ashley Ann

reviewList.text:
An absolutely amazing spa experience from start to finish. The peaceful atmosphere, warm hospitality, and professional therapists made us feel completely relaxed and refreshed. The massage was perfectly done, and every detail added to the luxury and comfort of the experience.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind and recharge. We will definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: Ali Iushad

reviewList.text: I loved everything about this place. From the moment you walk in it feels like you're transported to a relaxing paradise. The staff are welcoming and accommodating - serving you tea immediately in the serene reception area. I had an amazing signature massage in a private room with a skilled massage therapist. I was then served more tea/snacks at the end. The only issue I had was that they take cash only so I had to find the nearest ATM as this was my third time visiting!
reviewList.author: Mahbuba Ahmed

places.name: Pam Spa Sora & Massage Da Nang

reviewList.text: Amazing treatment in this very professional SPA. The reception also the therapists are breathing kindness and professionalism.  Receing you with a cup of tea and a delicious cake. At the end of treatment, they offer you again a cup of tea and slice of fruits. Big thanks to Thuy Nga for her professionalism and kindness.  I highly recommend this spa after a hard day of exploring DA Nang and around.
reviewList.author: Mohamed SELOUGHA

reviewList.text: Me and my gf came here and loved it. I had a Thai massage. I’m used to getting oiled up but here I the therapist used tiger balm which I liked a lot. My muscles were very sore because of the gym and after the message my pain was gone. Definitely recommend to come here!
reviewList.author: Moritz Harwalik

reviewList.text:
I recently had the chance to experience a traditional Vietnamese hair wash at IKIGAI SPA CENTER, and it was absolutely amazing.
From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm and relaxing. The staff were very welcoming and professional, making me feel comfortable right away. The hair washing service was much more than just a simple wash — it felt like a full relaxation treatment.
They started with a gentle scalp massage that helped relieve all my stress. The techniques were slow, rhythmic, and incredibly soothing. Then came the shampooing, which was done very carefully and thoroughly, followed by a neck and shoulder massage that made the whole experience even better.
What I loved most was how attentive they were to every detail. The warm water, the soft movements, and the peaceful environment made it feel like a mini spa retreat.
After the wash, my hair felt super clean, soft, and refreshed. I also felt mentally relaxed and recharged.
If you are visiting Vietnam, I highly recommend trying a Vietnamese hair wash, especially at IKIGAI SPA CENTER. It’s not just about clean hair — it’s a unique and relaxing experience you shouldn’t miss 🥰🥰🥰
reviewList.author: กันตรัตน์ โพธิ์เย็น

reviewList.text: The service is great here. I was met, and walked to the spa room. They served me tea, biscuits before the session. The therapist was so kind, she asked me if I feel good all along. Massage was really nice. Then I was offered mango with some tea afterwards, which I didn’t expect. It was so sweet of them. Thank you were much.
reviewList.author: Єва Сучалкіна

reviewList.text: Very disappointed with this place. Midway through the massage, we noticed that the therapist had opened all the curtains wide, and we were essentially fully exposed. The room directly overlooks a public street. When we questioned it, they said it was for "fresh air" and to "stay mentally awake"—which makes no sense. There was no prior warning or consent. This is a serious privacy violation. If you value your dignity and safety, I'd suggest going elsewhere.
reviewList.author: Puiman Li

reviewList.text: Such a beautiful and thorough spa! The staff are friendly and welcoming. I enjoyed the 50-minute milk and lavender body scrub, complete with a steam bath and shower. The facility is impeccable. I must also say the tea and snacks served after the treatment were delicious! Thank you also for my gift ☺️
reviewList.author: Tiffani Lewis

reviewList.text: The best massage I had in Vietnam! Went a bit last minute an hour or so before they closed and they were kind enough to accommodate me with the massage I wanted. The drinks and snacks after were also quite good.
reviewList.author: Stephanie Albarghouthi

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing experience at this spa and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a professional and relaxing massage.

From the moment I walked in, the service was exceptional. The receptionist was incredibly welcoming, friendly, and professional. She took the time to answer all of my questions about the spa and made me feel comfortable right away. Before the massage, I was asked to complete a short form indicating which areas of my body I wanted the therapist to focus on and whether I had any preferences for the massage. I really appreciated this thoughtful and personalised approach.

The massage therapist was outstanding. She was highly professional, clearly very experienced, and her massage techniques were excellent. She knew exactly how to work on the right pressure points and adjusted the pressure immediately whenever I requested. The entire massage was both relaxing and therapeutic, and I left feeling completely refreshed.

Another lovely touch was being served jasmine tea and delicious snacks both before and after the massage. It really added to the overall experience and made the visit feel even more special.

Overall, this was a five-star experience from beginning to end. The excellent customer service, skilled therapist, and thoughtful attention to detail made this one of the best massage experiences I've had. I'll definitely be returning the next time I'm in the area!
reviewList.author: Shashank Tamgadge

reviewList.text: If you’re visiting Da Nang, run to this place! This is hands down the #1 massage in Da Nang. We had an amazing experience from start to finish. The service is outstanding, the staff are incredibly friendly and professional, and the massage itself was absolutely incredible. 10/10 — every minute was pure relaxation. We will definitely come back. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Шакир Иминов

reviewList.text: It was one of the nicest experience I've ever had! My lovely masseuse was such a professional, the Spa personnel was very warm and welcoming 😊🙏 they even treated me a coconut pudding dessert once after the treatment, and tea with cookies twice: before and after. I will definitely come back, thank you 🩷🌸
reviewList.author: Nia Nova

reviewList.text:
I saw a review from a TikToker named Ducy (“Đu Xi Ưa Đi”) who experienced services at Chua Spa, so I trusted the place and decided to come here. I called in advance to make a reservation before arriving.

When I got to Chua Spa, the receptionist recommended a 90-minute massage package for 420k. I also asked about the sauna services, both dry and steam sauna, and the receptionist told me they had everything, including a herbal foot soak service. However, the receptionists said I would do the massage first and then use the sauna afterward.

I found that a bit strange because I’ve been to many massage places before, and usually customers shower first, then use the steam sauna and herbal foot soak, followed by the dry sauna, and finally the massage. Still, I happily agreed to follow the staff’s instructions.

As for the massage therapist’s skills, I honestly was not very impressed. The staff seemed quite young and inexperienced, so their techniques were not very professional yet.

About 10 minutes into my massage, another guest entered my room with a child around 3–4 years old. The child kept screaming nonstop, so I asked the staff to move me to another room.

After the oil and hot stone massage, I was taken to the steam sauna. The sauna room was very small, nothing like what I had seen in the reviews. I waited a long time, and the steam only started coming out after around 10 minutes. There was also no foot soak basin.

After finishing the steam sauna, I wanted to use the dry sauna as well, but when I asked, the staff told me that the women’s area did not have a dry sauna or a foot soak area. Apparently, only the men’s section had the full facilities.

So why didn’t they tell me that from the beginning? When I looked at the menu, men and women were charged the same price.

I then asked where I was supposed to do the herbal foot soak. The staff awkwardly brought out a basin of water for me in the changing room, where many guests were constantly walking in and out to change clothes and store their belongings. It felt extremely inconvenient and uncomfortable.

I spent money expecting to relax, but the experience was honestly very disappointing.
reviewList.author: Tú Anh Nguyễn

reviewList.text: We came by recommendation our friend and get truly excellent experience! Manager gave perfect service in the beginning, stuff was guiding all process with steam bath carefully and master of massage was the best! I came with pain in my neck and she fixed everything! It was healing! Absolutely recomended! Masters number 18 and 20 are the amazing! And snacks in the end are very healthy and nice! Thanks all team for  everything !
reviewList.author: Анастасия Линькова

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience at Chua Spa Danang. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcome and cared for. The spa is beautiful, clean, and creates a very relaxing atmosphere.

The treatment was professional, and the therapists paid great attention to detail, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout the entire session. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely rejuvenated.

If you are looking for a high-quality spa experience in Da Nang, I highly recommend Chua Spa Da Nang. I will definitely be back on my next visit!
reviewList.author: Yesica Etcheto

reviewList.text: Had a wonderful experience at Chua Spa! The hair wash was super relaxing, and the head massage felt amazing. The staff were very friendly, gentle, and attentive throughout the whole session. My hair felt so clean, soft, and refreshed afterward. Such a lovely place to unwind after a long day. Highly recommend! 💕I’m
reviewList.author: Chenling CUI

reviewList.text:
Extremely disappointed and frustrated with this place. One of the worst service experiences I have had in Da Nang.

We made an online reservation for 3 pax hair wash and 2 pax body massage before coming. When we arrived, the counter told us that the place was fully booked and asked us to wait for around 1 hour. We accepted it because we understood that they were busy, and since we had nowhere else to go, we decided to wait patiently.

However, after waiting for a long time, a large group of customers came in. They had reservations and were immediately taken in for their services.

We continued waiting and thought that our turn would be next. But when it finally came to us, the staff suddenly told us that there was no room available for 3 pax hair wash anymore and that we needed to wait another 2 hours.

This is completely unacceptable. If the shop could not accommodate our booking, they should have informed us from the beginning instead of letting us waste an hour of our time waiting there. The staff showed very poor communication and terrible management of reservations.

What is the point of making an online booking if customers still have to wait and find out later that the service is unavailable? We planned our time based on the reservation, but the shop failed to respect our time.

A good business should know how to manage customers, communicate clearly, and honor reservations. Unfortunately, this place failed in all three areas.

Very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for reliable service. Think twice before coming here

reviewList.text: Had a great experience and affordable . Easy communication via whats app to check availability. Mimi and other staff  were very friendly and accommodating. I had a gel manicure with removal of previous set and repair of 2 nails,  a deluxe pedicure opted for scrub , mask and massage (shoulders and legs) . The amount i paid would of been the cost of one service in the uk, so very pleased with the outcome. They also give you 3 days to come back to repair or fix your nails.
reviewList.author: Jezz R

reviewList.text:
Absolutely Incredible Experience — The Perfect Way to Start My Vietnam Trip! 🇻🇳❤️
After travelling all the way from Australia on a 16-hour flight to Vietnam, I arrived feeling exhausted and really needed some relaxation and pampering. I came here and had a hair wash, manicure, pedicure, foot massage, waxing full leg and arm, facial, brow threading and brow tint — and honestly, I couldn’t have chosen a better place!
From the moment I arrived, the staff were so friendly, welcoming and professional. Every service was done with so much care and attention to detail. The foot massage was absolutely heavenly after such a long flight — I felt all the tiredness disappear! 💆‍♀️✨
And my nails were AMAZING! 💅❤️ Honestly, I think these are the best nails I’ve ever had done. The attention to detail was incredible, and I was genuinely so happy with the final result. My brows were also beautifully shaped and tinted, and my manicure and pedicure were done perfectly.
The whole experience was beautifully relaxing from beginning to end. I walked in exhausted after a 16-hour journey and walked out feeling refreshed, pampered and so happy. 🌸
What impressed me most was how professional, gentle, friendly and attentive everyone was. You can really see that they take pride in their work and care about making their customers happy.
If you’re visiting Vietnam, I highly recommend this place! It’s the perfect place to treat yourself, relax and feel amazing. ❤️
Thank you so much to the entire team for such a wonderful experience. You made my first day in Vietnam extra special! 🇻🇳✨
I will definitely be coming back! 💕

reviewList.text:

reviewList.text:
We visited Jang Mi Spa in Da Nang today, and my friend and I tried their special hair wash package. It included a nourishing hair wash and head massage, neck and shoulder massage, Jade Radiance facial, and a facial mask.

The experience was wonderful! The neck and shoulder massage was especially good, very relaxing, and helped me feel refreshed. I also really enjoyed the facial massage, which was soothing and made the whole experience even more enjoyable. It was such a lovely way to relax and take a break from our busy day.

Overall, we had a great experience and enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and treatments. I would definitely recommend Jang Mi Spa to anyone looking for a relaxing hair wash and facial experience in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Getziyal

reviewList.text:
A Wonderful and Relaxing Spa Experience!

I visited Jang Mi Spa today for a hair wash and facial treatment, and I was really satisfied with the overall experience!

Both treatments were lovely, and the head massage was especially relaxing and comfortable. It was such a soothing experience that allowed me to completely unwind and enjoy the moment.

I truly enjoyed the entire session and left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and well taken care of.

Highly recommended to anyone visiting Da Nang who is looking for a relaxing and enjoyable spa experience! ❤️

Thank you, Jang Mi Spa, for such a wonderful experience!

reviewList.text:
​Absolute perfection! I’ve visited Jang MJ Spa twice since July 15th, and every single experience has been exceptional. The team provides incredible care, genuine warmth, and unmatched attention to detail. Every tension melts away the moment you step through the door.

​If you're in Da Nang and looking for top-tier wellness and restorative massage, this is hands-down the best place in town. Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
As someone who has been to a couple massage locations , this was a perfect recommendation from Google. Despite this being my first massage spot in Da Nang specifically, I don’t believe I would want to visit another spot.

We were greeted by Vy who spoke acceptable english to help navigate their selection. We decided to do a 60 minute foot massage and 30 minute scalp massage! Tuyet was my masseuse, and as someone who likes strong massages that dive into the Knots and parts of the muscle that are tight she did just that instead of skimming over.

I am not a fan of too much elbow which some use, but Tuyet did not do that. She communicated multiple times whether or not I was comfortable. For someone of her stature her hands and ability to use her body to ensure her client gets a massage that will make them sore while being relieved do just the job!

My girlfriend got Nhung who was just as thorough as well!

We will come back :)
reviewList.author: Danh Tran

reviewList.text: We had the hot stone massage and it was so relaxing! We both fell asleep like a baby 😆 staff are very friendly and nice and we even get a mango yogurt cold drink after our session! Definitely worth a visit with such a value price!
reviewList.author: Stefunny Yeung

reviewList.text:
We just walked in randomly and honestly it’s the best massage we’ve had so far.

The hostess was super friendly, and the neck–shoulder–back massage was amazing — strong pressure just how we like it.
They even gave us free yogurt after, which was so good.

Highly recommend!!
reviewList.author: Mina

reviewList.text: Highly recommend! We search for a random massage place during our trip in Danang (we were at a matcha bar in the neighbourhood) and Bliss Spa pops up on the map. With tons of good reviews and a hint of curiosity for “Japanese style massage”, we came to Bliss and OMG they are so good! I personally love atmosphere (very quiet and no mosquito!!) the masseuse told us in advance if they could adjust the force as our preference and hit all the right sore spots. I mean, a one hour in heaven! If you walk around a lot or want to treat yourself during holiday, you should be Blissed!

reviewList.text: I absolutely love this spa! The staff are incredibly attentive, friendly, and polite. Their manners and communication are excellent. Highly recommend! ❤️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Truly First-Class Service!

Having visited Vietnam for years, I can confidently say this is one of the best service experiences I’ve had! From the receptionist to the therapists and every member of the team, everyone is incredibly friendly, thoughtful, attentive, and genuinely caring.

Their hospitality and professionalism are truly first-class, making you feel welcome and comfortable from the moment you walk in. Another big plus is that everyone speaks English very well, making communication effortless!

Definitely a place I’ll return to and highly recommend to my friends. Keep up the amazing work! 😊👏

reviewList.text: The spa area is quiet, elegant and spotlessly clean. The therapist was highly skilled and adjusted the massage pressure perfectly to ease my sore muscles after sightseeing. I would highly recommend this spa to all visitors and will definitely come back on my next visit.

reviewList.text:
An absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish! ✨
The place is exceptionally clean, the massages were amazing, and the service was outstanding from the moment I arrived until the end. I tried the Hot Stone Massage and the Head & Facial Massage, and both were absolutely fantastic.
The hospitality was excellent, with refreshments offered upon arrival and again after the treatment. I also really appreciated the privacy and the availability of a private room for hijabi women, which made the experience even more comfortable and relaxing.
Everything was handled with great care and professionalism. Truly one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had.
I highly recommend this place and would definitely come back again! 🤍✨

reviewList.text: I traveled here from the U.S. and had a 90-minute deep tissue massage today, while my girlfriend had a 90-minute relaxation massage. The therapists were incredibly dedicated. reviewList.text: An absolute hidden gem! For just ₹2,000, we received world-class service that included a deeply relaxing body massage, a refreshing head wash, and a rejuvenating facial. To top it all off, we were treated to fresh yogurt and dragon fruit once the session was complete. Exceptional value and pure indulgence. I can't wait to return! Thank you so much for your hospitality.

reviewList.text:
The massage was amazing.
Also, they were welcome to come here with the kids. While we are taking the message, kids were relaxing with the same room.

This was really helpful since we need to check out the hotel and the flight is 18:40PM.

Also, they gave us the free transfer to the airport.

So we enjoyed the trip of Da Nang until the last minutes :-)
reviewList.author: Tatsuya Toyama

reviewList.text:
​I used this spa on the day I flew back home.
It included transfers from my hotel to the spa, and then from the spa to the airport. Pregnancy massages can often feel a bit lacking, but they really worked out all the tension here.
I fell into a comfortable sleep and woke up feeling completely refreshed and relaxed.
There’s also a Lotte Mart right next door, which was great for some last-minute shopping.
I highly recommend visiting on the final day of your trip!
reviewList.author: Manami

reviewList.text:
This is my family’s go-to massage spa. Every time we visit Da Nang, we always make sure to stop by here. The massage therapists are incredibly skilled, and the techniques are absolutely amazing. Everyone here is so friendly and welcoming, which makes me feel right at home.
The complimentary door to door transportation service also made our family trip so much more convenient. During our vacation, I even booked a massage here every single day
Definitely a place worth experiencing.

reviewList.text:

The spa is wonderful, great ambiance. The reception staff were patient and very helpful.

It was a really good, relaxing experience… highly recommend.

reviewList.text:
This is actually my third time visiting this spa with my wife, and we’ve had a good experience every time. The place is clean, smells nice, and has a really relaxing atmosphere. I especially enjoy the sound of rain in the background, which makes it easy to unwind after a long day.

The staff are friendly and attentive without being pushy, and the massage is consistently good. The pressure feels comfortable, and the therapist knows how to work on the areas that feel tense. It’s become one of our favorite places to relax together. We’ll definitely keep coming back whenever we need some time to recharge!✨
reviewList.author: Lene Rew

reviewList.text:
Really enjoyed my experience at Maha Spa! The staff were super friendly and welcoming, and the place was clean, comfortable, and relaxing.

I tried the massage, facial treatment, and shampoo, and honestly enjoyed all of them. The massage was really relaxing and the pressure was just right. The facial treatment was also really nice and refreshing, and the shampoo was probably one of my favourite parts. Everything felt very well done and not rushed.

The whole experience was really relaxing from start to finish. Definitely worth trying if you’re in Da Nang, and I’d definitely come back again! 😊
reviewList.author: Haidir Ali

reviewList.text: The people of Maha spa are exceptional! They'll feel that you are a queen and all pampered. The massage is sooooo nice and theyll make sure that you like how hard the pressure. I did the 60min. body massage and the 45min. shampoo. After the treatment, I feel so refreshed and my hair feels like it was light and so clean.
reviewList.author: Denise Daley

reviewList.text:
Must-try experience when visiting Da Nang!

I had an incredible time at Maha Spa. The space is absolutely stunning - peaceful, beautifully decorated, and relaxing from the moment you walk through the door. The staff is so warm, welcoming, and enthusiastic!
What I appreciated most was how attentive my therapist was during the massage - they proactively checked in on the pressure throughout the entire session to make sure everything felt just right. Truly a top-notch experience.
Highly recommended!👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviewList.author: Mai Thị Thùy Dung

reviewList.text: Don't have enough photos because I fell asleep as soon as it started😆 My mom and I chose the VIP combo, 1 day before we leave Da Nang. It was just beside the Avora Hotel where we stayed, And it was worth it! The massage was so great, I really fell asleep😆 the price was also great, because you get to have facial, body massage, and hair washed in one session. Even though we picked the 90 mins, it felt like my body pain from the whole 5 day trip was instantly gone. And My hair was so soft and smells good as well. The one who assisted me also checked on me from time to time which I find nice, especially as a tourist. All in all, this one is great! With free snacks as well They have card payment as an option.

reviewList.text: Surprisingly quiet even if it is  along the highway across the Han River. I asked for strong pressure and use of stick for foot massage and my therapist did not disappoint! Great value for money 💕

reviewList.text:
An amazing foot massage at Moon Spa! 🌙

My 60-minute foot massage was absolutely amazing. My therapist, Banh, has the most amazing hands. Skilled, relaxing, and just the right pressure.

The spa is welcoming, quiet, and peaceful. Afterward, they served a lovely plate of fresh mango and coconut crackers with tea, the perfect way to finish.

Highly recommend Moon Spa in Da Nang, and be sure to ask for Banh! 🙏

— Ken, from Oregon, USA 🇺🇸
reviewList.author: Ken

reviewList.text: Not a great massage. Not even a good one. In fairness, my wife reported a really good massage. The therapist I had did not have any talent whatsoever. It was pretty much moving oil around with her hands. The pressure at the beginning before the actual rub began was incredibly intense. My therapist was a bigger woman. I'm a muscular man and I don't know if they assigned me the larger, stronger therapist because of that, but my point is, although I very sturdy, it was a crushing experience. There was no payoff with the rubbing portion of the massage as it was fairly random rubbing around. At one point the therapist moved the massage table with her hands to push it away from the wall and I bit my tongue. I was not expecting a violent travel movement. The chit chat between the therapists was distracting. A random grab of my calf followed by a giggle was plain odd. A third person entered the narrow curtain area at one point and joined in the giggle filled discussion. My wife was also bothered by the conversation and a third person entering the massage area. All in all, I had a bad experience. My wife, much smaller, and less of a massage customer back at home did report liking the experience for the most part. Then again, her expectations may have been a bit lower. I may also add that the experience at a massage facility needs to be a calm entry. There was much chaos and it was loud. We were rushed, or herded, to charis to have our feet washed. So, it did not start off well. There are better places to go.
reviewList.author: gary smothers

reviewList.text: Massage room was clean. Staff were friendly. I wanted hard massage and Han gave the type of massage I wanted. Full body with oil and it was more than what I expected. From Hanoi to Da Nag I have  had  multiple massages but honestly this was the best so far. Thank you
