reviewList.text:
I’m not quite sure why the reviews are that good here, it was definitely a negative experience!

First, I walked into the hotel to look for the spa and the hotel receptionist at the lobby gave me a menu. I was surprised as the menu prices were definitely higher than listed on the website. A little shady for me from the beginning. The only told me to go upstairs to lvl 5 when I showed her the website menu prices, and she realized I had a reservation.

Second, the interior of the spa place looks quite old and a little run down. Still we had a booking and there were good reviews so we went ahead.

The bed was a little stiff and I had a backache after 1 hour. Foot massage I received (90mins) was not the best, lower than average, didn’t really feel rejuvenated after. reviewList.text:
IF YOU’RE SENSITIVE TO NOISE AND ACTUALLY WANT TO FULLY RELAX AND IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE EXPERIENCE, I REALLY WOULDN’T RECOMMEND THIS PLACE.

I chose this spa because of all the great reviews, but unfortunately, my experience was very different.

The massage itself was okay, but the overall environment completely ruined the experience for me.

You can clearly hear music and bass coming from outside, and inside there is almost zero privacy. The massage areas are separated only by curtains, so you can hear people walking around, talking, and everything happening nearby. Honestly, it felt less like a spa and more like getting a massage in someone’s hallway while the whole family is moving around the house. There is also a very noticeable conveyor-belt feeling, with people constantly coming and going, which makes it extremely difficult to switch off and relax.

At some point I even put on my noise-cancelling headphones, and I could still hear everything happening around me.

What surprised me even more was finding out afterwards that they actually have private rooms. Nobody mentioned this when I made the booking, and nobody offered me this option when I arrived either. I really think guests should be informed in advance that there are different room options and simply be asked which one they prefer. Had I known there was a private room available, I obviously would have chosen it.

As compensation, they offered me a 15% discount for my next visit. Personally, I find this a rather strange way to handle a disappointing experience. I’ve had a negative massage experience elsewhere before, and that place offered me a complimentary treatment so I could give them a second chance and potentially leave with a completely different impression.

Here, I’m essentially being asked to come back, spend more money, and hope that the experience is better this time, just with 15% off. I can see how that works well from a business perspective, but as a customer, no thank you. I’ll pass on the discount.

For the price, I genuinely don’t think the experience was worth it. I came here expecting to relax and left regretting that I chose this place.

reviewList.text:

Came back after 2 days to get the combo FULL BODY + FACIAL w/ FREE SHAMPOO.
For me, my brother and my Mom.
Booked on watsapp, I told them the massage was for my Mom's birthday 🎂.

The staff are so nice specially the girls at the reception. They also remembered us from the 1st visit. Definitely made my Mom's day and our vacation memorable.

reviewList.text:
Outstanding Experience – Highly Recommended!

I absolutely loved my experience at NQ Spa in Da Nang! The service was exceptional from start to finish. Every step of the treatment was explained clearly, thoroughly, and professionally, making me feel completely comfortable and well taken care of.

The treatment itself was performed with great care, attention to detail, and professionalism. The results were amazing – my skin feels incredibly soft, fresh, and rejuvenated!

A truly wonderful experience that I would happily repeat anytime. Highly recommended! Thank you so much for the fantastic service!
reviewList.author: Sascha Behrens

reviewList.text: From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed with genuine warmth and attentive service. The facial treatment was a relaxing and rejuvenating experience, delivered with professionalism and care. My skin looked noticeably fresher, brighter, and more radiant afterwards. It was clear that the team takes pride in their work and puts their clients’ comfort first. A wonderful facial spa experience for anyone seeking quality skincare and exceptional hospitality in Vietnam.
reviewList.author: Ivan Rivas

reviewList.text:
Absolutely amazing experience! ❤️ I honestly can’t recommend this place enough!

From the very beginning, the team was incredibly kind, caring, and professional. They carefully examined my skin, listened to my concerns, and recommended the treatments that would work best for me.

What really makes this place special is how much genuine love and care they put into everything they do. They were extremely gentle, attentive, and thoughtful throughout the entire process.

And the care doesn’t stop when you leave the clinic! They kept checking in on me, messaging me between appointments, asking how my skin was doing, and giving me advice. They even invited me back several times to make sure my skin was healing properly and ready for the next treatment.

You can truly feel that they care about you and your results, not just about providing a service.

And the results? I noticed a huge improvement after just ONE treatment, and literally everyone around me noticed it too!

The prices are also incredibly reasonable, especially considering the quality of the treatments and the level of personal attention you receive.

Everything is done with so much care, patience, and attention to detail. I felt genuinely looked after every step of the way.

Such a wonderful experience, beautiful people, and amazing results. Worth every penny! ❤️
reviewList.author: Fia

reviewList.text:
We really enjoyed our visit to NqSpa! We chose the Nano Therapy treatment, which lasted around two hours, and the whole experience was incredibly relaxing and comfortable. The therapist was very polite and attentive, regularly checking that everything was okay and that we felt comfortable.

We were also very impressed by how caring and responsive the staff were. My wife had a bruise, and they immediately offered her some ice to help reduce the pain and discomfort. It was a small gesture, but it really showed how much they care about their guests.

Great service, a pleasant atmosphere, and excellent quality overall. We were very happy with the experience and would definitely recommend NqSpa!
reviewList.author: D K

reviewList.text:
NQ SPA has become our family’s first choice for beauty and skincare treatments. We have had several different treatments here, and every visit has been a wonderful experience. Our most recent treatment was HIFU, and we were very impressed by the professionalism, attention to detail, and care we received throughout the entire procedure.
The team is always warm, welcoming, and attentive. They never rush, explain everything clearly, and make sure you feel comfortable from beginning to end. It’s rare to find a place where you can completely trust both the people and the quality of the treatments.

Thank you for taking such great care of our family. We always look forward to coming back and highly recommend NQ SPA to anyone looking for exceptional service and true professionals.
reviewList.author: Олена Баранова

reviewList.text: Had an absolutely amazing time here! The massage was incredibly relaxing – I actually fell right asleep while getting worked on. To top it all off, we were treated to some really fresh, delicious juice. I've uploaded a picture from our visit, so be sure to check it out! Highly recommend giving this place a try if you're looking for a top-notch experience in Da Nang.

reviewList.text:

I stayed at the hotel thst is connected and got 20% off and a free foot massage which was also lovely. Clean space with nice view and great employees! Highly recommend.

Juices were fresh and delicious. I would absolutely come back to visit again.

reviewList.text:

My technician SUN was incredible, she took good care of me. we had a couples massage and the entire team was kind, professional and great at their service. All of them took amazing care of us!!
It totally worth it.

reviewList.text:

reviewList.text: Had the most incredible 90min hair treatment!! The service is amazing and the staff show real care. The homemade yogurt at the end is a nice touch! The is the perfect thing to do to escape the mid day heat
reviewList.author: Roydon macrae

reviewList.text:
This spa is beautiful with zen vibes and lemon grass aroma therapy. The staffs are professional especially Lisa the front desk staff. It is clean and I throughly enjoy my massage. You do have to tell them where you want to concentrate on the areas you want a stronger pressure. Lisa is super professional. My brother on the other hand said his masseuse didn’t massage his shoulders where he needed the most. He did ask to concentrate on his shoulders but the masseuse said ok ok but never massage his shoulders. He was disappointed for the price he paid. Same with my mom.
But I do recommend this location because it is clean and if you get a good masseuse it’s a worth the high price.
reviewList.author: H Pham

reviewList.text:
Calm and relaxing place, very clean and the massuese was very firm and pleasant. I got the 90 minute massage and 30 minute hair treatment. The price was very reasonable.

I would highly recommend this spa and would consider coming back when I return to Da Nang
reviewList.author: Antonio Villarojo

reviewList.text: My family have been traveling through Vietnam the last few weeks. This is our third massage and definitely our favorite thus far. The staff was friendly and courteous. The space is clean and super cute. The massage was perfectly firm. 10/10 experience, highly recommend and would be back if we can.
reviewList.author: Angie Nguyen

reviewList.text: Had a very memorable experience at Me Spa on our last day in Da Nang. We decided to get the 60 minute shampoo service and it did not disappoint. We had delicious yogurt and tea after. Would do it all over again :)
reviewList.author: Alyssa Patungan

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely worth it!

After trying several massages since arriving in Vietnam, I can honestly say Oani Spa is probably the best and most professional massage I’ve had so far. 💆🏽‍♀️

What impressed me most was how detailed the massage was. The therapist didn’t just go through the motions — she really took her time and worked on every knot and tense spot in my body. It felt like she knew exactly where I needed attention. I walked out feeling so much lighter and relaxed.

The massage bed was spotlessly clean, and the ambience in the room was calm, quiet and very relaxing. Everything felt professional and well thought out.

I’ve had some really good massages during my Vietnam trip, but Oani Spa has definitely set the bar very high. If you’re in Da Nang and looking for a professional, thorough massage, I highly recommend giving this place a try.

I’ll definitely be back! ❤️
reviewList.author: Paula W

reviewList.text: The staff was so welcoming, very easy to communicate with. The ambience was soothing and relaxing, which was so fantastic since there’s multiple spas on every street that are brightly lit and just don’t give a zen vibe. Very clean and aesthetic. But THE TREATMENTS, (I got the shampoo, body scrub, Aroma massage, and facial) were the best I’ve ever had, and I visit spas monthly at the least. I came back the very next day. The ginger tea at the end was so good too. Thank you so much ladies! I will be sending my friends I’m traveling with later tonight! I intend on trying out the nail services while I wait for them.
reviewList.author: Leah Alexander

reviewList.text: I walked in without an appointment around 4pm on a Wednesday. It was busy in the lobby so I expected to be turned away without an appointment, but to my surprise I was sat almost immediately. I have a full-body sunburn so I was only in for a 30 minute scalp scrub. Nu, I hope I am spelling that right, did a fantastic job. Every movement felt intentional and she was sure to ask if pressure/water temp etc. is okay. Nu was very diligent about getting out all of the conditioner off my hair. She also gave me some gentle stretches which was nice since I wasn’t able to have any massage services. I came in with low expectations due to experiencing other spas that I did not like too much, so this was a lovely experience. I would genuinely recommend this place. The atmosphere is nice, the only downside would be that it is one big room for the foot massages, scalp scrubs, and blow drys so it’s not totally “serene” but the service you are getting beats that. It’s also very clean and the hair products feel nice. I hope to return again one day
reviewList.author: Alex Bauernfeind

reviewList.text: My husband and I got some pampering massages here.  The staff were nice and our technicians both had firm touches which was what we wanted. Place is relaxing and all is good except that I have to remind the technicians to keep the blankets on our backs if they are working on our legs.  Especially since we were right below the AC blowing at us at full blast.  So overall we both had a relaxing massage except for the cold air and my husband and I both ended up catching a cold.
reviewList.author: Dr. Mia Hanh Nguyen

reviewList.text:
Our experience at Oani Spa was absolutely outstanding. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with genuine warmth and exceptional hospitality.
The spa is beautifully designed, spotless, and provides a peaceful atmosphere that immediately helps you relax. The therapists were highly professional, skilled, and attentive to every detail, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the entire treatment.
The massage and foot treatment exceeded our expectations, leaving us feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated. The level of service and care was truly first-class.
We highly recommend Oani Spa to anyone visiting Da Nang who is looking for a luxurious and relaxing spa experience. We will definitely be back on our next trip!
reviewList.author: Keyvan Keshtkar

reviewList.text: The full body massage was great, especially if you have sore points lol. All the women stuff were so nice and spoke basic English. We were greeted with tea and then were led to dim-light room where you change into a gow and experience whatever massage you choose. The music was calming and AC helped to relax. Overall, great experience! I'd definitely come back and recommend this place to all interested.
reviewList.author: Kris Luves

reviewList.text:
Very relaxing massage and super accommodating , always checking in with us to see how we were feeling or to adjust the pressure.
Also the tea provided at the end was really good!
reviewList.author: Annie Rahme

reviewList.text:
**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Total bliss and SO close!**
If you're staying at the Four Points by Sheraton, you have to hit up Honey Spa. It’s literally just two blocks away, which was perfect because we didn't want to deal with driving or Ubers after winding down.
We got a massage and it was incredibly relaxing—exactly what we needed to melt away the stress. The therapists were amazing and the whole vibe was just super peaceful.
10/10 recommend if you need a quick, convenient escape. We left feeling like jelly in the best way possible!
reviewList.author: Rommel Diala

reviewList.text: I went with a huge group of friends and they were very accommodating. The staff were so friendly and kind. Great place to get a massage or head-spa service in Da Nang. I got the Shampoo 4 Hands and absolutely loved it.
reviewList.author: hannah nguyen

reviewList.text: Loved our visit to Honey Head Spa! Such a relaxing experience and the staff were lovely and very attentive. They took extra care with my mum after recent dental work, which we really appreciated. We both left feeling so relaxed. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Eliza-Jane Young

places.name: Hai Stylist Đà Nẵng - 43b Nguyễn Thế Lộc - Salon Tóc Đà Nẵng

reviewList.text:
Today was my last day in Vietnam, and I really wanted to end my trip with a little hair transformation after having four different colors in my hair over the past few months.

When I found Hai Stylist on Google, I immediately had a good feeling about the place. I looked through their work and, honestly, I just trusted my gut and knew I wanted to go there. And I’m so glad I did.

From the moment I walked in, the staff were 10/10. They were incredibly kind, welcoming and attentive throughout the whole appointment. They genuinely made me feel so comfortable and taken care of, and I was already so happy with the experience from the very beginning.

They also achieved exactly what I was looking for: getting rid of all the orange and brown tones that had built up in my hair and giving it a completely fresh look. I genuinely feel like I’ve been reborn 😂 My hair looks and feels SO good, and I’m honestly beyond happy with the result.

But what I loved the most was definitely the staff, specially from Tien, An and Khoa. I genuinely don’t have enough words to describe how lovely they were. They were so attentive, patient and sweet throughout the entire process, and you could really tell that they cared about making sure I was happy with the result.

I definitely recommend it 10/10 ⭐️

Whenever I come back to Vietnam, I already know exactly where I’ll be going. 🤍
reviewList.author: Amber Ocampo

reviewList.text: I decided to check this out during my time in Da Nang, and was so happy with the experience and result! I did a full package (wash + trim + colour + treatment) with Tinh and Mai, and they were so sweet and helpful! The shop also gives you snacks and water to munch on so that you’re not hungry during the session! ❤️ Clean interior, and the hairdressers check in on you to make sure you have a comfortable experience too. They also offer some helpful tips to maintain your hair after, and are not pushy when recommending packages! It was my first time going to a salon,thank you for the wonderful time and making it a stress-free time for me :)
reviewList.author: Charmayne Lee

reviewList.text:
I did research for different hair salons before my visit to Da Nang, and I’m so glad I chose to go with Hai Stylist for this experience. I arrived at 8am and my service was done before 11am.

My stylists were Vi and Hoa. I walked in asking for color and cut. After looking at my hair, Vi recommended a keratin treatment because my hair was so dry after years of coloring and bleaching which I didn’t even know I needed. My hair has never felt more soft! And I didn’t know I could restore so much shine back into my hair!! She made sure I was happy with my hair decisions as well before proceeding as I was going from very light/bleached hair to dark.  Vi also walked me through how to treat my hair and maintain the color throughout each step of the process from haircut, coloring, blow drying, washing my hair & styling. I love that they even did a color test and were willing to let me go outside the salon into the natural daylight just to make sure I was happy with the color! This is the most hair education I’ve ever received from a stylist, and she even recommended me some of their hair products and showed me all the prices before committing. My favorite small detail here is that they give you ear covers while getting your hair done!

Vi was so personable, friendly, and really took the time to educate me about the importance of taking care of my hair after leaving Hai Stylist. Vi and Hoa worked on dying, blow drying, curling and styling my hair at the same time and I truly felt so well taken care of. When I shared my gratitude towards the end for making this experience so smooth, Hoa told me too that I deserve this and that really touched me!

This was sucha amazing experience, 10/10 recommend Hai Stylist for your hair treatment needs. I would come back the next I visit Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Jess C

reviewList.text: So much fun getting my hair done here! My wife and I both got our hair cut and washed by Tien. I also got a keratin treatment and bleach. Our hair was styled before we left. I sent them a DM on instagram in English before we got there and was scheduled within the hour. My wife decided while we were there that she also wanted her hair done. We were given waters and taken care of super well. Tien made sure to look at all my reference videos and helped me select a style that would fit best with my face. Vi and Duong bleached my hair with a lot of care and got me to a super bright white that I've never been able to get anywhere else. I speak Vietnamese and English. It was helpful to know Vietnamese, but my wife only speaks English. It helps to have Google Translate if you don't speak any viet. They also do services privately if you need to only be worked on/seen by women. Clean, comfortable, I can't wait to come again next time I'm in Vietnam. Everyone was so nice! My hair before was so long and dry and they made it feel so healthy even after bleach. Lightening hair WILL take a long time if you have black hair like me, be prepared for that. It's typical though to be able to reach such a light color. Beauty is time!
reviewList.author: Diana Nguyen

reviewList.text:
I came all the way from INDIA for my haircut- anf let me tell you this was the BESTT haircut ive ever had!!
My hairstylists vi and tinh, girl power YES! were the most enthusiastic and soooo friendly with me, i loved them so much!  They were the cutest and super nice to me and we were talking all the time through google translate or through basic english words.. totally recommend to get ur haircut here :))

reviewList.text: Fantastic experience at Bee Honey Spa! The massage was incredibly relaxing and helped ease all my muscle tension. I also tried their hair shampoo service, which was absolutely amazing and refreshing. The staff is polite, professional, and very attentive. Highly recommend this place if you are visiting Da Nang!

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful experience at Bee Honey Spa! 🍯✨ The full-body massage was amazing, and the staff were very friendly and professional. The atmosphere was clean, cozy, and relaxing. I felt refreshed and relieved of all my stress after the massage. Excellent service and great value for money. Highly recommend Bee Honey Spa, and I will definitely come back again! 💆‍♀️❤️

Booked thr 4 handsassage thru Klook. The therapists were great. Enjoyed the hot stones back massage the most. Booking an appointment thru whatsapp was easy. Picked yp from the hotel for free, and dropped off at our preferred location after. Gave us snacksbefre and after. Highly recommended!

reviewList.text: Everything was absolutely amazing! I booked a package that included a wonderful massage, pedicure, hair wash, and facial treatment. My skin feels so clean and refreshed! I’m honestly obsessed with this place and wish I could come here every day. Highly recommend!

reviewList.text: Toản is the best hairdresser I’ve EVER had! Everything was done quickly, beautifully💫, and neatly. I am absolutely delighted! This salon was recommended to me, and now I’ll be recommending it to everyone else too 😍 Thank you!!!

reviewList.text:
I am extremely disappointed with this salon. We paid 3,000,000 VND for a keratin hair straightening treatment after being told the results would last 3 to 6 months. Unfortunately, after only two days, my wife’s hair looked even worse than it did before the treatment.

For this price, we expected a professional service and a long-lasting result. Instead, the treatment failed almost immediately. We do not want another treatment because applying strong chemicals again could further damage her hair.

We feel that we paid a very high price for a service that did not deliver what was promised. If you are a tourist considering this salon, I strongly recommend thinking twice before spending your money here. Based on our experience, we cannot recommend this salon.

reviewList.text: Amazing experience at Destiny Spa! The staff were very friendly, professional, and welcoming from the moment I walked in. The massage was relaxing and the service was excellent — they really paid attention to details and made sure I was comfortable throughout. The spa is clean, beautiful, and has a relaxing atmosphere. I also loved the little touches after the treatment. Definitely one of the best spa experiences I had in Da Nang. Highly recommend and will come back again! 🙏✨

reviewList.text: This is the worst massage parlor in all of Vietnam. Do you not feed your masseuses? The massage was completely powerless, and the masseuses were wearing headphones with loud, clear audio. The masseuses were neither focused nor professional. I have no idea how you got a 4.9 rating. reviewList.text: I tried the combo promo, which included a scalp massage, facial, ear cleaning, and a light body massage, plus I added a foot spa. Everything went smoothly since my masseuse seemed like a total expert. I felt really rested, and my hair stayed soft even after washing it. One thing to note, though, is that I had a tiny breakout after the facial, so it’s probably better to ask about the products they use before picking that option. Also, the combo didn't quite feel like a full 60 minutes. While I felt good afterward, the staff seemed a bit on a rush. Overall, still a good experience! 👍🏽

reviewList.text:

The spa is very affordable, and the prices are slightly negotiable. It is conveniently located very close to the beach, making it an ideal place to unwind after a day of sightseeing.

For travelers coming from India, I would strongly recommend this spa for a quality massage experience at a reasonable price. A great place to visit for relaxation and rejuvenation!

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amazing experience! The girls were absolutely lovely, kind and very professional. The treatment went perfectly and I felt really comfortable and well taken care of throughout. 🥰
I’m extremely happy with the service and I highly recommend this spa and massage center to anyone visiting Da Nang. Thank you so much for everything! ❤️
reviewList.author: Abi

reviewList.text:
Such a lovely experience! The hot stone massage was something we hadn’t tried before and it was such a nice, relaxing sensation. The therapist was really attentive throughout and kept checking that I was comfortable. When I asked her to use a little less pressure, she adjusted straight away.

They really took their time on every part of the body and nothing felt rushed. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming, and afterwards they even gave us tea, yoghurt and some little snacks, which was such a nice touch.

Really relaxing experience and we left feeling great. Would definitely recommend!
reviewList.author: Niki Lau

reviewList.text: The best hair salon experience I had. Very good for its price. And all staffs are very friendly and accommodating. Big 👍🏻 and shoutout to my hairstylist Thanh Koi! 🔥🔥You’re the best! I didn’t even have to tell him what hairstyle I want, he just knew! And viola! My dream hairstyle achieved! My boyfriend also loved it! We both loved it! Will definitely come back next time we visit Vietnam. 🇻🇳
reviewList.author: felmarich dagohoy

reviewList.text:
I came to this salon and asked for a balayage on my pre-bleached hair. From the very beginning, my hair artist Quan was understanding, thoughtful and knowledgeable.

Although I was a foreigner, they made efforts to communicate with me and to explain processes to me without being pushy at all.

Through the day they were thoughtful with complimentary snacks and water and even offering to order me food.

Overall I loved the end result! The colour is lovely and a wonderful tone. Although bleached my hair feels light and taken care of with a treatment.

They offered complimentary steaming and aftercare and advice on how to take care of my hair!

A great salon with wonderful staff and services thank you!
reviewList.author: Megan Wan

reviewList.text:
If you have curly hair, DO NOT book an appointment here! I left with my hair looking worse than when I walked in. :(

I went for highlights. They recommended double bleaching my curly hair, which can cause severe damage, breakage and make my curls not to be there anymore. Several hairstylists were present, yet none questioned the procedure. They even gave me a quote! I used to be a hairstylist myself, so I knew the risks, but what if I hadn’t?

When I refused, they pointed to an employee with bleached white, straight hair, saying she had done it without problems. Apparently, they didn’t understand that different hair textures require different care, I had to explain to them that as she has straight hair she could do it.

They offered me to just wash and blow-dry it, I accepted jt which was another mistake. They tangled my hair so badly that I had to ask for a comb to detangle it myself. They were even going to blow-dry it without detangling it first! They then dried my curls as if they were straight hair, leaving me with a frizzy, poorly styled mess.

There’s nothing wrong with admitting you don’t know how to work with curly hair. What’s wrong is pretending you do. I would have much preferred being turned away than having my hair mishandled.

Honestly, I wish I hadn’t gotten anything done here.
reviewList.author: Daniela Barazarte

reviewList.text: I am from the Philippines having my vacation here in Vietnam. The hairstylists at Hana hair salon are very talented and accommodating. I got a haircut, hair treatment and hair color. From black hair to brown hair. It looks classy and elegant. I highly recommend this salon if you are in Da Nang, Vietnam. Plus they have good customer service and are very kind.
reviewList.author: Czara Divina Delos Reyes

reviewList.text: I got a root dye, keratin treatment, and a small trim with Thanh Khoi and a couple of the girls (I didn’t catch their names). The keratin is perfect for keeping my frizzy hair straight in the Vietnam humidity . Everyone was super sweet , and Thanh was really attentive about keeping my hair healthy throughout the whole process. Would definitely recommend ! :)
reviewList.author: R W

reviewList.text:
I had a great experience at Len Spa in Da Nang. The staff were extremely attentive, friendly, and professional from start to finish, which immediately made me feel comfortable and relaxed.

The environment is very clean, calm, and well maintained, with a soothing atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind. I especially enjoyed the hair treatment and shampooing — it was incredibly relaxing, thoughtfully done, and not rushed at all. You can tell the staff really care about the quality of the experience.

Another big plus is the pricing. The services are very reasonably priced for the level of care and attention you receive, making it excellent value compared to similar spas.

Overall, Len Spa is a wonderful place to relax and recharge. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Da Nang and looking for a clean, comfortable spa with genuinely kind service.
reviewList.author: SecondDinner

reviewList.text: The spa is very good and relaxing. Staff is really accommodating and speaks really good English. Very easy to understand as well. My nails were done beautifully too. If you are coming to Da Nang, check their place.
reviewList.author: Renee Mae Baltazar

reviewList.text: Amazing deal with excellent outstanding performance. One of the best and relaxing head spa and massage so far in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Li Ya

reviewList.text: My hair has honestly never been softer! Did a 60 minute shampoo massage with my friend, all the girls were very lovely and took great care of us. Both of us almost fell asleep, and we also got water, crackers and yoghurt! Could recommend it to everyone
reviewList.author: Zora van Dijk

reviewList.text: This was near our hotel so we went by to try the hair wash and a body wash. Both were amazing. I told my MIL who tried the hair wash for the first time and she had the most amazing hour. We were treated to some yoghurt, fresh fruit and water to begin with followed by them soaking your feet before your treatment. It was bliss and we will be back
reviewList.author: Thu Phan

places.name: HAI STYLIST Hair Salon
places.address: 36 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
This was my second day in Da Nang and I was looking for a place that could help touch up my previously done hair. I came in with outgrown hair with mismatched shades. I wanted silver money pieces and I was very pleased when I was met with a whole team as soon I walked in. They were thorough during my consult and communicated very well, answered all my questions and I felt confident that they were going to deliver what was best for me considering the state of my hair.
Long and Tai went above and beyond. They checked in on every step - they asked if I was hungry and offered to call Grab for me; made sure I was ok during the bleaching process and overall made the experience very personable. They were real troopers and stayed at the chair for 6 hours and took real good care of me. Everyone here was really great and I love how much teamwork is involved in providing the best hair outcomes and service for their customers. I highly recommend this salon and I will definitely come back the next time I visit!
reviewList.author: Nancy

reviewList.text:
Local pricing for tourists.
These guys are experts (All guys, 1 girl). They take pride in the work they do. They work as a team. Specialty is Korean curls. Clients are mostly tourists. But the store price is priced for locals, so you get exceptional value. I highly recommend this salon. Just be aware they don't speak much English and use a phone translator. Bring pictures of what you want done for ease of communication.
reviewList.author: ashley khong

reviewList.text: I had the best experience here with my hair highlights Ha and ky did the best job. I love my hair so much. It’s stunning such a good vibe and good service. Every staff take good care of each customers doesn’t feel awkward at all. I would recommend this hair salon and I would go back anytime I come back to Dannang
reviewList.author: Quarantine Sucks

reviewList.text: Tai & Long did an amazing job with my hair! I felt so relaxed and attended too, I had an all over colour and deep conditioning treatment. And 24hours later in the Vietnam humidity it is still so smooth and shiny, it hasn’t frizzed at all!
reviewList.author: Georgia Carter

reviewList.text:
I am so impressed. Tai and Ly looked after me. I contacted the salon through What’s App this morning and made an appointment for later in the day. I’ve just returned to my hotel and my husband said it was the best my hair has ever been.
I showed Tai a photo of the colour and another photo of the highlight colour and the result was super. We used Google Translate to communicate but Ly’s English was also good. They kept checking in on me throughout the appointment and ensured I had water and snacks. Lots of other hairdressers watching and learning. The salon got very busy in the late afternoon but they treated me very well ensuring I wasn’t forgotten.
They look after both men and women - cuts, colour, perm - all styles. All staff friendly and enthusiastic.
I am from Australia and  I go to an upmarket salon in Sydney. When I’m back in Da Nang I will be sure to come back for an appointment.
reviewList.author: Margaret Creagh

attribution.name: Hai Stylist Cơ Sở 2 Salon Tóc Đà Nẵng
Hai Stylist Cơ Sở 2 Salon Tóc Đà Nẵng
Hai Stylist Cơ Sở 2 Salon Tóc Đà Nẵng

reviewList.text:
I came here everyday once also i carefully thought of here might be best worth to get massage in a whole Da nang province.
Course of attitudes of booking manager besides a ttl quality too. Interiors either bath n bedroom seems super clean.
Actually this place is occupied by Koreans but I would strongly recommend for everyone who wants true relax.
reviewList.author: Luke Kim

reviewList.text: One of the best massage I have ever had in my entire life and the hotstone is the highlight of the session!!! Reasonable proce and Must try!!!
reviewList.author: Sonia Chanderan

reviewList.text: The best foot massage I've ever had. Be is my massage therapist—her technique is professional and meticulous. The massage was so relaxing that we extended it from 60 to 90 minutes. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Ada Chen

reviewList.text: A lovely spa space with excellent service and reasonable price. The receptionist and therapist are professional. I had a foot massage and it was truly relaxing! It is newly opened and I can see it will only be more popular!
reviewList.author: Lydia L.

reviewList.text:
This is a great spa and absolutely worth visiting. I’ve found massages can be very hit or miss based on past experience, but this place did not disappoint.

My husband and I had multiple massages at Anna Spa during our stay in Da Nang. It’s well run, clean, and organised. The prices are very reasonable and the therapists are excellent. I had Nga for full body massages several times and requested her again because she was consistently great. My husband saw Linh and was also very happy.

The rooms are private, the music is relaxing, and the whole place smells lovely. The fact that we kept going back says a lot.

An added bonus is the discount for repeat visits. We paid 500,000 VND each for a 2-hour massage (around $29 AUD), which felt like incredible value. We tried a mix of deep tissue and aroma massages with hot stones and both were excellent.

We’ll definitely be back when we return to Da Nang next year.
reviewList.author: mase_al

places.name: Elsa Spa massage Da Nang ( 엘사 스파 )

reviewList.text: The massage bed was way too hard, making it really uncomfortable to lie down. The therapist was totally slacking off; she didn't even ask me to take off my bra for the neck and shoulder massage. On top of that, she rinsed my neck and shoulders with cold water.
reviewList.author: Cindy wang

reviewList.text: I had a fantastic experience at Elsa Spa. The massage was truly relaxing and one of the best I’ve had during my trip. The staff were friendly and professional, and the spa itself was clean and beautifully maintained. Everything exceeded my expectations. If I ever visit Da Nang again, I will definitely come back for a second visit. Highly recommended
reviewList.author: Thảo Vy Trần Ngọc

reviewList.text:
The staff were professional, attentive, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived.
A special thanks to Receptionist Uyen, who was exceptionally welcoming, kind, and professional. She explained everything clearly, helped me choose the right treatment, and made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. Her warm smile and excellent customer service truly stood out.
reviewList.author: Ngọc Thiện Lê

reviewList.text: Had a 30 minute shampoo/head massage, was a great experience. Fresh mango at the end was a nice touch, didn’t feel a rush to leave.
reviewList.author: Jade Verberne

reviewList.text: Was greeted by friendly front desk n cute pupppppyyyyyy aaaaaaaa
reviewList.author: Samantha S
