reviewList.text: Our experience here is so nice and relaxing!❤️ the staff here is very accommodating and kind, their service is excellent ❤️ we will definitely comeback back here❤️.
reviewList.author: SIERRA, ANGELICA

reviewList.text: Loved every bit of the service. I did hair and face spa and it was worth every penny
reviewList.author: mehak bhat

reviewList.text: staff very friendly and kind! good masaage and wonderful experience here 🤍🇻🇳
reviewList.author: Maizatul Akmah binti Aripin

reviewList.text: Oriental service. And great massage with great hands on ear spa
reviewList.author: Nutty Jas

reviewList.text: Exceptional service. Highly recommend & would definitely come back.
reviewList.author: Gary Hitchman

attribution.name: VVIP Supreme Spa 최고의 스파 至尊越式按摩

reviewList.text: Great!!! Such a great hairstylist! They gave me exactly the haircut I wanted, and the price was very affordable. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Phornpassorn Boonchu

reviewList.text: I did my Lkeratin and hair treatment in Traky hair with thuan luan and his team and am very with the service. I’d highly recommend everyone to come for these services
reviewList.author: Anita PrasainRijal

reviewList.text:
The most incredible experience I’ve ever had! Thank you so much. From the moment I came in, 4 staff gave me a seat a snack box cold drinks
- I had a cut and keratin treatment —which was done so so well I don’t have words to describe how gentle and professional the staff were with me. Thanks heaps for transforming my hair from shaggy to model!!
reviewList.author: Ppp

reviewList.text: It was absolutely fantastic! He cut my hair professionally, treated it beautifully, and was incredibly friendly. He even offered us refreshments. It's a shame some people miss out on such a wonderful service.
reviewList.author: Hee Kong

reviewList.text:
I had a very disappointing and unprofessional experience at Trakky Hair Salon. My hair stylist is Trung Phan. I was quoted 2.8M VND for highlights, color, and a cut on my shoulder-length hair. What I actually received was a rushed, uneven all-over color—not highlights. No foils were used at all. Two stylists applied color for about 15–20 minutes, I sat with it for only 5 minutes, and then was taken to rinse. That was somehow considered “highlights.”
While still in the salon, I questioned THREE times why my hair had two completely different color sections—light brown on top and highlighted from mid-length down. I was told there was “no other way” to bring highlights up to the top, which is simply not true based on years of getting my hair highlighted elsewhere.
When I asked them to at least fix the color so it looked consistent, they refused and told me my hair was already “pretty.”
The next day, after multiple people pointed out how uneven my hair looked, I contacted the salon again. Instead of taking responsibility, they wanted to charge me an additional 1.5M VND to fix what they failed to do correctly in the first place.
This isn’t about the money—it’s about lack of professionalism, poor technique, and zero accountability. I will be going elsewhere to fix my hair.
I do not recommend this salon. Stay clear.
reviewList.author: Christine Vo

places.name: Mo Ran Spa
places.address: 88 Trần Bạch Đằng, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: We went here on a weekend without booking but they were full already. Luckily we are able to book for a slot around 1 hour later. We choose the foot massage with hot stone, the masseuse are very attentive and adjust accordingly with the strength. Highly recommended you to come try for yourself too. ☺️☺️☺️ Thank you so much for have us today. We enjoyed so much and consider coming back if I have time during our stay in Da Nang!!
reviewList.author: WY C

reviewList.text: It was a great experience and even better massage. The masseuse were gentle and asked if you are good during the massage. Definitely recommend 10/10 service.
reviewList.author: keisha felix

reviewList.text: the best massage ever! the service was amazing from the very first message when booking all the way until we left the spa. the staff are so kind, welcoming, and helpful. the best massage and the sweetest people! thank you so much, i’ll definitely be back ❤️❤️🫶🏻
reviewList.author: owendoz

reviewList.text:
A truly beautiful and relaxing experience at Mo Ran Spa in Da Nang. ✨

From the moment I arrived, everything felt thoughtfully curated—from the serene and elegant ambiance to the warm hospitality. The massage was exceptional, the facial was wonderfully relaxing, and the hair wash was incredibly soothing.

I especially appreciated the complimentary drink and light snacks, which added such a lovely touch to the overall experience. Everything was beautifully presented, and the atmosphere made it easy to completely unwind.

A refined and memorable spa experience. Definitely a place I would happily return to. 🤍
reviewList.author: Carly Lim

reviewList.text: I was at location 3 today. Really good service and staff speak English better than the counter staff at my grand hotel 😅 Foot massage was good, it covers up to thighs. Hair wash + neck and shoulder massage was excellent, highly recommend. Toilets are clean too, like hotel’s. Very happy experience.
reviewList.author: Yen Leong

reviewList.text:
One of the best aesthetic experiences I’ve had in Da Nang.

I came in for RF microneedling and Botox, and what stood out most was how personalized the treatment felt. The practitioner adjusted the RF depth and settings based on different areas of my face rather than using a one-size-fits-all approach, taking extra care around my under-eye area, nasolabial folds, and areas of concern. The attention to detail was impressive.

The staff were kind, professional, communicative, and patient throughout the entire process. As someone who is nervous around needles, I especially appreciated how accommodating they were and how comfortable they made me feel. Aftercare guide was thoughtful too.

The clinic was clean, well-organized, and never felt rushed. I left feeling confident that I was in experienced hands and genuinely cared for as a client.

If you’re looking for natural-looking results, thoughtful treatment planning, and excellent service in Da Nang, I highly recommend this clinic. I’ll definitely be returning.
reviewList.author: Isabelle Kent

reviewList.text:
My boyfriend and I both had facials and microneedling treatments. I was able to book my treatment through Facebook very easily, the communication was great and friendly.

The location was easy to find and it was very clean and professional. I had a face consultation that was quick and informative!

My aesthetician was Hoa, she took great care of me, making sure nothing was hurting and I felt comfortable throughout my experience. She showed me the needles she was using, and made sure I knew the needles were new from unopened packages, which I appreciated!

Overall I am highly satisfied with my experience, from the easy booking process, professional staff, clean and nice facility, and the results. I would recommend Hieu Dep to anyone looking for a quality treatment.
reviewList.author: Jade Verberne

reviewList.text: Best hydra-facial I’ve had in a long time, and definitely the best extraction treatment ever. My tech, Quynh, was great! She checked in on my comfortability, let me know what she was doing next, and best of all — really took her time with the extractions (which are always simultaneously my favorite and least favorite part of facials….lol iykyk). The extractions were honestly the main reason why I went in so I’m glad Quynh was on my wavelength. I haven’t had a facial since spring, so Quynh was working with my post-summer skin — ‘nuff said. I left feeling well taken care of, and my face looked noticeably hydrated and refreshed afterwards. We got sent home with after-care instructions, and even got a small discount for our facials. The price was totally worth it, and I would 100% return for another facial in the future! Cảm ơn, Hiệu Đẹp!
reviewList.author: Sarah Belle Lin

reviewList.text: I received the facial service with the chemical peal, and laser hair removal. The staff were so kind and told me everything they were doing before they do it. They even gave recommendations for products for my skin type. Great staff, great place, great prices! Highly recommend
reviewList.author: Trinity Lewis-morales

reviewList.text:
My husband and I had microneedling done, and Truc took care of me. We were both satisfied with the service and felt that they did a great job. Our skin felt clean and refreshed afterward, and we recovered within a few days.

I also really appreciated that they followed up with us a few days later to check if we were doing okay. It was a nice touch and showed that they genuinely care about their clients even after the treatment.

The only downside for us was that the procedure took quite a while, and the treatment bed wasn’t the most comfortable for such a long session. Our backs were a little sore from lying down for so long.

Still, it’s a great place. The clinic is pretty clean, and the staff are professional and attentive. If we come back to Da Nang again, we’ll definitely use their services again!
reviewList.author: Kristin Zheng

places.name: Bliss Spa & Shampoo - Hair Wash, Shampoo Danang - Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh

reviewList.text:
They only had the 60 min option on the menu for hair, but they were so nice and let me do 30 for a cheaper price.
My hair wasn’t fully dry when I left but I have really long hair.
It smelled really nice!
They gave us a yoghurt drink at the end which was really delicious. The receptionist talked to us while waiting and was really sweet !!
reviewList.author: Usha Frost

reviewList.text: Today I had an exhausting day and by chance I was walking around here and found this place. I had a massage and shampoo (for the first time). I felt very well taken care of from the beginning (welcomed with tea), through the middle (a great professional washing my hair and massaging my shoulders and arms very well), to the end (mango lassi and impeccably hydrated hair). I highly recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Lau Loretto

reviewList.text: I had hair, neck, and shoulder shampoo massage and its so good. Plus they even gave me a fruit tea and mango yogurt which are cherry on top. Love the experience, will definitely come back here ❤️🤗 thank you Bliss Spa 💕
reviewList.author: Ronaliza Villezar

reviewList.text: Great shampoo massage for one hour. The stuff is welcoming, polite and very professional. At the end they are sending you out with a milk drink.
reviewList.author: Violetta

reviewList.text: We did a 60min shampoo, ear cleaning, and facial that lasted a total of 2 hours. It was a great experience and my ears feel so clean. They gave us a smoothie at the end that was very yummy.
reviewList.author: Jacky Tse

reviewList.text:
I had such a great experience with hairstylists.

I have been here with my mom for hair wash and blow dry.

They gave massage while washing they take good 20 min to wash and after this my hairs so softer and shiny.

The attention to detail, professionalism, and friendly atmosphere made the whole experience even better.You can tell they truly care about their work and their clients.

I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this master! ✨
reviewList.author: suman Kombale

reviewList.text:
Found this cute salon on Google for a cut and color.

I was a little nervous about the language barrier, but the owner speaks English and was able to communicate what I was looking for. That said, the stylist has great intuition and guided me toward something that was realistic and worked beautifully with my hair.

I have pretty unruly hair, but you would never know it after he was done. End product looked like out of a magazine. Didn’t expect it to turn out so well, otherwise would have taken before picture.

I wish I lived here because this would totally  be my regular salon!
reviewList.author: T Lam

reviewList.text: Walked into MPN Hair Studio without an appointment and had a great experience. Leo was able to accommodate me and did an excellent job with my haircut. He took the time to understand what I wanted, paid attention to the details, and made sure everything looked great. The whole experience was smooth, professional, and friendly. I'm really happy with the result and will definitely be back. Highly recommend Leo if you're looking for a great hairstylist!
reviewList.author: Javine C

reviewList.text: Five stars for an exceptional team! I am so impressed by my hairstylist's attention to detail; they carefully monitored my hair throughout the entire bleaching process. Communication was smooth despite the language barrier because the stylist put so much effort into understanding my requests. The final result is absolutely beautiful and exceeded my expectations. Thank you to the wonderful team for the outstanding service! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: Kathy Lai

reviewList.text: Having mid-length men's hair, getting a trim can be tricky at traditional barbers who aren't always great with scissor cuts. I found this salon after a lot of research, and my stylist, Hung, completely exceeded my expectations. He listened to my request and took his time giving me a fantastic cut. The price was very reasonable for the amount of time and attention to detail he gave. I wouldn't hesitate to return in the future!
reviewList.author: D Armstrong

places.name: BODY TRUYỀN THỐNG SPA & MASSAGE ( 전통적인 바디 스파 & 마사지 )

reviewList.text:
Went back for the 2nd with the old folks for a 60mins foot massage.
Interesting technic and different from Thai style.
You first get a herbal foot bathe for a few minutes, they dry your feet and you lie on the chair, with a warm herbal bag nicely placed at the back of your neck. And the staff will asks whether you would like to have a cucumber face mask (we didn’t go for the face mask)
The foot massage begins.
Towards the end of the foot massage, they use hot stones to massage your leg, and hot-pressed with a warm herbal bag and ends of using a warm towel to wipe off any massage oils.
Thereafter, you get a bit of shoulder massage.
reviewList.author: SY Pang (twinkietwinkles)

reviewList.text: Very nice massage.  They don't do body scrub instead hot stone and it was amazing and different experiences. Always nice to try new.  Did a 2 hours body massage,  hot stone and facial.  My wife did the shampoo as she doing the new water spray.  They offered great discount and we return it back in tips.  Recommended
reviewList.author: Tuk Poon

reviewList.text:
I highly recommend this place! Special thanks to Huong - she is a true professional!

Before coming here, I tried 8 different massage places in Da Nang, and this was the only one where I truly enjoyed the experience. Finally, a proper, high-quality massage, not just someone walking on my back.

Thank you, Huong ❤️
reviewList.author: Olga Kuznetsova

reviewList.text: Stopped in for a foot massage. It was incredible. They used hot stones at the end too. Very peaceful and relaxing environment. The mango and tea at the end was a lovely touch.
reviewList.author: Emily Cosic

reviewList.text:
Amazing massage experience! This massage shop is absolutely worth to be recommended.

They give you the full amount of time, this is the 3rd shop we went to, unlike other places that cut your session short (we paid 120 mins, end up only 90 mins service😅) or have the masseuse walking around and wasting time.

Not only the session length is honest, the technique excellent, my package is hot stone Thai massage + shampoo, I really appreciate every step👍👍

They even have a cute little dog you can pet 😀😀
reviewList.author: YIP PY

attribution.name: BODY TRUYỀN THỐNG SPA & MASSAGE ( 전통적인 바디 스파 & 마사지 )
BODY TRUYỀN THỐNG SPA & MASSAGE ( 전통적인 바디 스파 & 마사지 )

places.name: Thera Spa & Massage Da Nang
places.address: 79 Phan Thúc Duyện, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
I had one of the best massages I’ve experienced in Vietnam at Thera Spa.

Hung was absolutely wonderful! Professional, attentive and incredibly skilled. I’ve had several massages during my trip and this was definitely one of the best.

Bean was so warm, friendly and welcoming from the moment we arrived, making us feel comfortable and relaxed right away.

After the massage, we were treated to fresh watermelon and water, which was a lovely touch and the perfect way to finish the experience.

The spa is clean, relaxing, and the service is excellent from start to finish. I highly recommend Thera Spa to anyone visiting Da Nang and looking for a quality massage experience.

Thank you, Hung and Bean, for such a wonderful experience
reviewList.author: Natasha Johnson

reviewList.text: This place is simply amazing. I woke up not being able to lift my left arm up, but when nam: Nhung performed her massage, I feel like a new person now! Pain has gone, and she’s very caring and professional. Simply amazing and highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Anton Piatrou

reviewList.text:
Average, but good enough — 6.5/10
Me and my girl got 90’ body massage — proper Vietnamese technique, but masseuses aren’t experienced. Also they were talking too much. Atmosphere is fine.
reviewList.author: NIKITOS

reviewList.text: Terrible. When I went to get a massage, the boss said there is someone ready to help me, but I ended up having to wait for 15 more minutes for my masseuse to arrive for no reason. Then my masseuse spent the whole time massaging me while playing on his phone. He was basically just there, touching me, with his attention focused on the phone, one hand massaging me while the other held the phone. It was, honestly, the worst massage I’ve ever had.
reviewList.author: Ka Yuen Cheung

reviewList.text:
Here is the best massage in my life.
I got the thailand massage.
It's amazing extremly.
I will visit again two days later.
I recommend noni spa strongly.
reviewList.author: 윤형두

reviewList.text:
If you’re visiting Da Nang and looking for an exceptional massage, look no further than RIN SPA 1. I had an absolutely fantastic experience, and Lan Nguyen was phenomenal!

Her technique, attention to detail, and ability to find the PERFECT pressure made this one of the best massages I’ve ever had. She seemed to know exactly what my body needed, balancing just the right amount of pressure with a level of care and skill that truly stood out. Nothing felt rushed or routine. She genuinely made the experience special.

What impressed me most was how perfectly she adjusted the pressure. It takes real skill to get that balance right, and Lan absolutely nailed it!

My strongest recommendation: book your massage at RIN SPA 1 and ask specifically for Lan Nguyen. If you find a therapist who gets everything just right, you remember their name, and Lan is definitely someone I’ll remember.

Five stars without hesitation. Exceptional service, outstanding technique, and a genuinely memorable experience. I would happily return and recommend Lan to anyone looking for a top-quality massage in Da Nang! 🙌

After the massage I was even treated with watermelon and tea.
reviewList.author: Paul Guzman

reviewList.text: Great experience! I came with a few friends to get a deep foot massage, and it was incredible. After we finished they gave us some snacks, fruit, and Tea. Definitely coming back 🥰
reviewList.author: ivan meneses

reviewList.text:
The foot massage and the service here is top notch!
They're very kind and sweet and welcoming.
I highly recommend this place. As well as their massage was very professional and will listen to you if you want it harder or more gentle.
reviewList.author: Farah Alali

reviewList.text: Deep Foot Massage was great and exactly what we wanted! Everything was very clean and well kept. My & Lien communicated very well with us to make sure everything was perfect. We were given fresh watermelon and warm tea after our service!!
reviewList.author: Mataia Wong

reviewList.text: We had a great foot and back massage for a good price! It was so relaxing. They gave us tea before our massage and watermelon afterwards. Thanks My & Lien!
reviewList.author: Natalie Nakatsui

places.name: Tun Beauty Salon & Spa
places.address: 238 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, An Hải

reviewList.text:
Lovely experience! Even within the last hour of closing they were super friendly and warm to allow us to come in and take care of us, it did not make the experience rushed or any bit different which was super exceptional!!

The place was clean and delightful!

Karen washed my hair and she was so gentle at the same time super firm with her massage. It was definitely a new experience to have my ears washed as my previous hair washes here in Vietnam have not, instead she made the utmost effort to wash delicate and firm.

Meanwhile, both Leon and Duc took care of my blow out and style. From the beginning coming in, there were super sweet to take care of everything and super hospitable. They will make sure you are having a good time and are friendly - even offering great dinner options! My hair has never felt this healthy and clean in a long time! They are great and highly professional, I would recommend to everyone that they are in good hands with the three! Thank you again 🫶
reviewList.author: Erin Hautea

reviewList.text: We had a great experience at Tun Beauty Salon! First they checked out our hair carefully and recommended which treatment we should do. Then Duc, Hiep, and Uyen did a great job at doing the treatment and haircut. They were also all really lovely, kind and caring and brought us snacks. Would definitely recommend!
reviewList.author: Jana Göldi

reviewList.text:
I cannot say enough good things about my experience at Tun Beauty! I have thin, fine hair that easily falls out due to an autoimmune disease, so finding a stylist I can truly trust is incredibly rare.
I originally came in wanting a cut just below my shoulders, but my master stylist, Bao, politely gave me his honest professional advice. Everything he said made complete sense for my hair type. I decided to trust his expertise entirely and gave him full control. I just told him I needed something low-maintenance with natural volume, since I’m a total "wash and go" girl.
Bao absolutely delivered! He gave me the perfect cut that suits me, boosts my hair's volume, and is so easy to style.
Huge shout-out to Hieu and Yen for assisting and making the whole experience so seamless and welcoming. If you have fine or challenging hair, go see Bao—he is a true professional!
reviewList.author: Nga T

reviewList.text:
I had such an amazing experience at TUN Beauty Salon & Spa! ❤️

My hair transformation took around 14 hours, so you can imagine how long and tiring the process was. But what really stood out to me was how incredibly caring and attentive the whole team was throughout the entire day. They would constantly check on my hair, ask if I was still okay, and make sure I was comfortable. They even made sure I never went hungry during the whole process! 🥹❤️

I came to them with a hair color request that another salon had previously declined because they said they couldn’t achieve it without damaging my hair. I honestly wasn’t sure if it would be possible, but the team at TUN took on the challenge and they delivered! They managed to achieve the color I wanted while keeping my hair looking beautiful, healthy, and soft.
What I appreciated most was that they didn’t just focus on the final result. They were very careful with my hair throughout the entire 14-hour process, checking its condition from time to time and making sure everything was still okay before continuing.

The patience, effort, and attention to detail from the entire team really made a difference. You can tell that they genuinely care about both the hair and the person sitting in their chair.
After such a long day, I walked out incredibly happy with my hair. ✨ They turned a color that another salon said they couldn’t do into exactly what I was hoping for — without compromising the health of my hair.

Thank you so much to the entire TUN Beauty Salon & Spa team for taking care of me, keeping me comfortable, feeding me, checking on me, and most importantly, giving me such a beautiful and healthy hair transformation. ❤️ Thank you so much to Hiep and Bao ⭐️ And of course to the assistants, Hieu and Duc ❤️

Definitely a long 14-hour journey, but so worth it! ✨
reviewList.author: Kryssna Kiela Samson

reviewList.text: I had a 35 min wash and massage then blow dry and curl style and the staff were amazing. My head massage is so relaxing I almost fell asleep. The staff were so cute and understood exactly what I wanted and my hair looks so fresh. Thank you Leon and Uyen 🥰 definitely recommend this salon for absolutely any service
reviewList.author: Jess Mazzitelli

reviewList.text:
I had a one hour aroma massage. My first massage experience in Vietnam. It was really great. The facility is really nice, the atmosphere is very calm and relaxing.
The massage was excellent. I am very happy. Really great value and you get a free drink on your way out. The staff were all very nice.
I will definitely come back every time I need a massage 💆‍♂️
reviewList.author: Tyler

reviewList.text: I have two treatments. Body massage and ear cleaning. Very very good. I recommend. Very professional and friendly staff. Also the best coffee 👍🏽
reviewList.author: The spare 77 Clash

reviewList.text: This massage place is super peaceful and relaxing unlike other places along the road. We had nice massage and were offered free drinks afterwards. I like this little touch.
reviewList.author: Liza

reviewList.text: I have had many massages from this venue. Each time they have been extremely relaxing and delightful. Every masseuse very attentive to my needs. Very clean facilities. I couldn't bring myself to try anywhere else whilst I was staying in Danang. The complementary mango smoothy at the end of the treatment was always a delicious. Can't recommend enough. You will not be disappointed.
reviewList.author: Jo Donnelly

reviewList.text: First massage in Da Nang and it didn’t disappoint at all! I highly recommend Hong for body massage (medium pressure) and hair wash. She hit all the right places and seems very experience. Place is very clean and staff were all so helpful. I will definitely return every time I visit Da Nang, Vietnam.
reviewList.author: Diana Huynh

places.name: LaLien Spa -Gội Dưỡng Sinh-Massage body
places.address: Lô 21 An Thượng 34, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: I have found my affordable spa home in Da Nang. The staff is very friendly. I got the 90 minute oil/hot stone massage. My therapist Long is very good. The pressure was medium to firm. The spa is very clean and I love the bamboo steps. I will definitely come back to this friendly, clean and amazing place.
reviewList.author: Frank Ship

reviewList.text:
Service:
- When I visited, everyone I interacted with was friendly, and although they didn’t speak English and I don’t speak Vietnamese, we communicated using Google translator.
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- The massage beds are comfortable.
- Everything is clean.
- During my massage they played some relaxing music.
- When required, to keep you cool, they have air conditioning and fans.
- Rating: 5/5

Service:
- 60 minute full body massage.
- My treatment started off with some fresh fruit and a bottle of water. I then got changed, and a lady washed my feet, then I was taken upstairs to the massage beds, where my full body massage began. Once finished, I was escorted downstairs, where I was given a menu where I could choose a complimentary drink.
- Although I only booked the standard body massage, I’m pleased to say they also used hot stones, which felt great and was very much appreciated.
- A special thank you to my masseuse, Too Ten Xuan a, who was absolutely amazing! Highly recommend!
- Price: 300K
- Rating: 5/5

If you’re looking a great massage at a reasonable price, I highly recommend La Lien Spa.

Overall Rating: 5/5
reviewList.author: Steve Hilton

reviewList.text: This place was great! They treated me well with a great stone massage. Tom was amazing! I was having a sore neck prior to my visit and was feeling better after she gave me a great massage. Great experience overall!
reviewList.author: fakayode oluwaseun

reviewList.text:
This was my very first massage in Da Nang and since there is so many options I did not expect much. Travis from Da Nang Social Club recommended this place for a hair spa/wash and I was like ok, hopefully they do good massage too, let's see🫠

But what I received?!!!😍 45 minutes of an absolute BLISS super strong back massage with hot stones, head massage front/back, my massuse Tha (she is tiny but so strong and knows what she's doing, wow!) exactlty knew what spots to focus on, the pressure was absolutely amazing & strong and as Im writing this review Im here with a free pineapple juice, in a nice calm atmoshphere, and I feel soooo relaxed and my trapese are 100% softer and lighter.

I got so lucky finding Tha as the first massage therapist in Da Nang it feels illegal!🤣

I will only go to her from now on.

So grateful, 5/5, highly recommend!!!! THIS IS IT (and i am a massage pro - even lived in Bali and this was better!)
reviewList.author: Martiny Tomash

reviewList.text: Really enjoyed my massage at Lalien Spa. It was quiet, clean, and the staff were kind without being too much. The massage felt careful, not rushed, and I left feeling much better than when I came in. Simple, calm, and worth trying.
reviewList.author: nguoi trong ca chua

reviewList.text: The place is clean and comfortable, and the staff are professional, friendly, and welcoming. The massage was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep! 🥰 I’m really happy I came here and had such a wonderful experience. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Bee Hui Lew

reviewList.text: Really enjoyed our visit to MEW Spa. The staff were warm and friendly, and both the shampoo and massage were incredibly relaxing. We felt comfortable from the moment we arrived. They also let us leave our luggage there, which was a huge help and made the rest of our day much easier. We really appreciated their kindness and would happily come back next time we’re in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Benjamin

reviewList.text:
It was wonderful experiencing a foot massage after long hours of city exploration and shopping. Totally worth the value of money.
The masseuses were awesome at their job. Will visit again.
reviewList.author: Utsav Shrestha

reviewList.text:
We came across this massage place while having dinner nearby and decided to give it a try after walking around all day. It turned out to be such a pleasant experience. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout the session, making us feel comfortable from start to finish.
We left feeling relaxed and really happy with the service. We'll definitely be coming back again during the rest of our stay. Highly recommended if you're looking to end your day with a relaxing massage and a good night's sleep
reviewList.author: Cassie Lourdes

reviewList.text: This is genuinely the worst massage shop ive been in da nang, ive stayed here for 5 days and i go for massage everyday this is the worst one ive ever had. For a 60min massage session, the lady that was in charge of me was not there for like 15-20mins. So i only got a 40mins massage instade of a full 60mins massage. Secondly, the massage was so inconsistent and it has no flow AT ALL, the massage lady was just doing random stuff. The left and right part of the body massage is just completely unsymmetrical. She was just doing whatever she remember. In the room the light is so strong that it annoys me badly, and they were washing the massage equipment right beside me. Making a lot of noises, and the water droplets even spill on my left shoulder. Also, the room is so hot that it makes me sweat so bad, they dont even want to open the ac, probably just to cut budget. The massage session is so bad that makes me feel so mad and therefore i was here writing this review to remind whoever sees this pls do not enter this massage shop. ITS JUST A COMPLETE WASTE OF MONEY, i payed 350k vnd for a 60 minutes massage on 27/8/2026 around 10pm. WORST MASSAGE EVER!
reviewList.author: Pee You Wei

reviewList.text: The whole experience with this salon was amazing! The owner did a great job . He took his time and handled my hair with care. He styled my hair exactly the way I wanted and did a good job with keratin treatment too. I really liked the results. Very good service and reasonable prices. If you are looking for a hair salon in Danang, don’t hesitate to go to Quốc Được Hair Salon, they won’t let you down. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Uyen Le

reviewList.text: Traveling to Da Nang and wanted to find a hair salon nearby for a quick hair dye and stumbled upon this hair salon near the hotel. My overall experience was pleasant! The owner of the hair salon explained the process thoroughly and I appreciated how he went through the cost to confirm with me beforehand. He made the effort to communicate and gave me a truly personable experience. The owner has many years of experience and you can definitely tell he takes ownership for the quality of his work. His assistants were also amazing and are very friendly. Highly recommend this salon for anyone visiting the area for professional haircuts and hair coloring. I will visit again when I’m traveling to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: l Einna

reviewList.text: I really loved this salon! I came in without a specific haircut in mind—I just wanted to cut off all the damaged ends. The result turned out so cute, and I’m really happy with my new haircut. A huge thank you to hairstylist! ☺️
reviewList.author: Sveta

reviewList.text:
Permanent straightening-
Such a great experience! The staff were kind, knowledgeable, and very efficient—my daughter’s straight perm was done in just 3 hours. The owner was honest and upfront about pricing, which I loved. No wonder this place has such high ratings!
reviewList.author: Julie Pham

reviewList.text: Stopped by for a Keratin treatment and Quoc Duoc took care of my frizzy hair! Loved the results and friendly attitude.
reviewList.author: Cindy Tran

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My wife and I had an amazing experience at Herbal Spa during our visit to Da Nang. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm smiles and exceptional hospitality. The spa is beautiful, spotless, and incredibly peaceful—it immediately helped us relax.

We both chose the Herbal Fusion Oil Journey (Aromatic Anti-Stress Massage), and it was hands down the best massage we’ve ever had. I asked for deep pressure to work on the knots in my back and my extremely tight shoulders, and my therapist was absolutely incredible. She found every area of tension and applied just the right amount of pressure to release years of tightness without ever being uncomfortable. I walked out feeling lighter, looser, and completely pain-free.

My wife also loved her massage and said it was one of the most relaxing treatments she’s ever experienced. The therapists were highly skilled, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the entire session.

The service from start to finish was outstanding, and every detail made us feel like valued guests. If you’re looking for an authentic, professional, and unforgettable spa experience in Da Nang, Herbal Spa is a must-visit. We highly recommend it and will definitely return the next time we’re in Vietnam!
reviewList.author: Keng Ly

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing Dry Deep Bodywork Massage yesterday at Herbal Spa. Honestly, it was the best massage I have ever had.

I was so happy with the entire 90-minute session. Thuan was exceptional. She quickly understood my body aches, muscle tension, and problem areas, then adjusted the pressure perfectly to suit my comfort level. She truly has gifted hands.

The receptionist was also incredibly welcoming and helpful, and the thoughtful treat after the massage was a lovely touch.

I will definitely be coming back during my stay in Vietnam. I’m so glad I discovered this place. Thank you once again for such a wonderful experience. My body feels alive again. All the stiffness and tension are gone, and I feel completely refreshed. ❤️🙂
reviewList.author: Shivika Sharma

reviewList.text:
It’s our sixth visit to Da Nang and every time we searched for good massage, but none was good. Given our previous horrible experience with a lot of massage and spa place, we spent hours looking at reviews of each place hope to find a more reliable one as most of the reviews on google map are not genuine. We were also quite skeptical with this one at first as it also has a huge amount of 5 stars plus many one star reviews.

When we first entered the herbal spa, the receptionist was very polite and friendly, but the 3 out of 4 bottle of sample oil put at the reception lost their flavour. So we could only pick the one we can smell clearly. (Only negative thing I can comment on!)

Afterward we were asked to go to their store across the road which is the boutique one and we were quite worried at first. The boutique one is newer and cleaner. The therapists brought us up and they were very clear about the procedure and checked on us regularly to ensure the massage was comfortable.

The best I want to highlight is their pressure and the accuracy of the places they massage. They really know what they are doing and maintain good suitable pressure throughout without just rubbing your skin which happened in many many spa / massage place in Da Nang.

Both therapists are very professional and give very relaxing massage. That was the first time I have such a good massage in the past few years as well as all my visits to Da Nang.

Highly recommend the Herbal massage boutique.

Lastly the snacks at the end are bonus. The price is exactly the same as what they said during our booking online which I really have to clarify. No additional fee (at least for us). Hope that helps !
reviewList.author: Ric F

reviewList.text: This isn't my first time at this spa, and every visit leaves me super happy! 😊 The staff are really friendly, the therapists are great at what they do, and the massage is amazing. It relaxes both your body and your mind. Today I had therapist Tram 21, and I loved how she worked! Big thanks for taking such good care of your clients and for having such professional therapists!🥰
reviewList.author: Saida N

reviewList.text:
An amazing spa experience! Highly recommend the "Personalized Journey" ✨

I recently tried two massages at Herbal Boutique Spa, and both were fantastic!

The first one was "Shao Hua," using aromatic essential oils with hot herbal stones. It was wonderfully warm and relaxing.

However, the biggest highlight for me was the second one—"Personalized Journey"! The therapist customizes the session based on your daily bodily needs, blending various techniques. I've been to many massage places, but the care and gentleness here are truly unmatched. Their technique is so unique that it completely melts away all your fatigue from the inside out.

In particular, their acupoint precision is unlike ordinary tuina. It feels genuinely comfortable—not from brute force or painful pressure, but from being spot-on and perfectly balanced.

I strongly recommend trying this project. It tailors to your exact needs and helps you unwind completely. I will definitely be back! 💯
reviewList.author: Family Wong

places.name: Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care

reviewList.text:
Spa xinh, nv lễ tân và ktv 5/5.
This was all i ever needed after a sun bathing day.
Coconut body scrub, my skin felt so smooth and soothing after, facility here is clean and nice. Quiet atmosphere, definitely return monthly for this treatment. Bonus, they were so nice to my puppy, I was afraid that no dogs allowed, but my dog is well behaved and well groomed, we got the whole room for ourselves. Not saying that this is applicable for all kinds of dogs. Overall experience, I was supper happy and relaxed 😌
reviewList.author: Chelsea Truong (ADIDAS DANANG)

reviewList.text: Oh my goodness was this the best experience ever!! We were there for 4 hours. It was the perfect way to spend our day as we waited to check into our hotel. The staff were super lovely and incredibly skilled. It was so good - my partner fell asleep on 3 different occasions. We went for the gentle option and it was perfect for a relaxing time.
reviewList.author: Sophie White

reviewList.text:
Non Spa in the An Thuong area of Da Nang was an excellent experience. The location is perfect—right in the heart of the tourist area, making it easy to visit after dinner or a long day at the beach.

The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing. The massage was top-quality, with skilled therapists who knew exactly how to relieve tension and fatigue. I left feeling completely refreshed.

What I really liked was the balance between professionalism and comfort. It felt well-managed and consistent, which is not always easy to find in busy tourist areas.

If you’re staying around An Thuong and looking for a reliable and high-quality massage, this place is definitely worth it. Highly recommended.

Check my profile for Agoda & Klook discount links.
reviewList.author: Travel Maker

reviewList.text:
Visited there three times during my 5-day trip in Da Nang. Massage service is excellent, the power is just right. Me and my husband got a private room. It’s very nice to have hair massage before sleep. And there are different massage packages and combinations for selection.
Can book in advance through whatsapp. Staff respond fast.
Will visit again if I travel to Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Zimmer DA

reviewList.text:
Absolutely incredible experience at Nong Spa! I did the three-hour spa package and genuinely loved every minute of it. The value for money was insane for the quality and amount of treatments included.

David at reception was extremely attentive, warm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived and really made the whole experience feel special. My masseuse, Phuong, was wonderful — so kind, professional, and SO, SO strong! The massage was amazing and exactly the kind of pressure I love.

I left feeling completely relaxed and incredibly well looked after. One of the best-value spa experiences I’ve had. Would absolutely recommend Nong Spa and especially Phuong!
reviewList.author: Ashlee Hurry

attribution.name: Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care
Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care

places.name: Beauty Salon Lộc - Best Hair Salon & Treatment Da Nang
places.address: 222 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, An Hải

reviewList.text: I had a fantastic experience at this salon! The atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing, and the staff are incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive. A special thank you to Du, Sang, Nhi, Ri, Trang, and Vũ for their excellent service, enthusiasm, and kindness. Everyone was so welcoming and made sure I felt comfortable throughout my visit. The team works really well together, and their dedication truly makes a difference. The service was excellent, and I was very happy with the results. I highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for professional hair services and a wonderful experience. Definitely worth five stars, and I will be coming back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: tram ngoc

reviewList.text: I was very pleased with my visit to the salon. Convenient location. Excellent service. They dyed my long hair in 1.5 hours with four people. It was very fast. The color turned out exactly what I wanted, not a hint of red. They evened out the shade well, just a cool dark shade. The stylists are very nice people. I will definitely come back again🤩🤩
reviewList.author: Diana Inami

reviewList.text:
Awesome people doing an amazing job! I originally went in just to get my roots touched up, but I was so impressed with their work and their incredibly reasonable prices that I ended up getting a full color, haircut, and keratin treatment too. They were professional, talented, and genuinely wonderful.
Thank you Khao and the team.
I only wish they were in my hometown so I could enjoy their services every month! Highly recommend them! ❤️
reviewList.author: Mondana Khoddami

reviewList.text: Amazing experience at the Salon on the 3rd of November. I had a total colour change and the colour is incredible, exactly the way I wanted it. The people were so kind and gentle, would definitely recommend this Salon. ❤️
reviewList.author: Rachel Leckie

reviewList.text:
I come every week to get my hair washed & a blow dry. The staff & team are so lovely. The wash is very relaxing. I’ve had over 3 different stylist do my hair at the end & each has been great with making my hair look amazing & fresh. I get compliments on my blow out even the day after. 👍
I enjoy coming here every week.
reviewList.author: June Castelli

attribution.name: Beauty Salon Lộc - Best Hair Salon & Treatment Da Nang
Beauty Salon Lộc - Best Hair Salon & Treatment Da Nang

reviewList.text: I came here for a body massage and got mani and pedi done! Staff are extremely friendly and they seamlessly guide you through the entire process. Wait time is minimal.
reviewList.author: Sylvia Huh

reviewList.text: Nhi is pretty and gets me great nail art!! I love her sophiticated art design. Next time, I will ask for her again . Thank you for your hard work!!!!
reviewList.author: ** Shin

reviewList.text:
Very nice , very professional
I like them so much . Thank you , Ms Nhi
reviewList.author: May Myat Noe Kyin

reviewList.text: Very nice girl. NHI great thank you
reviewList.author: Nasty tea_u Roh

reviewList.text: very good, tam did them I recommend 👍😊
reviewList.author: Mya Miller

reviewList.text:
Amazing Foot Massage Experience at Feeling Spa

I had such a wonderful experience at Feeling Spa! 🌿 The foot massage was absolutely relaxing and exactly what I needed after a long day of exploring. The therapist was professional, attentive, and knew exactly how to relieve the tension and tiredness in my feet.

The atmosphere was clean, peaceful, and comfortable, making it easy to completely relax. The massage was the perfect balance of gentle and firm pressure, and I felt refreshed and energized afterward.

If you’re looking for a great place to relax and treat yourself, I highly recommend Feeling Spa. The service was excellent, the experience was relaxing, and I would definitely come back again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: Nie Ny

reviewList.text: The spa is designed with warm tones, looking very luxurious and clean. What I like the most is that the beds here are comfortable, and the bed sheets and towels smell nice, not musty like other places I've been. Big plus for the cleanliness. ...
reviewList.author: Minh Phan

reviewList.text: A wonderful experience! The spa ambiance was incredibly elegant, filled with the scent of herbs, and deeply relaxing. The staff were enthusiastic, the technicians were highly skilled, and I felt completely at ease after the treatment.
reviewList.author: Dung Thuỳ

reviewList.text:
I had the nicest experience here at Feeling Spa. As someone who doesn't enjoy massages, but is in a relationship with somebody who loves them, I was pleasantly surprised at how relaxed I was during a recent couples massage.

I had a 60min foot massage which is basically a full body massage minus the back. At one point, I even fell asleep. I would highly recommend this place. I left feeling bouncy and invigorated, and was even treated to an ice cold tea and biscuits while I waited for my partner to finish the rest of his 90min Thai massage.

We will definitely be back! Cám ơn! 🥰🥰 xoxo
reviewList.author: Kimberly Tarei

reviewList.text:
Such a wonderful place. The owner is very sweet and the prices are fantastic.

The massage was really great too! I’m a massage junkie and can tell when someone is technically skilled or not - and I was super impressed.

I had the hot stone treatment and my body was fully restored after weeks of having tired muscles.

Support the small places that aren’t on the main strip, they are the hidden gems!
reviewList.author: Andrew Love

reviewList.text: Absolutely lovely experience at Oani Spa in Da Nang after days of sightseeing! The staff speak good English and checked carefully about my tight areas and preferred pressure before starting. After the session, they served fresh fruit and light snacks for me to rest. Such a calm retreat for tired travellers. I’d highly recommend it if you want a peaceful break during your Da Nang trip.
reviewList.author: 吴名仕

reviewList.text: I had the 60-minute Head, Neck & Shoulder massage + a 30mins hair wash. I specifically asked the masseur to focus more on my neck, and she did an excellent job! My neck stiffness felt much better after the session. Definitely a great experience! Highly recommended. 😊 ended the session with a mango smoothie , very refreshing 💛💛💛
reviewList.author: c. chong

reviewList.text:
everything is sooo good! The service is so nice and even will give free drinks after the spa. I ordered the mango smoothie which is the best I think!
And the oil they use smells so nice! They will ask me if I am okay to check my status!
I will be back in the future!
reviewList.author: han

reviewList.text:
Went to 5 different massage parlour this trip in vietnam and we can safely say this is one of the best. From service, professionalism and cleanliness of the place.

They were suppose to close at 11pm but because of us arriving late and requesting for a 180 minutes massage, they still did it. Thank you very much team!

I’ve no complaints at all. They even serve us the greatest mango juice!
reviewList.author: CHAN CHAOXIN

reviewList.text:
When my partner and I travel, our focus is on eating well, going slow, relaxation and rejuvenation. Spas are usually always on the agenda. From Japan to Argentina.. everywhere in between.. we’ve experienced all sorts of treatments and massages and customer service.

We booked Oani for my partners 50th birthday  on the morning of her birthday. Kind of a last minute decision but we were able to book a couple of package treatments.

First, the services were OUTSTANDING. Probably the best massage I’ve ever had. Legit. We’re both jello after 3 hours of treatments ranging from massage to facial to scrub to head wash.

Second, the facility is clean, calm and comfortable.

Third, the staff brought out my partner the sweetest birthday cake! Totally a surprise to both of us!! Reminder, we booked this morning…

Would 10000% return. Run don’t walk.
reviewList.author: Shelley Tassin

places.name: Noah Spa Da Nang 노아스파
places.address: Lô 21 Phạm Văn Đồng, An Hải

reviewList.text: Lesson learned, won't fall for the 'pay in advance including the compulsory tip'. Yes, it is a very clean and quiet place and you can chose your favorite oil.  Yet, the hot stones were hardly hot and merely used, the massage itself was more of rubbing the oil, did not focus on any knots at all. Went straight to another place to have it fixed.
reviewList.author: Leonie

reviewList.text:
I visited Noah Spa, which was conveniently located beside my hotel. With no prior expectations, I opted for their premium stone massage package.  I can confidently say that I had the best massage ever.

During my four-night stay in Danang, I visited Noah Spa on my second night and ended up spending three consecutive nights there.
I wish Noah Spa could expand and open more branches so that more people could experience their exceptional service.

Hats off to the young couple who own the spa for their efforts in providing outstanding service. They deserve to open a training facility to share their expertise.

Special thanks to my therapist, Vuong, and the entire team for their soulful service.
reviewList.author: Aileen Catindig

reviewList.text:
I decided to stop by to see if they could fit me in for a foot massage, and I was accomodated on the spot. The friendly receptionist Jeannie made me feel welcome,and explained all the options for my massage very clearly.  I was also able to add my neck and shoulders to be massaged, as well as my legs and feet. My massage therapist Vuoung was very skillful, and applied just the right pressure to my aching muscles. It was one one of the best massages I've had so far in Da Nang.
The facilities are very calm, quiet, clean, and is surrounded by beautiful Buddhist statues.
In contrast to other spas in Da Nang, I wasn't pressured to immediately write a review as is very common with other big spas here. I appreciated that very much.
Thank you for a wonderful experience today!
reviewList.author: the real JeannieP

reviewList.text: 35 percent off if you pay by card and 40 percent if you pay by cash! They are slightly cheaper than the other spas but i would say the lady who helped me massaged was really good. I feel much relaxed right now! Other spas provide after spa treats/ snacks but they offer only tea, and also a glass of tea before your spa session. The receptionist could speak in English which was amazing! You have to pay before your session (i was pretty surprised about this but it was fine). Overall was very clean too! You’ll have your locker in the room so you’ll feel much safer!
reviewList.author: Deborah Kay

reviewList.text: Beautiful, clean and professional space. Very reasonably priced (40% discount promotion). Friendly staff and exceptional service. Best massage I’ve had in Vietnam so far! Thank you to Hang and the rest of the staff.
reviewList.author: Harry Cure

reviewList.text:
Outstanding job with how the salon processed my hair and took care of me! First time coming here and the salon providers were very professional and friendly. They took turns so it was a lengthy process for the luxury balayage, I spent about 7 hours here; hair wash, wet cut, foils, powdered bleach (my first time experiencing this), toner, final wash, & hair treatment, drying & styling. It’s an extensive process but worth it, usually my hair takes about 4-5 hours. Everyone steps in, which is unique as they are all learning different techniques for different hair types. Products are also vegan, which they informed me of prior to making my appointment. The other thing to note is they like to play music loudly so it’s very energetic! Loved the products & final result 😍 the only disappointment I found after later returning home was that my haircut was not even in the front pieces and I paid for the designer haircut.
200 VND - women’s designer haircut
800 VND - hair treatment
3.4 million VND - balayage color
Total is about $161 USD
reviewList.author: Sierra Brown

reviewList.text:
I had my hair extensions done here for the first time about a 1,5 months  ago, and I was really happy with the result. The quality was excellent, and the extensions lasted perfectly throughout the whole time.

Today I came back to have them removed, and the team did an amazing job. They worked with 6 hands at the same time, so everything was done incredibly fast and professionally.

reviewList.text:
I booked through WhatsApp, and the communication before the appointment seemed smooth. I chose the “Deep Hair Recovery” treatment for 500,000 VND and was clearly told that shampooing and blow-drying were included in the price. I specifically asked whether Olaplex shampoo would be used, and the stylist replied with a thumbs-up, which I understood as confirmation.

The actual “deep recovery” treatment consisted of applying two masks. That was all. There was no explanation of the products, no professional assessment of my hair, and no noticeable difference afterward compared with a basic hair mask I could easily apply at home. For 500,000 VND, the treatment felt extremely underwhelming and not worth the price.

The worst part came when it was time to pay. Despite being told beforehand that shampooing and blow-drying were included, I was suddenly charged an additional 170,000 VND for the Olaplex shampoo. This extra charge was never clearly explained or agreed upon before the service. When I questioned it, the staff simply smiled and continued asking me to pay. I felt misled and taken advantage of.

I also have very long hair, and the handling was careless and rough. My hair was repeatedly pulled and torn while being brushed, and I lost a noticeable amount during the appointment. There was very little patience, gentleness, or concern shown for the condition of my hair.

Friendly smiles do not make up for unclear pricing, unexpected charges, careless treatment, and a service that did not deliver what was promised. I left feeling disappointed and ripped off. I would not return and would not recommend this salon, especially to anyone with long hair.

........

Update: The salon contacted me and explained that the additional charge was due to a misunderstanding. They apologized and offered me a refund for Olaplex hair wash. I appreciate that they reached out and tried to resolve the situation.

reviewList.text:
After weeks of travel and long hours working as digital nomads, we were overdue for a proper reset. We found exactly that at Cassia Spa & Wellness. The moment we walked in, the outside world seemed to disappear. Soft lighting, calming scents, immaculate facilities, and a peaceful atmosphere immediately lived up to their tagline: “Unwind in Elegance.”

We both chose treatments tailored to exactly what we needed. I went all in with the 120-minute Signature Massage, which worked through weeks of travel tension and left me feeling completely renewed. Marie enjoyed the Relax & Release treatment with the hair treatment, followed by the Spirulina Microneedling Full Treatment, leaving her absolutely glowing.

Everything felt thoughtfully designed—from the spotless treatment rooms to the quiet ambiance that encouraged you to completely switch off. The staff were warm, professional, and genuinely caring throughout the experience, and the pricing felt very fair for the quality of service we received.

As full-time travelers with our Sunsets & Speakeasies YouTube channel, we’re constantly moving, filming, editing, and working. It’s easy to forget to slow down. This morning became one of those moments where we intentionally pressed pause. Walking out afterward, we both felt lighter, refreshed, and ready for the next chapter of our journey. Sometimes the best travel memories aren’t the busiest—they’re the moments where you simply take care of yourselves.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and looking for a premium spa experience without premium pricing, Cassia Spa & Wellness is an outstanding choice. Whether you need a deep massage, skincare treatments, or simply a few hours to recharge, this spa delivers on every level.

We’ll happily return the next time we’re in Da Nang.

Highly recommended. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 💆‍♂️🌿💆‍♀️✨

reviewList.text: Came back again, and it didn’t disappoint! And to the lovely owner, thank you again for your warm hospitality. We’ll definitely be back! 😊💆‍♀️✨
reviewList.author: JL

reviewList.text:
Fantastic Experience!
My time at May Healing Spa was such a lovely, calming escape, and their Nourishing Hair Wash 2 treatment absolutely blew me away. Right when I walked in, the staff greeted me with cold herbal tea and cool damp towels to freshen up, such a simple but thoughtful touch that instantly eased any stress I’d brought in with me. The space also has adorable resident cats wandering around, which adds such a warm, cozy vibe you don’t get at regular salons.

Before heading upstairs for my service, they handed me a custom preference sheet to fill out, which I really appreciated. I got to pick exactly how firm I wanted my massage, plus opt into extras like a facial cleanse and gentle ear massage—no awkward mid-treatment adjustments needed, every part of the session tailored to my comfort.

The treatment itself flowed beautifully. It started with a focused neck and shoulder massage that worked out all my built-up upper body tension, following the pressure I’d selected perfectly. After releasing all that tightness, I settled into a cushioned, comfortable recliner for the scalp wash. The therapist took their time massaging and cleansing my scalp thoroughly, with perfectly tempered water and zero rushed movements. The optional face and ear touches made it feel like a full-body relaxation ritual, not just a hair service.

By the end, my scalp felt deeply detoxified and my hair incredibly clean, light and soft from the nourishing products they used. The relaxed, floaty feeling lingered long after I left the spa too. Every detail here feels intentional, from the welcoming refreshments to the personalized consultation and attentive therapists. Between the soothing treatments, sweet kitties and thoughtful guest care, this is easily one of the best head spa experiences I’ve had, and I’ll definitely be coming back again.
reviewList.author: Tim Wong

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Amazing Vietnamese Head Spa & Foot Massage Experience! Highly Recommended!

We had a wonderful and relaxing experience at May Healing Spa during our trip to Da Nang!

We decided to visit for a traditional Vietnamese nourishing hair wash and foot massage, and it turned out to be a lovely way to unwind after several busy days exploring Da Nang and Hoi An.

The Vietnamese head spa was a particularly enjoyable experience. It was refreshing to have our hair washed while enjoying a relaxing treatment, and the whole experience felt like a little escape from the heat and busy streets outside. The combination of hair washing and head relaxation made it a great way to recharge.

The foot massage was another highlight. After spending the past few days walking around tourist attractions, exploring the ancient town and enjoying various activities, it was exactly the kind of relaxation we needed. Having both treatments together made the experience even more enjoyable.

We also appreciated the peaceful and comfortable atmosphere of the spa. It was a nice place to slow down, take a break from sightseeing and simply enjoy some time relaxing together.

One thing we especially liked was being able to experience a more traditional Vietnamese style of wellness treatment rather than just another ordinary massage. It added something different and memorable to our holiday.

Overall, May Healing Spa was a lovely addition to our Da Nang trip. The combination of a nourishing hair wash, relaxing foot massage and comfortable environment made it a very pleasant experience.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and looking for somewhere to relax after a long day of sightseeing, I would definitely recommend giving this place a try, especially the Vietnamese head spa experience!

Thank you, May Healing Spa, for a wonderful experience. We really enjoyed our visit and would happily come back again on our next trip to Da Nang! ❤️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
I’m so glad I found such a wonderful massage place in Da Nang!

There are many massage shops in tourist areas, but only a few offer a truly professional massage. I feel very lucky to have discovered this place.

Since it is tucked away from the main road, I initially wondered whether I had come to the right place. However, as soon as I stepped inside, the charming Japanese-style interior and exceptionally clean space made it feel completely different from an ordinary massage shop.

The therapists knew exactly which pressure points to work on, and their techniques felt highly professional. The male owner has many years of experience in the massage industry, and his professionalism and genuine dedication to his work really impressed me.

One small area for improvement is that the therapists seemed to lose a little focus during the second half of the massage. If they could maintain the same level of care and concentration throughout the entire session, this place would truly be a hidden gem.

I heard they also have a branch in Hoi An, and I honestly regret not visiting it during the four nights we stayed there. This is an excellent-value massage place that I would definitely love to visit again!

Outside, the rain is pouring and the storms are rolling in. But inside Stari, it's a completely different world.

From the moment you walk through the door, you're welcomed with a warm smile, a beautiful cup of tea and the feeling that it's time to slow down.

Today, we treated ourselves to a couples spa experience.

A refreshing shower, a soothing sauna, a beautiful rose-petal bath… and then the most magical massage, tailored to the areas we each wanted to focus on.

And while the storm carried on outside, we were tucked away in our own little bubble of pure bliss.

Sometimes the best thing to do on a rainy day is absolutely nothing. ❤️

Da Nang, Vietnam 🇻🇳

Tôi thực sự rất thích trải nghiệm mát-xa; chúng tôi đã ghé qua phòng xông hơi và hồ bơi, còn phần mát-xa thì thật tuyệt vời. Các nhân viên đều rất xinh đẹp, tốt bụng và dễ mến

An unforgettable wellness experience with my boyfriend 🤍

We visited Renora Wellness Spa together, and honestly, it turned out to be one of the most beautiful and relaxing experiences we’ve had in Da Nang.

From the moment we arrived, we immediately felt that this was much more than an ordinary massage salon. The atmosphere is incredibly peaceful, beautiful and intimate — exactly what you need when you want to escape from the busy city and spend some quality time together.

Going there with my boyfriend made the experience even more special. It was so nice to put our phones away, slow down, relax and simply enjoy being together. Sometimes you don’t need anything complicated — just a beautiful place, a calm atmosphere and someone you love. 🤍

We especially loved the combination of the Onsen, sauna and ice bath. Moving between the warm water, relaxing sauna and refreshing ice bath was such an incredible feeling. It really makes you feel completely refreshed and recharged.

The massage was also wonderful. Everything was very professional, from the beginning until the end. The therapist was attentive and made sure the pressure was comfortable. After the massage, I felt like all the tension had completely disappeared from my body.

I also really appreciated the attention to detail. The place is beautiful, clean and very thoughtfully designed. The staff are kind, welcoming and genuinely attentive, which makes the whole experience feel even more special.

I think Renora is especially perfect for couples. You can come here together, relax, have a wellness day, enjoy the Onsen and sauna, try the ice bath and then simply spend time together without any rush.

For us, it was not just a massage — it was a little escape from everyday life and a beautiful opportunity to reconnect with each other. ❤️

If you are visiting Da Nang with your partner, I would absolutely recommend putting Renora Wellness Spa on your list. It’s the kind of place where you leave feeling relaxed physically, refreshed mentally and simply happy that you came.

Thank you to the whole Renora team for such a wonderful experience. We absolutely loved it and would be very happy to come back again together! ✨🤍 ❤️

reviewList.text:
Our spa experience at Fusion was simply out of this world!
During our 4-day, 3-night stay, we were treated to three complimentary 50-minute massage sessions. Every single session was wonderfully relaxing, and the pressure applied was always spot on.
A special shoutout goes to Ms. Thao on our second day. The treatment was so blissful that I drifted in and out of sleep several times during our combined session! She attentively noticed the stiffness in my neck and shoulders and spent extra time working through the tension in those tight muscles. The temperature of the hot stone massage was also absolutely perfect.
On top of the massages, we joined the 7:00 PM Singing Bowl (Sound Bath) session. Master Phi Phi guided our family through a deeply spiritual and cleansing journey. I could literally feel every drop of water in my body vibrating in harmony with the bowls, bringing an incredible sense of inner peace. When the drum beats softly sounded at the end, it gently brought us back to reality from that weightless, floating state. It was such a priceless experience!
From the massages and spa facilities to the wellness activities, everything made our holiday at Fusion absolutely flawless. It is hands down the ultimate resort choice in Da Nang. We will definitely be back to try out more spa treatments on our next visit!

I searched for quite a long time a place nearby to do gel nails on my hands. I wanted to find the best specialist, because I prefer to keep my nails very short, besides they are quite thin and soft, so it’s always a bit difficult to find a good nail artist.
I contacted the studio per WhatsApp and we made an appointment quickly.
I needed to do a regular polish removal, shorten and polish my nails a little, also add hardener gel and then finally to finish my nails with a gel polish. I sent a picture as an example what I would like to get in the end, but in a different colors. And I got exactly the result I had in my mind! 😻🤌
The place is super cozy and cute and there’s a good background music, too.
The stylist is friendly and speaks English perfectly, so I had no problems in communicating at all.
It‘s also the first studio that uses the gloves while using the UV-lamp! That’s very thoughtful and important.
I’ll definitely come here next time, when I’m in Da Nang again. 🙏💜

UPD.
I also came here with my husband after a few days for a massage with hot stones and shampoo.
The place is quite small, but the massage was really good. I also enjoyed the shampooing, although it’d be good, if the water were warmer. Anyway, the massage felt great.

reviewList.text:
Having seen numerous positive reviews and photos for An Spa & Beauty in Da Nang, I decided to give them a try. Visiting at night, the atmosphere seemed a bit different from what the photos suggested (I've attached some for reference). I chose the gel manicure and pedicure package.

I was happy with the quality of the nail services. They did an excellent job, and my nails look fantastic. I appreciated their color recommendations, which were spot-on for my skin tone.

During the manicure, however, a standard step seemed to be missing. In many salons, hands are soaked in water to soften the cuticles, making them easier to remove and allowing for a more thorough hand scrub. This soaking process was absent during our service. I'm not sure if they were rushed, but it felt like a departure from the norm. Regrettably, my partner experienced a slight cut to their cuticle during the removal process, which caused some pain.

Our total bill came to 1,150,000 Vietnamese Dong (SGD 58ish)

While the nail treatments were good, I believe there's room for improvement in their service procedures and the overall upkeep of the shop.

One of the best skincare experiences I’ve ever had!

From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. The team carefully analyzed our skin and created a personalized 90-minute treatment that included deep cleansing, facial massage, masks, and a relaxing massage for the neck, shoulders, and scalp.

The atmosphere is incredibly calming, with beautiful interiors, soothing music, and outstanding attention to every detail. The staff are professional, caring, and made us feel completely relaxed throughout the entire visit.

Really enjoyed my experience at Skin Bar in Da Nang! I chose this place because they focus specifically on facial treatments and skin care, rather than being a regular spa that just offers a basic facial.

I did the acne treatment package, and I could already see a difference after just one session.

The treatment took around two hours and was super relaxing. I actually fell asleep halfway through. The staff were very gentle and attentive, and the whole experience felt professional without being overpriced.

Definitely recommend Skin Bar if you’re looking for proper skin care and facial treatments in Da Nang, especially if you have specific skin concerns rather than just wanting a quick facial.

reviewList.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Skin Bar in Da Nang. The studio itself is beautiful, stylish, and incredibly welcoming. From the moment I arrived, I felt that everything was designed with comfort and care in mind.
What I loved most was the personalized approach. Before the treatment, my skin was carefully assessed, and the specialist recommended the most suitable facial based on my skin’s condition. I chose the Calming Facial, and it was exactly what my sensitive, dehydrated skin needed.
Another detail that made the experience special was that you’re never just lying there waiting. While the mask and products are working, they treat you to relaxing head, neck, and shoulder massages, which makes the whole appointment feel like a true spa ritual rather than just a facial.
The owner is absolutely lovely, warm, and genuinely passionate about helping clients achieve healthier skin. Every step felt thoughtful and professional.
If you're looking for a facial in Da Nang that combines expertise, relaxation, and a personalized approach, I highly recommend Skin Bar. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and with my skin noticeably calmer and more hydrated.

reviewList.text:
Short version:
I came to Beauty Atelier completely desperate about my hair and not knowing what to do with it anymore. Toku took the time to understand what my hair actually needed and, after only a few weeks, it already looks and feels so much better.

What impressed me most is that he always recommended what was best for my hair, even when that meant fewer services and spending less. I never felt like he was trying to sell me something. I felt genuinely cared for.

This has honestly been the best experience I’ve ever had with a hair salon.

Long Version:
I’ve been to many hair salons in Vietnam, as well as in different countries over the past few years, and I thought I had a pretty good idea of what to expect. Then I decided to try this salon, and it honestly turned out to be the best experience I’ve ever had with a hairdresser.

The first time I contacted them, I was genuinely desperate about my hair. I couldn’t understand what was wrong with it anymore — whether it was damaged, dry, frizzy, or simply reacting badly to something.
I messaged @jfirstdanang on Instagram and they were incredibly kind and responsive from the very beginning. They asked me about my hair history, requested photos, and asked several questions to really understand the situation. My messages were VERY long 😅, but they took the time to read everything and give me what felt like a real consultation, completely free of charge and without trying to sell me anything. They simply suggested that I come to the salon so they could examine my hair properly.

When I arrived, the whole staff was incredibly welcoming and friendly. I was looked after by Stylist Toku, and one thing immediately impressed me: he remembered the entire history of my hair from our messages.

This is not a tiny, empty salon — there are many stations and every time I’ve been there, there have been several other clients. The fact that he had taken the time to remember my situation made me feel genuinely cared for in a way I had never experienced in another salon.

Toku examined my hair carefully, explained what he thought was happening, what we could do, and what he personally recommended. Then he gave me time to think about it. At no point did I feel any pressure to buy a service or treatment.

And this is probably the main reason I trust him so much.

He could easily have sold me a keratin treatment. I would have paid more and immediately gotten what I thought I wanted: smoother, less puffy hair. Instead, he was more concerned about the long-term health of my hair than about selling me the most expensive treatment.

I came back about two weeks later for color and a haircut. Toku remembered me, checked my hair again to see how it had responded to the treatments and products I had been using at home, and once again made his recommendations based on what was best for my hair rather than what would make the salon more money.
My hair had many different shades from previous coloring, so he carefully worked out the right color and processing time to make everything look more even. And when it came to the haircut, he actually advised me not to cut it. He explained that my hair was in good condition and that cutting it now could make the volume and puffiness more difficult for me to manage over the following weeks.

So once again, instead of simply doing another service and charging me for it, he told me I didn’t need it.

I left the salon with beautiful hair for the second time — and somehow spent less than I have at salons where I felt there was much more interest in selling me things.
Most importantly, my hair genuinely feels healthier and looks better. I don’t remember ever being this happy with it.

Thank you so much, Toku, and thank you to the entire Beauty Atelier team for being so kind every single time. You made me feel genuinely listened to, cared for, and special.

I can’t wait to come back. ❤️

I felt very comfortable and satisfied with the spa. On my first visit, the spa didn't immediately recommend an expensive treatment, but rather tailored it to my needs. Everything was very practical; they didn't promise beautiful skin after just a few sessions, so I confidently decided to try it out. What I really appreciated was their after-treatment support. I messaged them with questions and received very thorough guidance; they didn't just stop after the treatment was finished.

After a period of consistent use, my acne significantly reduced, I had fewer new breakouts, and my skin looked brighter and healthier than before. I also understood how to properly care for my skin and no longer tried too many products like I used to.

It's a suitable place for those who want a systematic, thorough skincare routine, without rushing, and who prioritize skin health.

The spa closely monitored and treated me for quite a long time, and now my skin has improved a lot. I see that the pitted scars on my cheeks are fuller and healthier than before. In my personal opinion, the spa is thorough, using natural and gentle methods, so please consider this before getting treatment.

I also want to thank the spa very much because even though the treatment was long, they were still enthusiastic from the beginning until the results were shown. My skin is now healthy, so I feel very confident going to Australia. Absolutely wonderful! 5 stars ⭐️
