reviewList.text:
I've been receiving skin treatments at Duong Thuy Spa for a while and I'm really satisfied, so I wanted to leave this review.

What I liked most was the meticulousness and dedication in their approach. Before each treatment, the skin was thoroughly examined and assessed, clearly explaining the skin's current condition and why a specific treatment plan was needed, instead of giving vague advice or forcing me to do too many services. It was great!

Throughout the treatment process, the owner closely monitored my skin, checking its condition at each visit to make adjustments if necessary. I felt this place prioritized skin restoration first, so the improvement was gradual but quite lasting, not the kind of quick beauty that weakens later.

The spa space was also very clean, private, and followed by appointment, making it quite comfortable, not crowded or requiring long waits. The steps were gentle, careful, and very hygienic.

After a while, my skin had fewer inflamed pimples, a smoother surface, and noticeable improvement in dark spots. The important thing is that I received very detailed instructions on how to care for my skin at home, and there was always someone to support me when I had skin problems.

If anyone is looking for a place to treat acne or skincare that is safe, thorough, and doesn't make exaggerated promises, I think this is a place well worth trying. Absolutely amazing! 5 stars for the spa.

reviewList.text:
This place may be acceptable to locals, but there are some issues here:

1) The guests seeking relaxation services should never be taken to the room upstairs because it is too brightly lit and clinical. That room should only be used for clients seeking more serious treatments from that older male therapist.

2) Some foot soaking buckets need to be repaired, as the wooden studs on the floorboard have fallen off—so the feet are stepping on sharp nails.

3) Body massages should not be performed on hair washing beds—because laying face down forces breathing into the sink of sewage pipe with no opening for airflow. It is nauseating.

4) Clean towels should be placed between the face/bed and body/bed for better hygiene between guests.

5) The feather stick ear tool should not be used inside the guests' ears during hair washes—as it is not properly disinfected between uses. It gave me an ear infection.

6) Water and soap should not be put into the ear canals—since the technicians do not properly know how to dry them. Giving the guests cotton swabs is not enough.

7) The technician should never use their nails to scratch the scalp during hair washes—it damages hair follicles that increases hair fall and oil production.

8) Some guests don't use indoor speaking voices—so the relaxation aspects are gone.

9) The service menu needs to be printed with the current pricing. They cannot raise and change the price on the customer at the cash register.

This is a difficult review to leave as Hana Spa employs cute staff. But until their standards and practices improve, it will be difficult for them to make loyal customers who know about quality spa services.
reviewList.author: Rosie C.

reviewList.text:
I had the most wonderful experience at Hana. Everyone was incredibly kind, friendly, and welcoming. Even though we spoke different languages, I could truly feel their sincerity and warmth.

I came back for the second time before returning to Thailand because I wanted to say goodbye and thank them. It wasn’t just a hair wash—it became one of my favorite memories in Da Nang.

Thank you for making me feel like a family, not just a customer. I will never forget your kindness, and I hope to see you again someday. ❤️🇻🇳🇹🇭

reviewList.text: The service was good, but... I've been to other spas for acne extraction, and compared to here, I found the technique not very good. Other places were gentle, but here it was extremely painful. At that moment, I thought, "Oh my God, I don't know what's going to happen to my face," but it turned out really badly. It was very swollen and bleeding. I knew it would be swollen for a long time. Before, when I had acne extracted, the swelling only lasted a maximum of 3 days and then went back to normal, not that much bleeding. Here, it took a week, and now it's almost a month and the acne scars haven't gone away. And I know for sure they won't go away. My skin doesn't usually get acne scars. But because of the technique, you pressed too hard, and now my face has dark spots. Of course, after the extraction, I took very good care of my skin because I work from home and don't go out during the day. Seeing those dark spots on my face after almost a month with no sign of fading is really upsetting because I've always taken such good care of my skin. I hope you can review your technique.

Thanks to everyone who shared their experiences on Google about this little spa, I was able to experience it myself and had the most amazing time last night.

I walked in earlier in the day and was informed they were completely booked for hours so I exchanged Facebook info with the lovely young lady there and came back later that evening for a shampoo and face wash.

What they advertise as a "face wash" is so much more than that. It came with a relaxing scalp, neck, and decolletage massage, as well as an exfoliating treatment that was made in-house and had the loveliest scent of roasted rice grain.

Earlier in the week, I had an allergic reaction to a Korean face cleanser that left my skin with bumps all over, so I was very nervous last night, but my skin is bump free and even smoother than what I came in with yesterday, so I'm glad to say my fears were unfounded.

The shampoo was so soothing that I actually fell asleep, which has never happened before bc my experiences elsewhere have been mildly painful. I am so glad I'll be in the area for a few more weeks because I'll definitely be coming back every other day now and will try their other services while I'm at it.

Thank you so much Mee Spa for a lovely evening!

The spa itself is beautifully designed, clean, peaceful, and has a very welcoming atmosphere. The little details, presentation, flowers, refreshments, and overall service really made the experience feel special.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After a long flight from the USA, my wife and I treated ourselves to the Babylon Premium Package, and it was hands down the best spa experience we’ve ever had.

From the moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us with genuine warmth and exceptional hospitality. The spa is beautifully designed and incredibly peaceful—exactly what we needed to recover from jet lag and start our vacation in Da Nang.

Our therapists were outstanding. They checked in throughout the massage to make sure the pressure was perfect and provided one of the most relaxing and therapeutic massages we’ve ever experienced. Every part of the four-hour premium package was thoughtfully planned, unhurried, and delivered with incredible attention to detail.

What truly sets Babylon Spa apart is the outstanding customer service. Every member of the team went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and cared for. You can tell they genuinely take pride in creating a world-class experience.

If you’re visiting Da Nang—especially after a long international flight—do yourself a favor and book the Babylon Premium Package. It was worth every penny, one of the highlights of our trip, and an experience we’ll absolutely return for on our next visit to Vietnam.

reviewList.text:
We had a really lovely experience here from start to finish.

As soon as you arrive, you’re given spa slippers and welcomed by one or two very friendly staff members who bring you the treatment menu. There’s no pressure at all, so you can take your time choosing what you would like. It’s also worth checking for their Happy Hour offers, as they sometimes have 20% discount.

While you’re deciding, you receive a refreshing flavored water. Before the treatment, you fill in a short form where you can mention any pain, sensitive areas, or parts of the body you would prefer them not to massage. You can also choose between three different massage oils.

After that, you’re taken to the treatment room and given special satin underwear to change into. Women also receive a top. The treatment starts with a relaxing warm foot bath before the actual massage begins.

The massage itself was excellent professional, relaxing and very well done. The massage therapists don’t speak much English, but this wasn’t a problem at all. A member of the reception staff regularly checks in during the treatment to make sure everything is comfortable, so you can easily ask for more or less pressure if needed.

Payment is made before the treatment, which makes everything very easy afterwards. When you come back downstairs, you’re served another drink together with watermelon and a small biscuit, which is a really nice finishing touch.

Overall, the whole experience feels organised, clean, thoughtful and welcoming. The staff are extremely friendly and they clearly pay attention to the little details. We would definitely recommend this spa if you’re looking for a good massage in Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
Le Venin Spa was a disappointing experience overall, with an acceptable but flawed body massage followed by a genuinely uncomfortable and unprofessional hair spa.
Overall rating
•	was 3 star after the body massage, 1 star after the hair spa
•	Programme tried: 90‑minute body massage + 40‑minute shampooing hair spa.
Body massage
•	The spa asked me to fill in a preference sheet, but key requests were ignored: I selected lavender oil yet smelled strongly of coconut oil, and I ticked “no neck massage” but still received neck work.
•	Pressure was far below medium, many areas were missed (arms and thighs were barely touched), and the therapist often failed to locate or work on actual tension points, which suggests poor training and low effort.
Strange massage techniques
•	The therapist repeatedly tapped and rubbed my toes in a way that felt more like someone trying to start a fire with a stick than a relaxing treatment, and this happened three times despite my growing discomfort—comfort for her as she could use the least amount of effort to pass the time.
•	Having visited many massage places, this was an unprecedented and unpleasant technique that pulled me out of any chance of relaxation.
Hair spa and scalp treatment
•	The hair spa was the worst part: my scalp was scratched with nails continuously for about 15 minutes as if that was the main “massage,” leaving my scalp feeling hurt rather than relaxed.
•	Conditioner was then used as the main lubricant to massage the scalp, which felt odd, unprofessional, and not at all like a proper head massage.
Environment and professionalism
•	During the shampooing, another staff member opened the treatment room door and started chatting with my therapist while noises from outside kept coming in, breaking any sense of privacy or calm.
•	With so many more professional, and truly relaxing massage places in Da Nang, this visit gave no reason to choose Le Venin Spa again.
(VND 500K for 90-minute body massage; VND150K for 40-minute shampooing w/massage)

My hair was washed really well and I got a lovely head massage at the same time. The head scratches were probably my favourite part, they felt so good. The whole 30 minutes was really relaxing and I left feeling completely refreshed.

Pam was the one who did my treatment and she was so lovely. She was sweet, attentive and just made the whole experience really enjoyable.

Such a good experience from start to finish. Definitely one of the best hair washes I’ve had, and I’ll be coming back for sure.

reviewList.text: My girlfriend and I had an amazing massage here today, surely the best we've ever had. The massage room was incredibly comfortable, and the air with inceresed oxygen felt so good that we feelt relaxed from the first minutes. The therapists were kind, attentive, and skillfull. We walked out feeling deeply relaxed, refreshed, and already looking forward to our next visit.

reviewList.text: Good service make me feel relax l love love love😘😘😘 from thailand

reviewList.text:
It is not the first time I come to that place. The staff is polite and I always lucky to come when there is no queue.

I take traditional massage. And it satisfies me every time.

And also they offer yummy jelly sticks :)
reviewList.author: Alexander Tarasovskiy

reviewList.text: Minluxury Spa is good. I experienced a pleasant spa in Da Nang. My friend is getting her nails done, so I had about an hour left, so it wasn't that far from the Han market, but I happened to see a Minluxury Spa while walking. I went to a Minluxury Spa because I thought I could get a pedicure because I didn't have much money in Vietnam. As expected, I had about 30 minutes for my pedicure. So I asked if I could get an oil massage, but when I saw that I didn't have enough money to get an oil massage, the manager of Minluxury Spa said he would do it for 60 minutes. If you go to Minluxury Spa, you can see Nam Hee-seok's picture and there are a lot of pictures. They are clean and not like a local massage shop. The price is good. I just went to Bana Hill, so I took a shower before I got a massage because I was sweating. The manager gave me a very meticulous massage. In particular, I could choose oil, but I chose jasmine and put something on my nose, but my nose was crooked. It was great. I should go again tomorrow. Da Nang Minlux Spa is highly recommended. It was good enough to go again tomorrow.
reviewList.author: 정현석

reviewList.text:
I tried this place because of the good rating but was disappointed by the experience.

After selecting a treatment and paying, the lady at the counter left us there with some water but never told us how long the wait for our massage would be. We sat there expecting to start soon but only when we clarified did she say that the massage would start in another 3 minutes (probably took longer than that). The wait wasn't the issue. I just wish she told us what to expect because we didn't have a lot of time which is why we opted for a shorter session.

The quality of the massage was below average. I selected a Thai massage but it did not feel satisfying. It's also really strange because they started off with asking us to soak our feet in tepid water. I didn't dare to ask, but I hope the water and tub were clean.

All I could say about the massage is that it did not injure me, but it also didn't release much tension in my shoulders or back. They also used a lot of vix for some weird reason.

One strange thing I realised about massage places in Danang is that they don't have hooks for you to hang up your clothes. You're expected to place all your belongings including your sweaty clothes into a box. I really wish I had the option to hang up my clothes.

The results was everything I wanted and the service was great. Vu, the owner did an amazing work on me and my kids. Looking for a place that knows what they’re doing, check this place out!
reviewList.author: KELLY LE

reviewList.text:
My wife came here as a walk in and got her hair trimmed.

Tri Hoang Vu Hair Salon is designed to be modern, tidy, and comfortable. The staff are friendly, enthusiastic, and always attentive to the customer experience. They make you feel comfortable and well cared for when they come here, even during peak hours.

Very reasonable prices and great customer service.
reviewList.author: Cebu Food Critic

reviewList.text:
I cannot give a high rating due to severe internal communication failures and unexpected extra charges. I messaged this salon on Instagram prior to booking, explicitly explaining that in past my bleached hair is fragile and stating: "I am not interested in keratin." They agreed and quoted me 1,300,000 VND for a B3 Bond Repair treatment. I also specifically asked if this price included a wash and blowout, and they wrote back: "The course of treatment includes rapid washing and dry blowing." However, once I arrived and sat in the chair, everything changed:They said I need to pay extra  for a separate hair wash, and I need to choose what hair wash I want basic , organic etc - directly contradicting their explicit written confirmation that washing was included in the price. At the end of the treatment, the stylist brought out a flat iron and showed me a translation on her phone saying they needed to use high heat to "seal in the keratin that was just applied." I had to firmly refuse and stop them myself to protect my hair. So it means they put keratin (they used face-mask) when I clearly mentioned in Instagram messages I don't want keratin. While the actual application was quick, some steps of treatment were made in 4 hands, the lack of transparency, hidden fees, and failure to communicate a customer's strict boundaries to the floor staff made this a highly stressful experience.
I do not recommend booking here if you expect a salon to honor its written text quotes or respect your specific hair boundaries.
reviewList.author: Anastasiia

reviewList.text: I have gotten my hair washed and styled here many times by My, she always does an excellent job and is so sweet! Last time I was there I also decided to get keratherpy treatment as my hair has experienced a bit of a climate shock since coming from canada where it is cold and dry. The therapy was everything I needed and more! I came in with dry and brittle hair and left with butter soft hair! Hung and My did such a great job, i highly recommend them and the salon in general!❤️ Prices are very reasonable and i’ve been always able to just walk in and get served immediately!
reviewList.author: katarina vincent

reviewList.text: Nv Mymeo did a great job washing my hair. I got the organic shampoo option. It was about 35 minutes and it came with a head, neck and shoulder massage. They blow dry your hair after as well. Prices are average for the area, starting at 150k. I highly recommend. :)
reviewList.author: Michelle Nguyen

reviewList.text: Had a great experience at Charm Spa! I availed their combo package with a full body massage and hair wash, and both were excellent. The massage was relaxing, the hair wash was so refreshing, and the staff were friendly and professional throughout. The spa was clean, peaceful, and a perfect place to unwind after exploring the city. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Cathy Rine

reviewList.text: I love this place! The staff, the service, the atmosphere, and prices for the packages are impeccable. If you get a therapist that you enjoy, ask for their name. By far my favorite is Ly (Lee) she focused on all that I asked. She worked out my lower back like I asked and fixed my ankle that was messed up from a trampoline accident. She noticed that on her own. Afterwards, they served watermelon, tea, and yogurt. That was delicious. All around 10/10
reviewList.author: Ken Pham

reviewList.text:
I had a deep tissue massage with V. She was amazing, very strong hands, just what I needed to get rid off some tension.
The place is very calm and make you feel relaxed from the time you step in. After your massage is finished, they will give you some tea, fruit and amazing home made yoghurt.
reviewList.author: Jerson Vargas

reviewList.text: Hi 👋, today I went to this massage center and had the 1 hour stone massage. Let's start with the environment, I must say that as soon as you enter you feel the relaxing, positive, silent atmosphere and the thoughtful girls immediately bring you tea ☕️, then the interior is set up very wooden so it also gives you the feeling of nature and Even the lamps have a great design and the lighting is adequate for a massage center. Let's move on to the massage 💆 which lasted 1 hour in a quiet room with two other beds but at that moment it was just me and my friend, it was the first time I tried the stone massage and I must say that I liked it and it was so relaxing and well executed that I fell asleep, only woke up when the girl asked to turn me over. The good, silent and professional masseuse. At the end of the massage the girls took us to a relaxation room where they offered us tea and fruit. Essential question in this massage center would I go back again or would I recommend it to some of my friends...certainly YES, I would recommend it and I'm sure that whoever goes there will thank me! See you soon 👋
reviewList.author: Roby Rosso

reviewList.text:
Let me start by saying I was originally going to leave 1 star. When I first came in (after lots of research and reading reviews) I decided to get a shampoo and facial. Unfortunately, my masseuse at that time was not very good. I had asked for fingertips, but got nails. I constantly had to ask for more pressure, even using translation app multiple times, but it was always lacking. She also got shampoo inside my ear drums and on my eyes.

Anyways, when I had told the front desk of my experience, I was given a 20% discount, along with a voucher for a free service of any kind (this was unexpected).

I went back the next day for a deep tissue massage, and I was very relaxed - almost fell asleep! I forgot to get her name, but she was very good. I have lots of knots and whenever it felt like things were starting to get too much, she instinctively swapped to other parts of the body without me ever having to mention anything.

I think as long as you ask for someone with experience and a good track record, you'll enjoy your experience here :)
reviewList.author: Newton Lam

reviewList.text: 100% recommend. I paid 200k for 45mins of food massage, felt so good. In the end she also massaged my back for a while. Before I left, they gave me mangos. Good service good price 🙏🏼
reviewList.author: ayowutudu

reviewList.text: With so many great reviews, I was worried they may be incentivized—but. they’re all genuine. I was surprised by the quality of the massage for such a reasonable price. They give you tea before and after your massage and some mango after. There is also a discount for return customers, which I definitely plan to take advantage of!
reviewList.author: Sophie Clesi

reviewList.text:
We stayed in Da Nang for four days and I had three four hand massages at Juno Spa. It would have been four, but unfortunately I was unwell on our final day.

From the outside, Juno is small and does not look like much, but do not let that put you off. The staff are kind, caring, attentive and genuinely focused on giving you a good massage.

At times they call in additional staff, but the quality never dropped. Every massage was structured, well sequenced and consistent. They regularly checked the pressure and comfort, and I never left feeling that the sore or tight areas had been missed.

They offer a 10% discount if you return, which is a nice incentive, but that is not why I kept coming back. I returned because the massages were genuinely excellent.

Most importantly, it was not just one good masseuse. Every therapist I had was skilled, attentive and clearly knew what they were doing.

Small establishment, great people, excellent massage and very good value. Three visits in four days probably says everything.
reviewList.author: Brent Meinberg

reviewList.text: Very clean, relaxing atmosphere, and excellent massage quality. Professional service and great attention to detail.
reviewList.author: Gunkgink Diary

reviewList.text: Had a body massage at Juno spa and it was really great. Staff were so kind and even served me tea and sweet mango after. It was 01 Hang who did my massage and she did a fantastic job. I feel more relaxed and comfortable. You will get 10% discount for your next appointment.

Highly recommended! We would definitely come back on our next visit to Da Nang. ❤️

reviewList.text:

The spa atmosphere was clean, peaceful, and very comfortable. The staff were friendly and always checked to make sure I felt comfortable during the session. I also really enjoyed the foot soaking before the massage.

If you are looking for a place to relax during your trip to Da Nang, I highly recommend trying the foot massage at L Cool Spa.

reviewList.text: Went to highly raved spas in danang for hair washing services but was rejected due to unavailability. Found this place on tiktok that does herbal shampoo services and was fortunate they had availability. This place is on the quieter alley , and can be blocked by the surrounding shop's plants, so be sure to use google map to navigate. Tried the 11 step signature herbal shampoo-ing + neck and shoulder wash. IT DID NOT DISAPPOINT! Its so relaxing, scrubs and scrubs and massage. This is my first head spa in vietnam and im so happy i came here. The lady who serviced me was nice, asking time to time if the scratching was ok. I almost slept! They are super generous wih their freebies and drinks... love the hospitality.... but make sure to make a reservation, as i believe the shop is quite small. The price is affordable too, paid 900,000 dong for 2 pax. Here are some pictures during my time at this place! Highly recommend 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

reviewList.text: Initially I had a 1 hour massage but felt so good that I extended for another half an hour. The masseuse worked tirelessly to work on my painful thigh. reviewList.text: It was a nice experience. The salon is open until late. I took the procedure of hair washing with massage. I asked not to touch one part of my face, I have after surgery. reviewList.text:

reviewList.text:
Our family of four had a wonderful experience today at Rosa Spa Da Nang! We all got the full body treatment, including the head, legs, feet, and shoulder massage, and every single one of us left feeling completely relaxed.
​What really stood out to us was how incredibly accommodating and helpful the staff were with our son, who is in a wheelchair. They made sure he was perfectly comfortable and went above and beyond to ensure he had a great experience.
​A special shoutout to Lant, who gave me my massage she was so nice, professional, and provided excellent service!
​If you are looking for a high-quality massage with fantastic, caring service in Da Nang, this is the place to go. We will definitely be back!

reviewList.text: Honestly surprised this place has such a high rating, was expecting it to at least come close to a 4 star but wasn’t even close to this. Front reception was nice enough, had some tea but from there it seemed to have all gone downhill .. we were brought into the massage room and told to change into the gown together in that room. The lights stayed on throughout the treatment and all I could hear was noise from outside. All I kept thinking about was how we made a mistake coming here. The treatment itself was below average , not a good massage, not a good wash, felt my hair being pulled the entire time and you can tell the girls just did not want to be there. All that for 500,000. Had much better services at other places for a better price , save yourself the money and time !!

reviewList.text:
A brand new opened SPA shop with luxurious decor and modern facilities. I decided to give it a try, Now they’re offering discount.
They do pay attention to details that others don’t, like disinfecting the slippers before you wear and placing a cotton pad over the massage bed. The massage and hair wash were both excellent.
To my surprise, they even served chicken soup, cashews, and tea afterward.
All I can say is, there’s no second SPA shop like this in Da Nang—it’s truly worth it!👍

reviewList.text: Our massage and shampoo was terrible. We could hear everyone speaking, the overhead lights were on and it was very rushed. We didn’t relax at all and felt as though we were a burden to be there. The product had such a strong scent and didn’t feel nice on the skin. They used the shampoo from our head as massage oil for our shoulders and neck. In my opinion, it’s a tourist trap. We’ve had much better elsewhere for cheaper in Vietnam.

The spa itself was clean, peaceful, and the staff were all very welcoming. Highly recommend if you’re looking to unwind!

reviewList.text: Since we had some time to kill before checking into our hotel in the afternoon, we decided to explore Da Nang Beach and grab some breakfast. Afterward, we stopped by Sand Spa for a massage, and it was absolutely the best decision we could have made! We truly loved this place. The experience was fantastic, and it was the perfect way to relax and pass the time. Highly recommend!

reviewList.text: A wonderful spa with professional therapists and a peaceful environment. Everything was perfect. I would definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Christ Lai

reviewList.text: If you're looking for a serious treatment to work out the kinks, this is it. The 90-minute duration makes a huge difference—there was no rushing, and the therapist took the time to really work on my problem areas. The dry walking and Thai-style techniques gave me an amazing stretch, and I felt so much more flexible afterward. The herbal foot soak at the start was a lovely touch to set the mood. This isn't just a pampering session; it’s therapeutic. I felt like I had a new body when I walked out. I'll definitely be back!
reviewList.author: Sophia Brown

reviewList.text: Truly healing hands… I had a pain in my neck for the past month so I opted for the head, neck and shoulder massage package. I chose this place because the treatment room was private. The only thing that sort of annoyed me was the street noise. They need to play some spa music to cover it. Otherwise it was a really great experience and I think I will return.

reviewList.text: Had an amazing time. We got the massage and head spa and the 90 mins flew by. Everyone was professional and we would come back if we had another night in Đà Nẵng.

reviewList.text:
We just had an amazing 1.5-hour facial treatment, including a deep cleansing, blackhead and blemish extraction, and a complete facial care package using professional equipment.

The hygiene standards are exceptionally high — honestly, even better than what we are used to in Germany. The staff took their time and did everything very carefully and professionally, without rushing.

The value for money is absolutely fantastic. You really get a high-quality treatment for a very fair price. We are extremely happy with the experience and can highly recommend this place to everyone.
reviewList.author: Benedikt

reviewList.text:
I inquired and booked a Hydrafacial appointment through whatsapp on the same day, and they responded pretty quickly. My husband and I arrived earlier than our scheduled time, and they were able to accommodate us right away.

We chose the Hydrafacial, which was 800,000 VND per person. Bang and Nhi took care of us, and they did a great job. The treatment included cleansing and deep cleaning of the face, and our skin felt really clean and refreshed afterward. It also came with a relaxing neck and head massage, which was such a nice bonus!

The whole experience was comfortable and relaxing. The place was clean and cozy, and we never felt rushed. Overall, we really enjoyed our Hydrafacial and were happy with the service. Would definitely recommend it!

reviewList.text: Thank you, Yen Nhi. You did the most thorough extraction I’ve ever had done in my life! Loved it. Will be back & highly recommend. I did the acne care facial.

reviewList.text:
Kim’s place is really something special. Unassuming from the outside but wow! - we are so pleased to have discovered this oasis. All her staff are just so lovely and they all work together beautifully. Lợi, Toàn and Trang are just delights and together with Kim they make you feel at home. My husband and I enjoyed several different services between us from massages, waxing, nails, hair treatments and everything was done with quiet, gentle, confident meticulous care. We really felt we were in good hands and our custom was respectfully welcomed.
I highly recommended this salon with confidence that you too will be so pleased to make this discovery.
reviewList.author: Joanna King

reviewList.text: Fabulous service!! Amazing foot massage, staff, and ambience. Also got delicious treats and tea. I would recommend coming here, I’ll be back again for sure!
reviewList.author: Uma Vandekerkhove

reviewList.text:
Got a hair cut and beard trim and shave.
It was so good that I have decided to get a massage too .
All the staff is excellent. Special thank yo the owner which is really amazing . She greets you with a beautiful smile and welcomes you.
reviewList.author: Gianluca Elia

reviewList.text: Massage, spa, nails, hair cut services all under one roof. My daughter had in grown nails that were hurting & the salon girls were very attentive to help her, they kept checking if she still had the pain. While waiting, I had a full body massage which was quite ok (though not as good as Balinese or Thai message). My husband had his hair cut & wash, facial massage. All the ladies were very friendly and we left the saloon feeling happy.
reviewList.author: Merryheart

reviewList.text:
I almost walked past this beauty salon, thinking it was just one of many, but I’m so glad I didn’t. This place truly stands out.

I chose a combo treatment along with a haircut, and the entire experience was excellent from start to finish. The staff were incredibly professional, warm, and attentive. They took their time and made sure everything was done with care and precision.

The combo included ear cleaning, a facial, a mask, a relaxing shoulder and neck massage, and several extra touches that made the experience feel complete.

In total, I paid 450,000 VND for more than two hours of high-quality treatment, which is amazing value for money. I left feeling refreshed, well-groomed, and genuinely impressed.

Highly recommended if you’re in Da Nang and looking for a great self-care experience!

reviewList.author: Loan Phan

reviewList.text:
I don’t usually get massages but coming from a long trip from Japan I felt I needed one. Friends didn’t have any recommendations.
So I googled whatever is near my hotel and found Nha Minh. Based on the positive reviews, I decided to come.

The rave reviews were spot on. The place was clean, relaxing and my masseuse provided friendly, effective massage. I had the one-hour (I had a meeting to go to afterwards) hot stone package. My exhausted body was restored. This was amazing great value. I loved the service so much I plan to return, as early as next week.

I have to mention Ms. Vuong, manager/owner. When I called to make a reservation, she squeezed me in at a busy time, 5pm. On my way, she followed up to make sure I found the place alright. I was 20 feet from the door and she was there waiting for me. She explained the different offerings, in very clear English. She guided me through what turned out to be the right choice for me. And as I was leaving, she saw me off at the door. Talk about deluxe customer service. This operator genuinely cares for her customers.

Lastly, a reviewer complained about temperature. It was not cold, as claimed. Not even close. Not hot either. They keep the temperature at just the right comfortable level.

Another said staff were talking all the time and it was a noisy environment. Staff talked to each other, yes, but they whispered, and said very little, like 1-2 sentences every 3 minutes or so. The place was pretty much dead quiet. All you can hear is this soft, relaxing piano lounge music. Oh and the sighs of happy customers (one reviewer said she moaned lol).

Then someone said the massage hurt? Of course it might. But you only have to tell your masseuse.  At one point I felt a bit of discomfort but I told my masseuse and immediately she adjusted her technique and pressure and it was alright after that.

This place deserves 6 stars if you ask me. I know I’ll be a regular customer.
reviewList.author: True North

reviewList.text:
I LOVE IT! This place has a 5.0 average review for all the great reasons.
Prompt, pleasant, and professional.
Call to reserve to help them plan if you can, but if you just turn up like we did, they're awesome at magically making it work 👌

We, a group of 4 (females), went in 8:30pm, an hour before close. There were only 2 workers there both occupied. One promptly helped us address all our questions while  finishing up with their clients and sat us down for tea.

Our interactions were super pleasant. We used Google translate and body language to sort every thing out. No confusion on what was included in the menu or pricing. (Cash only though, worth noting.)

Within like 5 mins, all her reinforcements showed up to make sure we all get out of there before 10pm. I got the full body massage. It was thorough and professional. Just the right pressure, and communication. The stone massage was really unique. The hair wash/massage my friends got were also great.

I'd go again if I wasn't leaving the area tomorrow early morning. Don't miss this gem ❤️

(Bonus, the workers there are all super cute! 😎)

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Wonderful, Professional Couple’s Spa Experience

During our vacation in Da Nang, my wife and I were looking for a relaxing spa day together, and Lounge Spa Danang exceeded our expectations.

The spa has created a welcoming, comfortable, and peaceful atmosphere from the moment you walk through the door. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, professional, and attentive, making us feel completely at ease.

My wife enjoyed a gel manicure and pedicure, a 60-minute foot massage, and a neck and shoulder massage. She left feeling completely refreshed and very happy with the results.

I chose their 90-minute Barbershop Combo, which included a traditional shave with facial massage, eyebrow and nose trimming, fingernail care, ear cleaning, hair wash and blow dry, plus massages for my back, legs, feet, neck, shoulders, and scalp. It was one of the most relaxing grooming experiences I’ve ever had, and the staff never made the service feel rushed.

One thing I’d especially like to mention for fellow international travelers: this is a professional wellness spa offering genuine massage and grooming services. If you’re simply looking for a relaxing, therapeutic spa experience (as we were), you can feel completely comfortable here. There were no awkward moments or uncomfortable upselling—just skilled, professional staff focused on helping us unwind.

The value was outstanding. Including tip, we paid a total of 1,540,000 VND (about US$58.56 / NZ$103.82) for everything:

* My Barbershop Combo: 460,000 VND (about US$17.49 / NZ$32.01)
* My wife’s services: 900,000 VND (about US$34.22 / NZ$60.67)

Considering the quality of the treatments and the amount of time we spent there, we thought the prices were exceptionally reasonable.

One thing to keep in mind: they currently accept cash only, so plan accordingly.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and want a legitimate, relaxing spa experience with excellent service and great value, we highly recommend Lounge Spa Danang. We wouldn’t hesitate to return on our next visit.

reviewList.text: This is an amazing spa right next to the New Orient Hotel with very good prices and friendly staff. I got my nails done by Quynh, who did a fantastic job with a gel manicure. It was the best manicure I had ever received.  She cleaned my nail beds very thoroughly and shaped my nails exactly how I wanted. She was also very precise and detail-oriented with the character design I wanted. One of my family member’s did the foot combo, which included exfoliation, a foot mask,  and foot massage. They spent a lot of time scrubbing the dry skin and cleaning until the feet were soft and properly moisturized. Their massage services are also very relaxing and stress relieving. reviewList.text:
Hello...
I came to Da Nang not for sightseeing or travel, but for a pure vacation to relieve stress and recover my lost physical strength.
As a researcher at Samsung, I have a project in progress, so I have no choice but to spend half of my vacation in the morning and take care of work at the hotel.
This is my first time on vacation abroad, and the destination is the port city of Da Nang, Vietnam.
I considered Japan, but since it has the same climate as Korea, I chose a warm place, and I spend my days going back and forth between restaurants, coffee shops, spas, and hotels.
I also chose a quiet hotel to avoid places with too many people, and I used the hotel spa three times, but the only thing that set it apart was the facilities, and in terms of price, it was not cost-effective at all.
I usually use my laptop for long periods of time, so I prefer spas over alcohol due to turtle neck and shoulder pain.
I use a large spa and many spas once a day, and I found a spa that I often visit, which is the lounge spa that I am introducing to you. The CEO is Korean and has worked for a large company for 20 years and has established himself in Da Nang.
First of all, he is kind and provides pick-up and sanding services, and the facilities are clean, and the employees' work attitude is excellent and kind.
And there are Korean-speaking employees on site, so there is no inconvenience..
I also recommend this spa because it is near the hotel I am staying at, and I have been using it frequently since I happened to stop by.
If you search for the KakaoTalk ID Lounge Spa and add it, you will also receive a discount.
You will receive more discounts when you visit again.
The foot callus removal service is differentiated and the massage is also top-notch.
I plan to get my nails done next time.
Nail care and toenail care too....
I highly recommend it.
Thank you.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Top-notch from start to finish!

I walked into Brothers Men's Boutique Salon wanting my scruff tightened up, and walked out feeling like a new man. My barber started with a 3 mm trim, then took it even shorter with real precision until it looked perfect — still scruffy, just sharp and clean.

Then his assistant took over with a facial massage unlike anything I've ever experienced. She worked the eye sockets and cheekbones with therapeutic precision — it felt like a little stampede of horses running across my face, and left me tingly and refreshed. She cleaned up my brows and forehead with a brand-new straight-edge blade, which she took the time to show me before installing it. Next came a hot towel, a lavender scrub, and a cold face wrap to finish.

To wrap it up, my barber combed and styled my hair exactly the way I like it.

Professional, skilled, and genuinely caring. If you're in Da Nang, don't miss Brothers. Thank you, team!

— Ken, visiting from Oregon, USA 🇺🇸

I also have a modern mullet kind of thing without shaved sides so i made sure that was clear not to use a low guard. reviewList.text:
Hands down the best barbershop experience in Da Nang!
My friend and I came here for a session (haircut, beard, and nose waxing). Even though we arrived a bit late, the staff was incredibly welcoming and accommodated us without any issues.
The level of cleanliness here is unmatched — it feels as exceptionally clean and hygienic as the top-tier salons back in Russia. This was my main priority, and Brothers delivered 100%. The metal tools and clippers are visibly spotless and professionally sterilized. There are many assistants working around the floor, constantly cleaning up, preparing fresh tools, and washing hair, which keeps the environment immaculate.
The barbers are true professionals — very precise, careful, and skilled. Both of our haircuts and grooming turned out perfect. I’m definitely making this my regular spot in Da Nang. Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
The best barbershop in all of Da Nang. We visited twice. When it comes to my hair and beard I'm extremely picky and demanding, which makes my recommendation for this barber all the more genuine.

I had the fade done on the sides and on the beard. The barber is exceptionally skilled and clearly knows how to work with curly hair. His eye for precision is impressive, he spotted an asymmetry in my haircut immediately and corrected a mistake my regular barber back home in Switzerland had made. The beard line, both on the cheek and around the neck, was perfectly straight, a level of precision that very few barbers back home manage. My beard hair grows in several whorls and different directions, yet he shaved it baby smooth with a straight razor without a single nick. That alone puts him ahead of most.

I got the signature cut, which includes a hair wash and massage. The staff member massaged my scalp, face, shoulders and back, alternating with hot and cold towels throughout. You genuinely feel treated like royalty. I'd take this barber home to Switzerland if I could.

The value for money is unbeatable, and the entire team is consistently polite, friendly and attentive. Highly recommend without hesitation.

reviewList.text:
I absolutely loved my experience here! I have very long, naturally wavy hair, so I'm always nervous about getting it cut. I only like subtle trims, and I've had so many experiences where stylists cut off more than I asked for or add layers that don't blend well. I often wear my hair in braids, so I prefer a clean, blended cut without short pieces sticking out.

From the moment I arrived, she was so kind, gentle, and caring. She really listened to exactly what I wanted and took such great care to trim only the damaged ends while keeping my hair long. The result was exactly what I had hoped for. My hair looks beautiful both naturally wavy and straight, which is so important to me.

The shampoo experience was honestly out of this world! The scalp massage and head scratching were incredibly relaxing, one of the best I've ever had. I also loved that you lie completely flat on a comfortable bed instead of leaning back over a sink with your neck hanging awkwardly. It was so much more comfortable and felt amazing.

reviewList.text:
🌿 Tran Thao Spa – A Truly Relaxing Experience in Da Nang

During my recent trip to Da Nang, I visited Tran Thao Spa, and it turned out to be one of the most peaceful and refreshing experiences of my entire vacation. If you’re looking for a place to relax and recharge both body and mind, I can wholeheartedly recommend this spa.

⸻

✨ Location & First Impression

The spa is conveniently located near My Khe Beach — just a few minutes’ walk away. As soon as I arrived, I was warmly welcomed by the staff with a friendly smile. The entrance and waiting area were clean and beautifully decorated, and I was offered tea while waiting. It already felt like the start of a healing experience.

⸻

🌸 Atmosphere & Facilities

The moment I stepped inside, I could feel the calming ambiance — soft lighting, gentle music, and a pleasant herbal scent filled the air. The massage rooms were private, cozy, and spotless. They use natural, high-quality products, which made me feel even more comfortable and cared for.
The spa menu offers a great variety of treatments, from body massages and hot stone therapy to herbal hair washing. It’s easy to find the perfect option that suits your needs.

⸻

💆‍♀️ Service & Experience

I chose the 60-minute oil body massage + herbal hair wash combo, and it was simply amazing.
•	Before starting, the therapist asked about my preferences and focused carefully on my neck and shoulders, where I had the most tension.
•	The massage pressure was just right, and the therapist’s technique felt professional and thoughtful.
•	After the session, I was offered a warm herbal tea, which completed the relaxing experience beautifully.
•	The herbal hair wash was more than just shampooing — it included a soothing scalp massage and gentle herbal steam, leaving my head and mind refreshed.

⸻

💰 Price & Value

The price was very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the service and the atmosphere. It truly felt like great value for money, and I wouldn’t hesitate to come back on my next trip to Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
Overall Experience: 10/10 ⭐
Glow Spa has become a personal favorite – I’ve already been three times, and that alone says a lot. Each visit has been consistently excellent. From relaxation to muscle relief, it hits every mark. Easily one of the best spa experiences I’ve had.

Massage Quality: 9/10 ⭐
The massage is detailed and effective. She worked through every knot and kept checking in to make sure the pressure was just right. What really stood out was how carefully she cleaned off the massage oil afterward – I left feeling refreshed, not greasy.

Therapist Professionalism: 9/10 ⭐
Very respectful and attentive. The therapist listens, adjusts when needed, and shows genuine care throughout the session.

Cleanliness & Hygiene: 9/10 ⭐
Everything is spotless – from the rooms to the towels and tools. The overall hygiene level gives you confidence from the moment you walk in.

Atmosphere: 8/10 ⭐
Soothing music, a calm environment, and a peaceful setup. It’s easy to switch off and unwind here. With a little more ambient detail, it could be even better – but it’s already very solid.

Prices & Value: 9/10 ⭐
The pricing is more than fair for what you get: 280.000 VND for 60 minutes and 380.000 VND for 90 minutes of full-body massage. Considering the quality, attention to detail, and all the little extras, it’s excellent value for money.

Extras / Notes:
You’re welcomed with a free peach iced tea, followed by a foot bath, and after the massage, you get fresh mango and more iced tea. The relaxing music adds to the calm vibe. The therapist takes time to wipe off excess oil properly – a rare and appreciated touch.

Would I recommend it?
Yes – 100%. I’ve been 3 times already because it’s that good. Excellent technique, consistent quality, and a full experience that feels premium.

reviewList.text:
Tl;dr Come here, it is excellent. They speak enough Korean to communicate, even if you aren't Korean.

Got the luxury service (shampoo, facial treatment, neck/shoulder massage), it delivered fully on all fronts. Down a random little alley you'd likely never wander down, worth the little journey.

For the better part of an hour, I felt like a dog being scritched so perfectly that it can't help but smile. Weeks of poor decisions gently drained off of my haggard visage, and my hair became as light and smooth as a chilled Michelob Ultra.

I departed relaxed like Sunday afternoon in the park, yet ready to take on life with both grace and fire; I made peace with my younger sibling constantly outshining me, stopped lifting weights with my ego, and finally told Uncle Mitch to quit commenting on my friends' Facebook posts.

Make no mistake, this is a humble family home with a small spa on the first floor. No burbling cherub fountains, singing bowls, or matching staff uniforms. Just an honest, hole in the wall neighborhood business that delivers incredible results at extremely fair prices.

I wholeheartedly recommend this fine establishment and hope to avail of their services again soon. You should, too.

Bonus round: if you are like I once was and believe that a red-blooded man should never be on the receiving end of a facial, I strongly urge you to reconsider (at least in the spa; I cannot speak to other contexts). Caring for your skin and hair is taking control of your appearance, just like exercising or wearing clothes that fit. Go in, get a proper shampoo, scalp treatment, head massage, shave, ear cleaning, and a face mask. Walk out feeling like Bradley Cooper with that elusive Oscar finally in hand. You both deserve it.

places.summary: Tranquil temple home to Buddha statues, bridges over a pool & a garden hung with scarlet lanterns.

reviewList.text:
We visited in the morning during the rain. Despite the overcast weather, the pagoda grounds were stunning, peaceful, and provided plenty of shelter from the drops.

Hours & Dress Code: Check opening hours in advance (there is only one entrance). Staff will ask you to cover up with a provided robe if you wear short shorts. Conical hats and umbrellas are available at the entry.

Strollers & Luggage: Strollers aren't very convenient on the grounds, so it's best to leave them in the parking area near the entrance. Lockers are available for large bags, alongside free drinking water and clean restrooms.

Footwear & Photography: Always remove your shoes before entering temples. Note that photography is only allowed outside. Also, be aware that you might enter a temple from one side and exit from another, leaving your shoes behind!

Atmosphere & Details: The complex is huge, featuring quiet meditation spots, relaxing gardens with swings, and shallow streams filled with koi carp and turtles.

We were almost the only visitors there, making it an exceptionally serene and memorable experience!
reviewList.author: Julia Alexandrova

reviewList.text:
Nam Son Pagoda is such a peaceful and beautiful place in Da Nang. The architecture is stunning, with traditional Vietnamese details, beautiful red-and-gold tones, and a very calm atmosphere.

I especially loved the bridge over the pond and the lantern decorations — every corner feels carefully designed and incredibly photogenic while still keeping the spiritual and tranquil vibe of the temple.

The entire area is clean, spacious, and surrounded by greenery, making it a perfect place to slow down, relax, and enjoy a quiet moment away from the busy city. Definitely one of the most beautiful pagodas to visit in Da Nang

The entire atmosphere feels incredibly warm, inviting, and safe. You instantly slow down the moment you enter. Birds were flying around peacefully, nature surrounding every corner, and there are so many beautiful areas where you can simply sit, meditate, read a book, or just be present.

It felt like a little sanctuary away from the noise of the world. A place to breathe, reconnect, and feel peace again.
Thank you so much for creating and preserving such a wonderful Temple experience. We left feeling lighter, calmer, and truly grateful 💜

reviewList.text:
I really wanted to give this place 0 stars, but I’m trying to be fair, so I’m giving it 2.

First, the hygiene. The towels had an unpleasant smell. I also noticed used towels being put back into circulation immediately, with the next customer lying on them. This raised serious hygiene concerns.

Second, my therapist was changed three times during one session. Two different employees independently told me the therapist had a stomachache, but nobody could explain why there were two additional changes. Each new therapist had no idea what the previous one had been doing, so the massage felt completely disjointed.

The first therapist was looking at her phone. The other two were not much better. All three used very repetitive, jerky and rough movements. The last therapist kept asking “Okay? Okay?” every few minutes. The pressure was fine, but the massage itself was poor. At the end, she even asked me to leave a tip if the massage was “okay”.

I understand this is a very budget salon, around 500,000 VND for two hours. But there are several salons nearby offering much better hygiene, fresh towels, disposable underwear and better massages for only a little more.

The interior is also very tired and basic. The reception staff are friendly, but after a bad experience there was no compensation or real attempt to solve the problem. I was simply charged the full price and then asked for a tip.

My rating:
Hygiene: 1/10
Massage: 2/10
Interior: 2/10
Management: 0/10

You might get lucky with a good therapist, but based on my experience, I wouldn’t count on it.

If you want a cheap massage and accept the risk, try it. If you want consistent quality, I’d spend more elsewhere.

Not recommended.

The restroom was poorly maintained and did not match the image the spa tries to present. During the hair washing service, the staff seemed rushed and unwilling to properly dry my hair. They even accidentally scratched my face, which was uncomfortable and unprofessional.

What shocked me the most was that after the service, I was given a bottle of water that appeared to have already been opened and partially consumed by someone else. This is completely unacceptable from a hygiene and customer service standpoint.

Another concern was that after the treatment, we were encouraged to leave a Google review in exchange for a 20% refund. This made me question how genuine some of the reviews are.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I don’t want other tourists to spend their money here based on potentially misleading ratings. There are many better spas in Da Nang that offer better service, better hygiene, and a much better overall experience for the same price or less.

reviewList.text:
I would like to share some professional feedback regarding my recent experience. I hope the owner can take this seriously and improve the service quality and overall environment for customers.

Firstly, I strongly suggest providing masks for staff to wear while serving customers. During hair washing and body massage services, the staff’s breath blowing directly onto customers’ faces is very uncomfortable. In addition, one staff member appeared to have a flu, cough, and runny nose while serving customers, and unfortunateIly i became sick afterwards as well. For hygiene and customer comfort, staff who are unwell should rest at home or all staffs wear masks while working or consultaion

Secondly, the ventilation and air-conditioning conditions need improvement. The fan was not functioning properly and was blowing directly onto my face, which felt unpleasant. However, when the fan was turned off, the hair washing room became extremely hot because the air conditioner was not working. It would be good for the owner to repair the air conditioner as soon as possible to provide a more comfortable environment for customers.

The hair wash area is quite messy, I also feel the cleanliness and organization of the shop should be improved. Towels were placed on the bedside table without proper arrangement, making it unclear whether they were for hair washing, body massage, hand massage, or foot massage. This creates an unhygienic impression.

In addition, the customer toilet was also being used as a shower area, and the floor inside toilet was constantly wet. This did not feel comfortable or private for customers. I would suggest having a separate shower/toilet area for family use and a separate toilet for customers to maintain professionalism and hygiene standards.

Another important point is the shop’s professional image. There is no proper reception counter, and family members were lying on the leg massage chairs near the main entrance during working hours. Customers can immediately see this when opening the main door, and it gives an unprofessional impression. It would be more appropriate for owners and staff to sit properly at a reception counter during business hours. If anyone wishes to rest, it would be better to do so inside a private room where customers cannot see.

Lastly, there was no drinking water offered to customers before or after the services. This small gesture is part of basic customer hospitality and professionalism.

I hope the owner can consider these suggestions seriously to improve customer experience and maintain better professional standards for the business.

P/s:

I purchased the Intensive Hair Wash service _ duration of 60 minutes.
I noted that face massage was not included, so I requested for face massage.
The staff informed me that there would be an additional charge of 25,000 VND.

I then asked how long the face massage would be. One staff member seemed ready to answer honestly, but another staff member stopped her and quickly replied that it would be 10 minutes.

Based on this information, the total service duration should have been 70 minutes (60 minutes hair wash + 10 minutes face massage). However, the overall service time was still only 60 minutes in total.

I hope the owner can clarify the service timing and ensure transparency with customers regarding additional services and duration. Professional communication and honesty are very important for customer trust and satisfaction.

I understand recommending services is part of business, but customers’ decisions should be respected without repeated pressure.

Excellent Value and Professional Service at Salon Hoang Manh Barber (Da Nang)
​I recently visited Salon Hoang Manh Barber in Da Nang and had an outstanding experience! From start to finish, the service was top-notch, and the value for money is unbeatable.
​Overview:
This salon delivers a truly professional barber experience that exceeds expectations, especially given the incredibly affordable prices. It’s the perfect spot for anyone looking for high-quality grooming without breaking the bank.
​The Combo Deal:
I opted for the Haircut, Shampoo, and Facial Wash combo, and I was genuinely surprised by the price—only 120,000 VND! This is an incredible value for the level of care provided.
​Staff and Service:
The staff was exceptionally polite and professional. My barber was attentive, listening carefully to what I wanted for my haircut and executing it with great precision. The shampoo and facial wash added a relaxing touch that made the whole experience feel like a mini-spa session.
My haircut was sharp and exactly what I asked for. The barber paid close attention to detail, ensuring everything was perfectly blended.
​The salon was clean, modern, and had a comfortable, welcoming atmosphere. It’s a great place to unwind.
​I highly recommend Salon Hoang Manh Barber to both locals and tourists. I've found my new go-to place for grooming in Da Nang.
​If you're looking for quality, politeness, and professionalism all in one affordable package, look no further than Salon Hoang Manh Barber.
Five stars!🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Avoid this place please❗️❗️❗️
This spa has nothing to do with massage at all!
I asked about Thai massage (with no stretching or exercises) because I have allergy to any oil or balm they usually use. The manager said okay, no problems. But even so the master used a little oil on her hands, I guess she thought I wouldn’t feel it. Very irresponsible. Now I have my back itching!
Moreover, master was not professional and didn’t even know the technique, she only made it hurt using pressure. That’s it, no massage, only strong pressuring.

And there were no excuses, just rude attitude to the client. No service. Very disappointing.

By the way, as alternative i asked for foot massage instead, hoping would have better experience, but nah, here’s no technique too. No comments.

A Heartfelt thank you to the entire Tia Wellness Resort team for the wonderful service, beautiful surroundings, and genuine kindness.

From the moment we arrived, every staff member went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable and relaxed. Their warmth, hospitality, and attention to every little detail made our stay truly special.

reviewList.author: Azzam Amer

reviewList.text:
This was our second stay at TIA Wellness Resort, and once again, it was an absolutely wonderful experience. The resort is beautifully maintained, exceptionally clean, peaceful, and surrounded by natural beauty. It truly feels like a hidden paradise, far away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

What made our stay even more special was the thoughtful hospitality of the team. After we checked in, the resort surprised me with a handwritten birthday card and a birthday cake, which was such a lovely and heartwarming gesture. The early check-in and late check-out arrangements were also greatly appreciated, allowing us to enjoy every moment of our stay. The 80-minute spa treatment was fantastic and incredibly relaxing.

The beachfront, sandy shores, and swimming pools each have their own unique charm. Whether under the sunshine or during the rain, the resort reveals a different kind of beauty and tranquility.

We spent four days here and barely felt the need to leave the resort. That says everything about how relaxing, beautiful, and complete the experience was.

Thank you to the entire TIA team for making our second visit so memorable. We left feeling refreshed, pampered, and grateful for these precious moments. TIA is truly a place we would love to return to again and again. Highly recommended for anyone seeking peace, wellness, and a meaningful escape.

reviewList.text: Loved this resort. The 80 minute treatment per person every day was the best. The resort is professional, luxurious and spotlessly maintained. reviewList.text:
A Terrible Hygiene Nightmare: My 60-Minute Vietnamese Shampoo and Shoulder Massage Experience Note: (Unfortunately, because the lighting inside was extremely dim, it was completely impossible to take any photos as evidence.)
To be honest, the moment I walked up the stairs, I already felt very uneasy—the walls around the staircase were covered in mold.
Once inside, I was asked to lie down on a bed and told to take off my upper body clothes and put on their "beauty vest." I asked where it was, and they pointed to a basket. To be frank, the lighting was extremely dim. There were only two vests in the basket, and I had no idea whether they were clean or dirty. When I asked, the staff just said, "Yes, just put it on." So I put it on and laid down.
The service itself was subpar: they only washed my hair (and since I have long hair, it wasn't a pleasant experience) and briefly touched my neck—it definitely wasn't good. Plus, every time I breathed, I could smell a heavy odor of mold. Afterward, they blow-dried and combed my hair. Honestly, I have curly hair, but they used a large brush to comb it completely straight—which is pretty ridiculous.
Of course, I was extremely unsatisfied. I felt their hygiene environment was deeply problematic. The realization hit me when I took off the vest afterward and was told to "throw it back into that same basket." It hit me like a ton of bricks: Are you kidding me? This meant the vests weren't even being washed—they were just taken off by one customer, placed right back in the basket, and handed directly to the next person. That is completely unacceptable and crossing the line!
I told my husband we must never go back there again—it was just too terrifying. The entire place was kept so dim that you couldn't see anything clearly, but the mold on the walls by the stairwell was undeniable.

reviewList.text:
Don't be fooled by the interior.

I visit Da Nang often, and while I know everyone has their likes and dislikes wherever they go, I wouldn't go there myself. I found it strange that there wasn't much information available, and sure enough... I went because I was tempted since it was near my accommodation.

Since there is so little information available, I am sharing this with you.

90 minutes costs 450,000 VND plus 10% tax. Total is 495,000 VND. I paid in cash. They didn't show me a separate menu; instead, they showed me a screenshot translated on their phone. Since we couldn't communicate verbally, they showed it to me later—I'm not sure if they adjusted the price or something... Anyway, the uneasy feeling about the lack of information wasn't unfounded.

The 90-minute session is listed as 22 steps, including facial cleansing, facial scrub, scrub massage, soothing massage, face mask, a few hair shampoos, neck and shoulders, and blow-drying.

You change clothes in the restroom.

The facial scrub treatment involves a massage, which causes irritation. The most surprising thing was that they scratched my face with their fingernails? At first, I doubted it and thought it was a machine. But the sensation was different from a machine. Anyway, strangely enough, they use their fingernails like a machine to scratch my face, just like scratching my head. (It is technically done, so it is fascinating.) - It’s not good. Because they just scratch your face.

The hand skills for the facial soothing massage are good, though.

Give up on the neck and shoulders (décolleté).

In conclusion, it’s a head spa, but washing my own hair makes it look less dry and rough.

The therapist seems to be working hard, so I’m giving them two stars.

reviewList.text:
Best one out here at Da Nang.

Most relaxing and the staffs are amazing at what they do. My whole body feels so good and relaxed after.

10/10

reviewList.text: We had a short window of time before getting the overnight train to Hà Nội. We found this place by google reviews. My son and I might disagree about this review, but I think that’s on us. I requested the Thai massage and he followed suit. TBH, it was pretty hardcore with me being folded forward, backward and stretched in some new directions. IMO, they delivered what was promised. There was, however, no English (again, that’s on us) so it was hard to dial down the treatments. The place is clean, professional and patronised by locals. Would recommend but careful what you wish (ask) for!
reviewList.author: Alister Bayston

reviewList.text:
I recieved the most rejuvenating and rewarding massage the day before I flew back to usa. My massage therapist was the BEST ! Next time I go back to Da Nang I will surely go back to Thi LA Spa
Dean

attribution.name: Thì Là Spa - Gội đầu dưỡng sinh, Massage thư giãn
Thì Là Spa - Gội đầu dưỡng sinh, Massage thư giãn

reviewList.text:
👎👎👎👎👎 The worst spa experience I’ve ever had. If there are zero or negative stars, that’s what I would give. UNPROFESSIONAL STAFF!!

Today, I availed of their combo- full body massage, ear cleaning, hair shampoo, and facial for 500,000 vnd . I arrived around 10:30 PM and we were the last customers who walked in.

The massage was subpar, but I will not complain about that. I’m not even going to complain about the staff being in house clothes or the way they were chatting entirely during the treatment. What completely ruined my visit was the person who did my facial, ear cleaning, and shampoo— he (or she? But looked like a he) was in a hurry to finish off my treatment as if just going through the steps to get everything over with. He was not gentle in his treatment at all.

•	He attempted to do dermaplaning without cleaning my face first. I told him I still had makeup on, so he hurriedly wiped it off with a sponge (I’m not even sure if it was clean or reused).

•	During ear cleaning, I felt unsafe.. he inserted the tools too deep into my ear, and I had to ask him to stop.

•	The facial was rough and rushed. The products he used caused a strong stinging and burning sensation, possibly because the products were harsh or because  he did dermaplaning first before applying them.

•	During the hair shampoo, he used his fingernails to scrub my scalp, which was very uncomfortable.

•	someone else dried my hair  and I stopped them from blow-drying my hair because they were using very high heat, too close to the ends, and it was burning my hair.

•	To top it all off, my shirt was soaking wet at the back when I got up. They didn’t let me change or even place a towel to protect my clothes during the shampooing. NO APOLOGIES AFTER.

I went to the spa hoping to relax, but I left more stressed than when I came in. 😭😭😭😭😭 they were in a rush probably to serve more customers or wanting to go home since we were the last ones. Overall I was not treated well.

If you have money, don’t come here and just spend it somewhere that values hygiene and professionalism. If you don’t, just rest at home or grab a drink instead. Either way, you’ll have a much better time than coming here.
reviewList.author: Julia Robles

reviewList.text: Back masage with good strength. They will also apply hot stones on your back and end with head massage. Free water is provided at end of massage. Will come again.
reviewList.author: AK Seow

reviewList.text: We walked in and were taken care of right away. I had a nice manicure and would recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Carly Zuehlke

reviewList.text: Had a really great foot massage experience! The staff was friendly and professional, and the atmosphere was calm and relaxing from the moment I walked in. The therapist was very skilled, applying just the right amount of pressure and really focusing on the tension points. I left feeling refreshed, lighter, and totally relaxed. Definitely worth it—would highly recommend and come back again!
reviewList.author: Katrin Hofmann

reviewList.text: Don’t sleep on this place. We were right next door at the Hotel Del Luna and wanted to give them a try. Was first sketched out as when you walk in, it looks like a restaurant. The relaxing spa area is upstairs with comfortable reclining seats and soft neck rests. We got the foot massage and it was one of the best I’ve had. Prices are good and the staff is friendly and accommodating.
reviewList.author: Kris Richie

reviewList.text:
Hair cut so bad I needed to go to another salon to get it fixed. And I was gonna get a perm here too. Thank God I decided to go elsewhere😩

**UPDATE since owner claimed I was not serviced there's

I came in on June 11th at around noon. I was serviced by a male employee. I was the only customer there. Please check the camera footage! Here’s proof that I did come to your salon and took a picture of your menu when I checked out. My hair cut was 200k. Looking at the menu now, my haircut was a lot cheaper than what’s showing on the menu. Did you guys give me an intern?

UPDATE 2: Let’s add GASLIGHTING to your list of characteristic as well

This picture was taken a week after I got my haircut at your salon. Your staff gave me a fake perm that’s why I didn’t see his work afterward. It wasn’t until the next day when I washed my hair that I saw how horrible it was. That’s when I had to go search for a new salon to get it fixed. The picture taken is at the new salon when I went to get it fixed because they couldn’t believe another professional salon would actually cut this hair.

You can deny it if you want but what you’re not gonna do is gaslight me into believing I was not in your shop and how much I paid your worker. Do better!
reviewList.author: Noelle Dang

reviewList.text:
The owner and staffs are very friendly. Their services are quick but diligent and efficient. The price is very reasonable for the quality received. I got my bang straightening and cut, scalp exfoliation and hair repair for the total
of 900k VND (the owner didn’t charge me the bang cut. Thank you ☺️). Highly recommended!!!

reviewList.text: Strongly recommend this salon to all the tourists. Amazing hair salon. I had my haircut here. Very satisfied

reviewList.text: I grew up here and even as a local, I always struggled to find a good hair salon. Now visiting home, I tried this one on a friend’s recommendation and it was beyond my expectations! Huge thanks to the owner couple, especially Mr. Beo, and the entire team. Prices are transparent and very very fair for the excellent quality. If you’re looking for a true ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ salon, this is it!

reviewList.author: Matt Sherwood

reviewList.text:
1★ – A serious mistake!

I saw this place advertised on Facebook and decided to give it a try. It turned out to be a mistake — a serious one.

If you are looking for a place to unwind, DO NOT COME HERE. Instead of relaxing music, you are exposed to doors slamming, people loudly choosing services, and hairdryers roaring upstairs. Rather than calming down, your anxiety builds up and you end up more tense than when you arrived.

The headpiece keeps screeching, and the poorly installed curtain allows harsh light to shine directly into your face, which was extremely annoying. Hygiene standards are shockingly low: towels are rinsed in the same bowl where your hair is washed, and the same towels are used to wipe the body and then the face. “All in one,” apparently. The towel used to dry my hair SMELLED OF MOLD, and I had to remove it immediately.

To make matters worse, the foot-soaking bowl was not rinsed between guests. That alone is enough to make this place unacceptable.

The owners should understand that advertising means nothing if you cannot deliver what you promise. Otherwise, it only leads to distrust and, frankly, disgrace.
reviewList.author: Rosaline Jos

reviewList.text: Whether you are a local resident or a visitor, treating yourself to their head shampoo spa experience is something you should not miss. The combination of skilled therapists, a serene environment, and exceptional service makes it the best in the city. I left feeling completely refreshed and pampered, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a bit of luxury and relaxation in Da Nang. Showered with kindness and smiles the moment I walked in.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely amazing experience! This was one of the best spa visits I’ve ever had. The staff were incredibly welcoming, professional, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and beautifully designed, making it easy to relax.

The massage was excellent—my therapist paid attention to every detail and adjusted the pressure perfectly. I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and free of tension. The facilities were spotless, and the service exceeded my expectations.

I also loved the café on the first floor. It has a cozy atmosphere, great coffee, and delicious drinks and snacks, making it the perfect place to unwind before or after your treatment. It’s such a nice addition to the overall experience.

If you’re visiting Da Nang or live here, I highly recommend this spa. Great value for the quality of service, and I’ll definitely be coming back the next time I’m in the city. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

places.name: Oneness Retreat Da Nang- Sauna & Icebath

reviewList.text:
I’ve visited many recovery, ice bath, and sauna facilities around the world, and this one is truly at the top of my list. Everything is exceptionally clean and well-maintained, which immediately makes you feel comfortable and relaxed.

They offer two different types of saunas and two ice baths — one at around 4°C for a serious cold plunge and another at 15°C for a more moderate experience. It’s perfect whether you’re experienced or just getting started.

You can also meditate, enjoy healthy meals, and fully unwind in a peaceful environment. The staff are amazing, and a special thank you to Ms. Hien — she is incredibly kind, helpful, and welcoming.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a premium recovery experience
reviewList.author: Luigi Mottola

reviewList.text:
Looove this place. Absolute heaven for wellness. Very competent staff and in general just a place to come and unwind be it sauna, ice bath, wellness classes upstairs or just to come meet friends for a long afternoon hangout to detox and let biohacking work it's magic. Onenness brings out all of that. Excellent addition to Da Nang 🥰

⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

reviewList.text: Love this place. Tried the sauna, ice bath, and massage. Similar to one of the nicest wellness spots I’ve been to. Everything is provided, so you can relax and take your time without feeling rushed. Just wish there were a clock by the ice bath to track the minutes. Would definitely come back! 🫶
reviewList.author: Melissa Seares

reviewList.text:
A little hidden oasis in Da Nang. I came here needing a proper break and left feeling like I had completely reset. I loved taking my time through the different pools and sauna rather than feeling rushed from one treatment to another.

The outdoor space was especially lovely for sitting quietly afterwards and extending the experience. Everything felt thoughtfully arranged, and the people working there made the visit easy and comfortable. A wonderful place to escape the heat and noise of the city for a few hours I would happily return.
