places.name: Son Tra Resort & Spa
places.summary: Warm villas with private pools in an informal beachfront resort featuring terrace dining & a spa.

reviewList.text:
This hotel has been the biggest surprise of my trip to Da Nang. It is situated on Son Tra Peninsula. Upon arrival, we were astonished by how spacious the villa is. Our accommodation is a two‑storey unit with a private swimming pool. It only costs around HK$1,000. A similar property would cost five to ten times as much in the Maldives.

What pleased us most is the service. Responses on WhatsApp are extremely prompt, and all staff are polite and well‑mannered. Even the doorman tried his best to communicate with us in English. The weather was poor during our stay, yet staying inside with family, watching the wind and rain outside, we felt wonderfully warm.

Our package originally included airport transfer. When the team learned we would not be heading to the airport, they thoughtfully arranged a car to the city centre for us instead. A great hotel is not only about views, but the people around you. We will absolutely come back. Thank you, lovely Candy, Hana, and all the other sweet team members.
reviewList.author: Patrick ZHU

reviewList.text:
Beautiful resort with private beach 15min out of the craziness of Da Nang.
We had a lovely stay here. Our rooms were huge, it was a villa with two bedrooms and 2 bathrooms upstairs and a kitchen, lounge and dining area downstairs with a toilet. Private pool for each of the villas in the garden.
More of a traditional style of room with dark wooden furniture but comfortable beds and very well air conditioned.
Direct access to a private beach with loungers and the main infinity pool overlooking the water. It truely is beautiful.
The staff were lovely and attentive, buffet breakfast had a good selection of east, west and all the usual items. All were delicious.
I highly recommend for a relaxing lazy stay.
reviewList.author: Stephanie Da Silva

reviewList.text: We loved it here. Right on the private beach with awesome private pool. The service was great and the food was delicious. Nice and private and quiet. The security on the gate was excellent and would definitely love to stay there again. The villas are huge and the grounds and villas are clean and beautiful. The views are amazing. Great communication on whatsapp and very cheap grab rides into town. Also has a free shuttle bus to take you up town.
reviewList.author: Simone

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful experience at the resort. The staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly. The pool villa was beautiful and thoughtfully equipped with all the amenities one could ask for.

The breakfast buffet was delicious, with a great variety of options to choose from. The easy access to the beach was another highlight, providing the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the surroundings.

Overall, it was a fantastic stay, and we would definitely love to visit again!
reviewList.author: Anil Ponappa

reviewList.text:
We had a great stay at this resort.
Our house was bigger than we imagined. It had two bedrooms (i knew it had only one), three bathrooms , a huge living and kitchen. The pool was big enough to swim and we also had a jacuzzi on the back of the house, which unfortunately it wasn't working for some reason. The beds were super comfortable, we slept really well.
I loved the fact that it's on the beach, even though there are not many sunbeds you can find one easily in the morning. There was an AC unit in every room in the house.
The breakfast was okay, there is a station for eggs/pho/banh mi which we loved. The food is varied enough for everyone to find something to eat.
I loved the staff, everyone was super nice and attentive. The communication was easy through WhatsApp as well.
Because we stayed 7 nights, they offered free pick up and drop off to the airport and one free a la carte meal at their restaurant which was a bonus, especially when we arrived on our first night, it was pouring and our flight got delayed.
For the price, you can't complain. The internet worked well all around the resort .The house is huge, it's quiet around the resort, you can easily order anything you need through grab (food, transport). I really wish we stayed longer . Thank you ❤️
Just a few suggestions about the house, it needs some improvements. The walls need some fresh paint, the kitchen furniture needs some upgrades . The bathroom towels have seen better days as well.
The night when we arrived we noticed the restaurant needed upgrades as well,food was just average and we had dinner twice over there. We ordered food on other days and we went out a lot to eat. It's a shame to have a restaurant in the resort and serve just average food.
Also it needs a lot of cleaning, there was sand on the floor at night. I understand people use the restaurant during the day when they come from the beach, but to have sand on the chairs and table at night, it's not exactly nice.
The staff was super nice and tried to clean around the resort after every storm but, the management might consider hiring more people to keep the surroundings cleaner, just my opinion.
I really hope there would be some improvements in the future because this place would be a 10/10 if they would give it a refresh.
reviewList.author: Cristina Antonescu Ghiocel

reviewList.text:
Very disappointing experience and strongly not recommend. We visited this massage shop since it’s just next to our hotel.

The masseur who attended to me seemed inexperienced and lacked basic technique. For a long stretch, she repeatedly applied balm and lightly stroked the same area of my calf without any proper pressure. After I used Google Translate to request more appropriate pressure and to focus on other areas, the massage became uncomfortably forceful instead, showing no understanding of proper technique or pressure points.

Overall, the experience felt unprofessional and poorly executed, as if the staff were not properly trained.

Both masseurs who served my boyfriend and I asked for tips at the end despite the poor service.
reviewList.author: Bobo Lim

reviewList.text:
Excellent gem right near our hotel, very competitively priced for a 60 minute aroma therapy. My girlfriend and I got a massage together, and both masseuses were checking in on us during the massage, to see if the pressure was fine etc.

Personally the masseuse I had did really well, getting a lot of knots out and cracking my back etc, walked out feeling very refreshed.

They even gave a juice too at the end of it all. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Karl Fuentes

reviewList.text: Receptionist are nice except the masseuse.Worst massage experienced ever. She's not doing it properly, more on like rushing. First time I've experienced using her foot and weight to massage me without asking for permission if it's ok. I'm not comfortable with that kind of massage.Instead I'm hoping to relax I got so stressed instead😥🥺😔
reviewList.author: rhoda jaclyn sabado

reviewList.text: I had an amazing experience at Gold Spa! The atmosphere was serene, and the staff were incredibly welcoming. My massage was heavenly—just the right pressure and perfect for relieving stress. The facilities were clean and well-maintained. I left feeling rejuvenated and relaxed. Highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind
reviewList.author: Phan Thii

reviewList.text:
I chose the relaxing body massage package with natural essential oils, and I must say that the technician's skills are great!
Moderate, rhythmic movements, pressing the right acupuncture points help the body completely relax. Especially the shoulders, neck and back - areas that often get tired from sitting at work - are carefully cared for and massaged very comfortably.
After the massage session, I felt my body feel lighter and my mind more relaxed.
reviewList.author: Oanh Bùi

places.name: Phương Liêm - Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh Đà Nẵng
places.address: 167 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
Due to the language barrier, I made a reservation through the hotel.

Once I arrived, I communicated using Papago.

(I am reposting this as the menu has changed.)

I booked the VIP 1 package, which includes grapefruit shampoo, for 130k for one hour.

They said the grapefruit shampoo alone takes 30 minutes.

The sister who recommended this place said that squinting was essential, so I went prepared.

The massage was quite professional.

At the end, they applied something warm to my eyes and feet, and also gave me a bubbling, steaming herbal treatment on my head.

I usually find massage rooms cold, but here, combined with the almost street-level atmosphere (motorcycle horns) and cool fan breeze, it was a very enjoyable local experience.

I recommend the grapefruit shampoo!
reviewList.author: 서윤희

reviewList.text: I had a terrible experience at my hair salon today. Even though I've been there many times because of the staff, the owner's attitude was terrible. I was waiting for the service to start, around 11 am, and when I asked her to turn on the air conditioning, she said it wasn't the right time and it was too hot. I asked her if it was hot at 11 am or 12 pm, and she said it was too hot. I was planning on the VIP 2 package but decided to stick with VIP 1 because it was too hot. They're so stingy with the air conditioning for the hot steam and compress services. My husband said the owner's hands were too stiff and hurt his scalp when she washed his hair last year, and this year the attitude is still the same. In this difficult economic climate, not knowing how to retain customers like this will only lead to losing them. With such awful attitudes, I will never come back. If it weren't for that staff member, this salon would probably be closed! Try to keep her, ma'am...
reviewList.author: Quỳnh Trang

reviewList.text: The best head massage of my life! Such a lovely staff member and the service is first-class. I'd love to come here every day. Definitely try it!

reviewList.text:
This is a place our whole family couldn't forget and revisited during our second trip to Da Nang.

It is frequented more by locals than tourists. The grapefruit shampoo is very satisfying; I have never received a shampoo of this quality, even in Seoul.

Both of the staff members are friendly.

Communication is not difficult, even using Papago.

I am incomparably satisfied with places like the ○○ Barbershop that are popular with Koreans.

I have a trip to Da Nang planned for next month, and I intend to visit again then.

reviewList.text: My experience was great! The staff were super enthusiastic, and the prices were reasonable! I had body and face whitening treatments and they worked very well, with noticeable results from the 2nd or 3rd session! Excellent!

reviewList.text: I came here based on a TikTok review about their skin whitening service. When I arrived, the staff and the owner were very helpful and enthusiastic. The service was very effective from the first session, and I'm very satisfied! I will definitely return to the spa again 👍👍
reviewList.author: trân nguyễn

reviewList.text:
Okay, so I almost never leave reviews unless a place completely blows me away, but I walked into this spa today as a total stranger with zero expectations, and I am genuinely sitting here in shock at how incredible everything was. From the literal second I opened the door, the whole vibe was just elite. The reception area smells like an absolute dream, the lighting is soft and relaxing, and the aesthetic is just pure main character energy without trying too hard or feeling fake.

What really got me was how seamless and authentic the whole experience felt. I was a bit nervous since it was my first time, but the staff treated me like a VIP from minute one. They were so warm, respectful, and attentive without being pushy at all. The private room was ridiculously clean, super cozy, and temperature-controlled to perfection, which immediately put my mind at ease.

Then came the actual treatment, and honest to god, my therapist had magic hands. She found knots in my shoulders that I did not even know existed and worked them out so flawlessly that I physically felt weeks of built-up stress leave my body. You can tell when people are just going through the motions versus when they actually know their craft, and these guys are absolute masters at what they do. Zero awkwardness, zero rushed vibes, just pure unadulterated bliss from start to finish. I am officially a customer for life now, ten out of ten, no cap.
reviewList.author: Tấn lâm Nguyễn

reviewList.text: What a lovely little surprise! ✨ I had such a wonderful experience at Moya Wellness Spa Da Nang today. From the moment I arrived, the staff were incredibly warm, attentive, and thoughtful. Their hospitality truly made the whole experience feel special, and every little detail made me feel well taken care of. The service was exceptional, and you can really tell that the team genuinely cares about their customers. Such a lovely new spot to unwind and treat yourself. I left feeling relaxed, happy, and already looking forward to coming back. Highly recommend! 🤍

reviewList.text:
Guys, I strongly recommend thinking twice before visiting this VIP Massage in Da Nang.
I paid the full price but did not receive the treatment and service that was promised to me. During the visit, I was also asked to pay extra money, which made the whole experience even more disappointing.
For me, this was one of the worst massage experiences I have had in Da Nang. The service did not feel worth the price I paid, and I left feeling very disappointed.
My advice to other travellers: don’t assume that a more expensive or “VIP” massage means better service. There are plenty of normal spas in Da Nang that charge less and, in my experience, provide much better service and value for money.
I personally would not visit this place again. I think Google should provide negative review option as well so I can -5 ⭐

Of these types of establishments, this was the best I found in my short trip to Da Nang, this was by far the best...

reviewList.text: It's a very professional massage parlor. Whenever I'm in Da Nang on a business trip, I always come here for a massage.

reviewList.text: SCAMMERS!! I Got scammed here today. The reviews are fake, stay away especially if you’re a westerner. They brought me a masseuse who instantly complained that I’m “too big” and she will not offer anything apart from “hand relief”. I asked for a change of waiters and they brought me another one with a worse attitude than the former. She also said no way she would do anything other than “hand relief”, using the excuse that I’m too big and a “westerner”. This was clearly an excuse and not reality, I would’ve appreciated the compliment if it was real. I settled for whatever she said she would offer and 5 minutes into the session she started barking at me in Vietnamese in a very loud voice for absolutely no reason. I was genuinely shocked and speechless, I had no idea what went wrong as I didn’t even move or open my mouth; the girl was clearly frustrated and had bruises on her chest; her eyes also looked swollen. I became very uncomfortable, ended the session instantly, and walked out. I got a bad sense of trafficking happening at this place, didn’t even bother to ask for my money back because I realized after the first masseuse interaction that I had just gotten scammed. The place is sketchy and I felt unsafe; you have been warned.
reviewList.author: Peter Haywood

reviewList.text: Worst service ever!!! Now I believe why the rating is low. The therapist is rushing to end the service, make me so uncomfortable, especially with her ANNOYED face, like she paid me for service. The package is an hour, but she is trying her best to end it in 30 minutes. Will never come back again.
reviewList.author: WL Kok

reviewList.text:
This business operates out of the 10th floor of the Seven Seas Hotel.

​My wife and I went in for a 45-minute foot and leg massage (300,000 VND each).

The timing was highly disappointing - 5 minutes were spent soaking our feet, followed by only 30 minutes of actual foot/leg massage, and 5 minutes on the neck and shoulders. On top of that, they finished 5 minutes early. It felt like they intentionally dragged out the massage on one leg just to kill time, as they re-massaged certain parts of one leg but not the other.

​While the massage itself wasn't terrible, the attitude of the staff completely spoiled the experience. At the end, they aggressively asked for a tip. We reluctantly agreed, but upon receiving it, one therapist scoffed and made a face of absolute disgust. Even though I don't speak Vietnamese, her angry tone while complaining to her colleague made it incredibly obvious she wasn't happy.

​It was an incredibly ungrateful and entitled attitude. Save your money - would not recommend.
reviewList.author: Anuj Choudhary

reviewList.text:
Came here to get my legs massaged. The reception and massage room was not too nice but I gave them the benefit of doubt, should not have.

The massage was the worst I have ever had (have been to a number of different places throughout Asia), felt more like random poking than massage. For example she spent more time rubbing my knee cap than massaging my thigh. The only training she must have had would be a 15 min Youtube video of how to massage. My plan was to give a two star rating but then she out of nowhere touched my private parts (through my boxer shorts) and wondered if I wanted massage there. I immediately got up and left the room, with her asking for tip behind me.

Now you what kind of place this is…

reviewList.text: This place is a bit basic, but Nhu Y gave a great foot massage and shampoo. Price is competitive with others. Tipped her for her hard work and good work ethic with no slacking.

reviewList.text: The worst experience I've ever had in Da Nang: terrible massage technique and they kept demanding tips, the room was dirty and smelly, the massage didn't use hot stones, and they didn't wipe me down with clean towels. I hope no one else has a similar experience.

reviewList.text:
The massage itself was very nice, my masseuse was kind of friendly and nice, had a very good hands. However she was districted by other guests time to time and I almost had to remind that I’m still there.

The place is not so nice, kind of basic and massage room is old. Even though it’s clean, it’s not relaxing.

In the end the personnel insists on tips, I saw some reviews like that but was hoping my that situation got improved. Obviously, it hasn’t. They ask minimum of 50k tips per person, which would be totally ok if they didn’t ask for it that way. There was a family of 3 people at the same time - and the masseuses didn’t let them go out until they tipped.

Just a cup of tea and tip pocket would be enough to get what they want without insulting anyone or make the situation feel unsafe for guests.
